function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_progress = cs_controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	self.starting_inner_progress = -1
	self.starting_grade = -1
	self.inter_section_params = {}

	self.onigirl_name = "onigirl"
	self.lana_oneline = "onigirl_titantavern_19"

	quest_icon.PreLoad()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
	self.pre_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'OniGirlRacingTitantavernPreSection')
end

function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'OniGirlRacingTitantavernSection1')
	}

	self.post_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'OniGirlRacingTitantavernPostSection')
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	self:lana_animation_setting()
end

function local_class:lana_animation_setting()
	local onigirl = get_character(self.onigirl_name)

	if onigirl == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		onigirl.Interactable.Talk = self.lana_oneline
		onigirl:SetEmotion('smile', true)
		onigirl:SetAnimation("success", true)
	else
		onigirl:SetEmotion('smile', true)
		onigirl:SetAnimation("attack", true)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end
}

function local_class:setting_notactive()
	local lana = self:get_lana()

	character_util.set_active_state(lana, 'disabled')
end

function local_class:setting_pre()
	local lana = self:get_lana()

	character_util.set_active_state(lana, 'enabled')

	self.lana_working_flag = true

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lana, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lana)
	character_util.set_direction(lana, 'down')

	lana.Position = self.lana_original_pos

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party_leader, { 'load_mini_game', 'lana_hard' }))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lana_working, self))
end

function local_class:setting_post()
	local lana = self:get_lana()

	character_util.set_active_state(lana, 'disabled')
end

function local_class:lana_pause_check()
	local lana = self:get_lana()
	if self.lana_work_pause and self.lana_working_flag then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lana)
		while self.lana_work_pause and self.lana_working_flag do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:exit_working_coroutine(present, item, present_tile_prop)
	present.FieldObjectBehaviour = present_tile_prop[1]
	present.Holdable = present_tile_prop[2]
	present.Interactable = present_tile_prop[3]
	self.sprite_attach_flag = false
	local lana = self:get_lana()
	local current_state = lana.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local target = current_state.HoldTarget
		command_util.execute_throw(lana, target, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(lana.Direction),
				lana.Position, 0, false)
	end
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	item:ConsumeComplete()
end

	local lana = self:get_lana()

	local count = 1

	local present_tile_prop = { }
	table.insert(present_tile_prop, present.FieldObjectBehaviour)
	table.insert(present_tile_prop, present.Holdable)
	table.insert(present_tile_prop, present.Interactable)

	lana.Position = self.lana_original_pos
	present.Position = self.lana_original_pos + 1 * unity_class.vector3.back + 1 * unity_class.vector3.up

	-- 라나 일하는 루틴

		character_util.set_direction(lana, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim(lana, { name = 'attack' })

			present.FieldObjectBehaviour = present_tile_prop[1]
			present.Holdable = present_tile_prop[2]
			present.Interactable = present_tile_prop[3]
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lana)
			return
		end
		if self:lana_pause_check() then
			character_util.set_anim(lana, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_direction(lana, 'down')
		end

		local item = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = lana.Position, target = present.Position
				, itemid = self.constants.original_item_id[count], lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', notforinven = true, skip_text = true })
		item:SetSortingLayer(true)
		item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

		count = ((count + 1)  % #self.constants.original_item_id) + 1

		if not self.lana_working_flag then
			yield_return(self, 'exit_working_coroutine', present,item, present_tile_prop)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lana)
			return
		end
		if self:lana_pause_check() then
			character_util.set_anim(lana, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_direction(lana, 'down')
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.6)
		self.sprite_attach_flag = true

		present.Position = self.lana_original_pos + 1 * unity_class.vector3.back + 1 * unity_class.vector3.up

		item:ConsumeComplete()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

	local present = self:get_present()
	local present_sprite = item
	local formal_parent = present_sprite.SpriteTransform.parent

	--[[
	drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = present.Position, target = present.Position
			, itemid = id, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', notforinven = true, skip_text = true })
	--]]

	present.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 1, 0.4))
	present_sprite:SetSortingLayer(true)
	present_sprite.SpriteTransform:SetParent(present.Transform)
	while self.sprite_attach_flag do
		present_sprite.SpriteTransform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	present_sprite.SpriteTransform:SetParent(formal_parent)

end

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = controller @
		QuestName = RedHood @
		Comment = 숲 서브스테이지의 빨간 모자 영입 퀘스트 @
]]

-- 생성자
function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller, scene)
	-- CS Controller 로 OnEvent 를 받을수 있다.
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = scene()

	self.starting_inner_progress = -1
	self.starting_grade = -1
	self.inter_section_params = {}
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
	-- pre story section 은 여기서 읽는다
	self.pre_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'RedHoodPreSection')
end

function local_class:on_init()
	-- 기본 이벤트 섹션들 로드를 여기서 처리
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'RedHoodSection1'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'RedHoodSection2'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'RedHoodSection3')
	}

	self.post_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'RedHoodPostSection')
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	self.scene:setting()

	-- 스테이지만 오픈되고 퀘스트가 진행되지 않은 경우 강제로 진행시켜준다.
	if self.quest_progress == nil and user_progress:IsStageOpened("substage_1_8") then
		quest_util.re_activate_quest(self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.setting_section, self))
end

function local_class:setting_section()

	if stage.Name == "easy_forest_1_4" then
		if self.quest_progress == nil then
			coroutine.yield(self.scene:setting_pre())
		end
	elseif stage.Name == "substage_1_8" then
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0 then
			coroutine.yield(self.scene:setting_1())
		end
	elseif stage.Name == "substage_1_9" then
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 then
			coroutine.yield(self.scene:setting_2())
		elseif self.quest_progress ~= nil and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			coroutine.yield(self.scene:setting_3())
		end

		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			coroutine.yield(self.scene:setting_post())
		else
			coroutine.yield(self.scene:setting_victim())
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end


	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass("RinShopMain")

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = controller @
		QuestName = RinShopMain @
		Comment = 린 도시락 가게 메인 퀘스트 @
]]

-- 생성자
function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller, _)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.starting_inner_progress = -1
	self.starting_grade = -1
	self.inter_section_params = {}

	-- 로드된 미니게임 데이터, 섹션에서 필요할 때만 저장
	self.save_data = {}

	self.on_bgm_transition = false

	-- 루프 존에 들어갔는지 저장
	self.enter_loop_zone = false

	-- 공장 내부에 있는지 저장
	self.is_in_factory = false

	-- 공장에서 상점으로 돌아올 때 BGM 원복 하지 않는 플래그 (섹션 4 때문에 필요)
	self.is_ignore_reset_factory_bgm = false

	-- 편지 읽었는지 저장
	self.read_letter = false

	-- 편지
	self.letter = nil

	-- 편지 DropItem 레퍼런스
	self.drop_item_letter = nil

	-- 콩 아이템 리스트
	self.pea_item_list = nil

	-- 공장 SFX
	self.factory_loop_sfx = nil

	-- 기타 상수
	self.letter_item_id = 20151
	self.pea_item_id = 20258

	-- 타일맵 캐릭터 이름

	-- 타일맵 필드오브젝트 이름
	self.letter_name = 'letter'
	self.interactable_pea_name = 'interactable_pea'

	-- 타일맵 존 이름
	self.loop_zone_name = 'loop'
	self.factory_event_zone_name = 'factory'

	-- 타일맵 마커 이름
	self.loop_end_marker_name = 'loop_end'
	self.loop_start_marker_name = 'loop_start'
	self.factory_marker_name = 'factory_default_start'

	-- 틴트 키
	self.tint_key_name = 'rin_shop_main'
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), 'on_event')

	self.letter = get_field_object(self.letter_name)

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
end

function local_class:on_init()
	-- 기본 이벤트 섹션들 로드를 여기서 처리
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'RinShopMainPreSection'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'RinShopMainSection1'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'RinShopMainSection2'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'RinShopMainSection3'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'RinShopMainSection4')
	}

	self.post_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'RinShopMainPostSection')
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	if self.quest_progress == nil or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 3 then
		stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.letter_name, 'disabled')
	end

	self:load_minigame()
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) then
		self:on_stage_start_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent) then
		self:on_battle_start_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent) then
		self:on_battle_end_event(e)
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 3 then
		self:activate_letter()
	end

	-- 콩 생성
	self:drop_pea()
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if not self.is_in_factory and zone_name == self.factory_event_zone_name then
		self.is_in_factory = true
	end

	if not self.enter_loop_zone and zone_name == self.loop_zone_name then
		-- 섹션 3 진행 중일 때는 작동하지 않음
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 4 then
			return false
		end

		self.enter_loop_zone = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.turn_off_bgm, self))

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_horror', state = 'event', mix = 2 })

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.loop_event, self))
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.loop_tint_event, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if self.is_in_factory and zone_name == self.factory_event_zone_name then
		self.is_in_factory = false

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.leave_factory_event, self))
	end

	if self.enter_loop_zone and zone_name == self.loop_zone_name then
		-- 섹션 3 진행 중일 때는 작동하지 않음
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 4 then
			return false
		end

		self.enter_loop_zone = false
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.turn_on_bgm, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.letter) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_letter, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_start_event(e)
	if self.is_in_factory then
		-- 공장 내부에서 전투 시작 시 factory sfx 페이드 아웃
		self:fade_out_factory_sfx()
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)
	if self.is_in_factory then
		-- 공장 내부에서 전투 종료 시 factory sfx 페이드 인
		self:fade_in_factory_sfx()
	end
end

-- 편지 활성화
function local_class:activate_letter()
	stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.letter_name, 'enabled')

	self.drop_item_letter = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = self.letter.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.2),
	                             itemid = self.letter_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
end

-- 공장 마지막 방에 콩 생성
function local_class:drop_pea()
	self.pea_item_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.DropItem)

	local pea_num = 35
	local index = 0
	local index_max = 11
	local index_sub = 2
	local count = 0
	local add_y = 0.4

	local rand_limit_x = 0.05
	local rand_limit_z = 0.05
	local rand_count = 4

	local rand_angle_limit = 35

	for i = 0, pea_num - 1 do
		index = index + 1

		if index > index_max then
			index = 1

			index_max = index_max - index_sub

			count = count + 1
		end

		local cur_x = 157 + 0.27 * (count + index)
		local cur_y = add_y * count
		local cur_z = 5

		local rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(-rand_limit_x * (rand_count - count) / rand_count,
				rand_limit_x * (rand_count - count) / rand_count)
		local rand_z = unity_class.random.Range(-rand_limit_z * (rand_count - count) / rand_count,
				rand_limit_z * (rand_count - count) / rand_count)

		local angle_dir = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, 2))
		local rand_angle = 0

		if angle_dir == 0 then
			rand_angle = unity_class.random.Range(-rand_angle_limit, rand_angle_limit)
		else
			rand_angle = unity_class.random.Range(180 - rand_angle_limit, 180 + rand_angle_limit)
		end

		local pea = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = vector(cur_x, cur_y, cur_z) + vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z),
		                                         itemid = self.pea_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

		pea.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, rand_angle, 0)
		pea.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, rand_angle, 0)

		if count > 0 then
			pea:SetSortingLayer(true)
		end

		-- 퀘스트 InnerProgress가 4 이하면 완두콩 아이템 검게 틴트
		if self.quest_progress == nil or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 4 then
			local item_sprite = pea.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

			item_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 })
			item_sprite:Rebuild()
		end

		self.pea_item_list:Add(pea)
	end

	-- 완두콩 상호작용 블록 Hitbox 수정
	local interactable_pea = get_field_object(self.interactable_pea_name)
	interactable_pea.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.45, 0.2, 0.5), vector(3, 3, 1.5))
end

-- 완두콩 틴트 해제, RinShopMainSection2에서 호출함
function local_class:remove_tint_pea(duration)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.remove_tint_pea_routine, self, duration))
end

-- 완두콩 틴트 해제
function local_class:remove_tint_pea_routine(duration)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_evolve_result_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local item = self.pea_item_list[0]

	local item_sprite = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local item_start_color = item_sprite.TintColor
	local item_end_color = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 })

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

		for i = 0, self.pea_item_list.Count - 1 do
			local cur_item_sprite = self.pea_item_list[i].SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

			cur_item_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.Lerp(item_start_color, item_end_color, progress)
			cur_item_sprite:Rebuild()
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	for i = 0, self.pea_item_list.Count - 1 do
		local cur_item_sprite = self.pea_item_list[i].SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

		cur_item_sprite.TintColor = item_end_color
		cur_item_sprite:Rebuild()
	end
end

function local_class:turn_on_bgm()
	while self.on_bgm_transition do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if not self.enter_loop_zone then
		self.on_bgm_transition = true

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'ondemand/v2_9_rinshop/audio:bgm_lynn_theme', state = 'field', mix = 2})
		wait_for_sec(2.1)

		self.on_bgm_transition = false
	end

end

function local_class:turn_off_bgm()
	while self.on_bgm_transition do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.enter_loop_zone then
		self.on_bgm_transition = true

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
		wait_for_sec(2.1)

		self.on_bgm_transition = false
	end

end

-- 통로 루프 이벤트 반복
function local_class:loop_event()
	local loop_start_marker_x = field:GetMarker(self.loop_start_marker_name).position.x
	local loop_end_marker_x = field:GetMarker(self.loop_end_marker_name).position.x

	while self.enter_loop_zone do
		if user_party_leader.Position.x >= loop_end_marker_x then
			local diff = user_party_leader.Position.x - loop_end_marker_x

			user_party_leader.Position = vector(
					loop_start_marker_x + diff, user_party_leader.Position.y, user_party_leader.Position.z)

		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 통로 루프 시 화면 틴트
function local_class:loop_tint_event()
	local tint_duration = 1.4

	while true do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_vignette_01')
		field:Tint(self.tint_key_name, unity_class.color.red, tint_duration)

		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

		while self.enter_loop_zone and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < tint_duration do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not self.enter_loop_zone then
			break
		end

		field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key_name, tint_duration)

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time

		while self.enter_loop_zone and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < tint_duration do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not self.enter_loop_zone then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 0.3 })

	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key_name, 0.3)
end

-- 편지에 상호작용
function local_class:interact_letter()
	if not self.read_letter then
		self.read_letter = true

		field_ui_util.show_narration_async( { key = 'rin_shop_main_s2_1' })

		field_ui_util.show_narration_async( { key = 'rin_shop_main_s2_2' })

		field_ui_util.show_narration_async( { key = 'rin_shop_main_s2_3' })

		field_ui_util.show_narration_async( { key = 'rin_shop_main_s2_4' })
	end

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { 'rin_shop_main_s2_5', 'mercy' }, { 'rin_shop_main_s2_6', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

		screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		local marker = field:GetMarker(self.factory_marker_name)

		character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, marker.position + vector(-1, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, marker.direction)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		self:fade_in_factory_sfx()

		screen_util.fade_in(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry,
				user_party_leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
				user_party_leader.Direction, game_string:GetString('rin_shop_main_s2_7'))
	end
end

-- 공장 벗어나서 돌아올 때 BGM 복구 스킵
function local_class:ignore_reset_factory_bgm(val)
	self.is_ignore_reset_factory_bgm = val
end

-- 공장 벗어나서 상점으로 돌아오면 발생하는 이벤트
function local_class:leave_factory_event()
	-- BGM 원복
	if not self.is_ignore_reset_factory_bgm then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_9_rinshop/audio:bgm_lynn_theme', state = 'field', mix = 2 })
	end

	-- SFX 페이드 아웃
	self:fade_out_factory_sfx()

	-- 공장에서 돌아오면 체력 회복
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = user_party_leader
	heal_info.target = user_party_leader
	heal_info.heal = user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.skipEffect = true

	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
end

-- 공장 BGM 재생
function local_class:fade_in_factory_sfx()
	if self.factory_loop_sfx == nil then
		self.factory_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{ sfx_name = '01_aircraft_loop_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc' })
	end
end

-- 공장 BGM 제거
function local_class:fade_out_factory_sfx()
	if self.factory_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.factory_loop_sfx:FadeOut(2)

		self.factory_loop_sfx = nil
	end
end

-- 미니게임 변수 로드
function local_class:load_minigame()
	local data = -1

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		data = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'RinShopSaveData')
	end

	if data == -1 then
		self.save_data.ShopLevel = 0
		self.save_data.NumCounters = 0
		self.save_data.NumTables = 0
		self.save_data.WeaponLevel = 0
		self.save_data.Money = 10000
		self.save_data.Marketing = 0
	else
		self:decode_data(data)
	end
end

-- 미니게임 변수 디코딩
function local_class:decode_data(data)
	local data = math.tointeger(data)

	if data ~= nil then
		self.save_data.ShopLevel = (data & 0x7)
		self.save_data.NumCounters = ((data >> 3) & 0x7)
		self.save_data.NumTables = ((data >> 6) & 0x7)
		self.save_data.WeaponLevel = ((data >> 9) & 0xF)
		self.save_data.Money = ((data >> 13) & 0x1FFFF) * 100
		self.save_data.Marketing = ((data >> 30) & 0x1)

		if self.save_data.Marketing > 1 then

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(water_npc, { key = 'shortstory_bari_flower_garden_61' })
end

function local_class:interact_water_npc()
	local water_npc = self.get_teatan_male()
	local bari = user_party.Leader
	local mayreel = self.get_mayreel()
	local ans = 0

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_to_async(bari, water_npc.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
					nil, 2.5, true, true)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_to_async(mayreel, water_npc.Position + vector(1, 0, -0.5),
					nil, 2.5, true, true)
		end)
	})
	character_util.set_group_direction({ bari, mayreel }, 'left')

	-- 저희 마을을 찾아주신 분들께 물을 나눠드리고 있어요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(water_npc, { key = 'shortstory_bari_flower_garden_49', skip = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(bari, { name = 'smile' })

	-- 시원한 물 한 잔 하며 쉬었다 가세요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(water_npc, { key = 'shortstory_bari_flower_garden_50', skip = true })

	if self.current_progress == self.progress.accept and self.current_water_npc_progress == self.water_npc_progress.none then
		-- 물을 얻는다.
		ans = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'shortstory_bari_flower_garden_55', 'mercy' },
			{ 'shortstory_bari_flower_garden_22', 'normal' }
		})

		if ans == 1 then
			self:give_item(self.item_id.water, 1, bari)

			-- 여깄습니다. 즐거운 여행 되세요!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(water_npc, { key = 'shortstory_bari_flower_garden_60', skip = true })

			self.current_water_npc_progress = self.water_npc_progress.clear
		end
	elseif self.current_progress ~= self.progress.accept or self.current_water_npc_progress == self.water_npc_progress.clear then
		-- 물을 마신다.
		ans = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'shortstory_bari_flower_garden_54', 'mercy' },
			{ 'shortstory_bari_flower_garden_22', 'normal' }
		})

		if ans == 1 then
			self:give_item(self.item_id.cup_filled, 1, bari)

			-- 여깄습니다. 즐거운 여행 되세요!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(water_npc, { key = 'shortstory_bari_flower_garden_60', skip = true })

			self:drink_water(bari)
		end
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(bari)
end

function local_class:drink_water(target)
	character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'dualgun_attack_right', loop = false, scale = 0.3 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drinking_01')
	target.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'glass_cup_filled_90')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	target.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'glass_cup_empty_90')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim(target)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'awesome' })
	wait_for_sec(1)
	target.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')
	character_util.remove_emotion(bari)
end

function local_class:give_item(item_id, throw_num, throw_target)
	local water_npc = self.get_teatan_male()

	character_util.set_direction(water_npc, 'left')
	local equip_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim(water_npc, { name = 'eat', loop = true })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	equip_sfx:FadeOut(0)
	character_util.remove_anim(water_npc)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	character_util.set_direction(water_npc, 'right')

	for i = 1, throw_num do
		character_util.set_anim(water_npc, { name = 'release', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle', sfx_name = '01_throw_01' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
		local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = water_npc.Position, target = throw_target.Position, itemid = item_id,
			notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true })

		wait_for_sec(0.75)
		item.ConsumeTarget = throw_target
		item:Fly()
	end
end

function local_class:init_npc(start_info)
	-- npc 세팅
	for k, v in pairs(start_info) do
		local character = get_character(k)
		character_util.set_position(character, v['pos'])
		character_util.set_direction(character, v['dir'])
		if type_util.is_string(v['emo']) then
			character_util.set_emotion(character, { name = v['emo'] })
		end
		if type_util.is_string(v['anim']) then
			character_util.set_anim(character, { name = v['anim'] })
		end
		if v['hide_ui'] ~= nil and v['hide_ui'] == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(character, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end
	end
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:color_to_color_routine(target, c1, c2, duration)
	local timer = 0

	if target ~= nil then
		local renderer = target:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
		local spine = target.SpineController
		if spine ~= nil then
			spine:RemoveColor(nil, 0)
			spine:AddColor('bari_field_tint', c1, 1, 0)

			while timer < duration do
				local progress = timer / duration
				local current_color = unity_class.color.Lerp(c1, c2, progress)

				spine:AddColor('bari_field_tint', current_color, 1, 0)

				timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			if c2 == unity_color({1, 1, 1, 1}) then
				spine:RemoveColor(nil, 0)
			else
				spine:AddColor('bari_field_tint', c2, 1, 0)
			end
			return
		elseif renderer ~= nil then
			local mat = renderer.material

			mat.shader = CS.UnityEngine.Shader.Find('Unlit/Texture Tint')
			mat.color = c1

			while timer < duration do
				local progress = timer / duration
				local current_color = unity_class.color.Lerp(c1, c2, progress)

				mat.color = current_color

				timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			mat.color = c2
			return
		end
	else

		--field:RemoveTint(nil, 0)
		field:Tint('bari_field_tint', c1, 0)

		while timer < duration do
			local progress = timer / duration
			local current_color = unity_class.color.Lerp(c1, c2, progress)

			field:Tint('bari_field_tint', current_color, 0)

			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		field:Tint('bari_field_tint', c2, 0)
		return
	end
end

function local_class:screen_distortion_event(e)
	local duration = 2.5
	local power = 0.008
	if e.Params.Length > 1 then
		duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(tonumber(e.Params[1]), 2.5)
	end
	if e.Params.Length > 2 then
		power = lua_helper.get_or_default(tonumber(e.Params[2]), 0.004)
	end

	if self.on_distortion then
		self.on_distortion = false

		self.new_vps.enabled = false
		self.vps.enabled = false
		self.vps.enabled = true

		self.distorter.DistortAmount = 0
		self.distorter.enabled = false
		self.new_camera:SetActive(false)
	else
		self.on_distortion = true

		self.new_camera:SetActive(true)
		self.distorter.enabled = true
		self.new_vps.enabled = true
		self.vps.enabled = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.screen_distortion_routine, self, duration, power))
	end
end

function local_class:screen_distortion_routine(duration, power)
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed
		self.distorter.DistortAmount = progress * power

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.distorter)
	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.new_camera)

	if self.portrait_img ~= nil then
		self.portrait_img:ConsumeComplete()
		self.portrait_img = nil
	end

	if self.resholder ~= nil then
		self.resholder:Dispose()
		self.resholder = nil
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.mat_container_obj) == false then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.mat_container_obj)
	end
	self.mat_container_obj = nil
	self.mat_container = nil

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

function local_class:portraits_set_alpha(targets, color, duration)
	local sprites = {}
	for _, v in ipairs(targets) do
		table.insert(sprites, v.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite)))
	end
	local prev_color = sprites[1].TintColor
	local timer = 0
	while timer < duration do
		local progress = timer / duration

		for _, sprite in ipairs(sprites) do
			sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.Lerp(prev_color, color, progress)
			sprite:Rebuild()
		end

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	for _, sprite in ipairs(sprites) do
		sprite.TintColor = color
		sprite:Rebuild()
	end

function local_class:memory_erase(characters, duration)
	local timer = 0

	local characters_count = 0
	if characters.Count == nil then
		if type_util.is_array(characters) then
			for _, _ in ipairs(characters) do
				characters_count = characters_count + 1
			end
		else
			characters = {characters}
			characters_count = 1
		end
	else
		characters_count = characters.Count
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(self.bari, {name = 'sleep_deep'})

	local origins = {}
	local effects = {}

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_flower_ball_01')
	for i = 1, characters_count do
		local memory_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_bari_memory_light_start'):Instantiate(characters[i].Position + vector(0, 1.5, 0))
		memory_fx.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
		effects[i] = memory_fx
		origins[i] = memory_fx.transform.position
	end


	field:Tint('bari_field_tint', unity_color({ 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1 }), duration / 4)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	while timer < duration do
		for i = 1, characters_count do
			effects[i].transform.position = origins[i] + vector(0, 1, 0) * timer * timer
			effects[i].transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) * (duration - timer) / duration
		end
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	field:RemoveTint('bari_field_tint', duration / 4)

	timer = 0
	while timer < duration / 4 do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 1, characters_count do
		effects[i].transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		effects[i]:Dispose()
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.bari)
end

			local duration = 1

			local origin = self.flower_piles[i].Position
			self.flower_piles[i].ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
			self.flower_piles[i]:SetSortingLayer(true)
			while timer < duration do

				local vp = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(origin, pos, progress)
				self.flower_piles[i].Position = vp

			self.flower_piles[i].SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.party_teleporting == false then
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 2 or self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('restaurant_back_entrance')) then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.teleport_party_to_marker, self, 'restaurant_back_entrance')
				return true

			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('restaurant_back_exit')) then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.teleport_party_to_marker, self, 'restaurant_back_exit')
				return true
			end
		end

		if self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			if self.warehouse_interact_cbs[e.Target] ~= nil then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.warehouse_interact_cbs[e.Target], self)
				return true

			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_factory_front_entrance()) then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.teleport_party_to_marker, self, 'factory_front_entrance')
				return true

			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_factory_back_entrance()) then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.teleport_party_to_marker, self, 'factory_back_entrance')
				return true

			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_sewer_entrance()) then
				speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(user_party.Leader)
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(user_party.Leader, 'shortstory_dragon_oneline_5')
				return true

	return false

		for i = 1, 4 do

function local_class:add_field_tint(duration, request_key, objs_data)
	local color = unity_class.color.black
	request_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(request_key, self.field_tint_key)
	local npcs = lua_helper.get_value(objs_data, 'npcs', nil)
	local items = lua_helper.get_value(objs_data, 'items', nil)
	local gos = lua_helper.get_value(objs_data, 'gos', nil)

	field:Tint(request_key, color, duration)

	if type_util.is_table(npcs) then
		-- npc들이 담긴 원본 테이블이 수정될 수 있으므로 복사된 테이블을 새로 생성
		local cached_npcs = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.tint_npcs_dic[request_key], {})
		for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
			-- 중복된 캐릭터가 들어가지 않도록 키값 부여
			cached_npcs[npc.Name] = npc
		end

		for _, npc in pairs(cached_npcs) do
			npc.SpineController:AddColor(request_key, color, 1, duration)
		end

		-- request_key를 키값으로 하도록 캐싱해놓음.
		self.tint_npcs_dic[request_key] = cached_npcs
	end

	if type_util.is_table(gos) then
		local cached_gos = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.tint_gos_dic[request_key], {})
		for _, go in pairs(gos) do
			cached_gos[go] = go
		end

		for _, go in pairs(cached_gos) do
			-- 일단 그냥 꺼버리는 방식으로...
			go:SetActive(false)
		end

		self.tint_gos_dic[request_key] = cached_gos
	end

	if type_util.is_table(items) then
		local cached_items = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.tint_items_dic[request_key], {})
		for _, item in pairs(items) do
			-- 중복된 아이템이 들어가지 않도록 키 값으로 자신을 넣음 (다른 방법이 있나?)
			if cached_items[item] == nil then
				cached_items[item] = {
					item = item,
					start_color = self:get_item_color(item)
				}
			end
		end

		self.tint_items_dic[request_key] = cached_items

		self:items_alpha_fade_async(cached_items, 0, 0, duration)

	else
		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end
end

function local_class:get_item_color(item)
	return item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite)).TintColor
end

function local_class:remove_field_tint(duration, request_key)
	request_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(request_key, self.field_tint_key)

	field:RemoveTint(request_key, duration)

	local npcs = self.tint_npcs_dic[request_key]
	local items = self.tint_items_dic[request_key]
	local gos = self.tint_gos_dic[request_key]

	-- 테이블일 때만 넣었으므로 테이블 검사는 하지 않아도 됨
	if npcs ~= nil then
		for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
			npc.SpineController:RemoveColor(request_key, duration)
		end

		-- 딕셔너리에서 삭제
		self.tint_npcs_dic[request_key] = nil
	end

	if gos ~= nil then
		for _, go in pairs(gos) do

		self.tint_items_dic[request_key] = nil
	else
		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end
end

-- 아이템들에 알파 페이드를 먹이는 함수
function local_class:items_alpha_fade_async(item_infos, sprite_alpha, shadow_alpha, duration)
	local item_sprites = {}
	local shadow_sprites = {}
	local item_start_alphas = {}
	local shadow_start_alphas = {}
	local item_start_colors = {}

	for _, info in pairs(item_infos) do
		-- 기존에 섹션 3에서 사용하던 것과 호환되도록
		local is_table = type_util.is_table(info)
		local item = is_table and info.item or info
		local start_color = is_table and info.start_color or unity_color({1, 1, 1, 1})

		local item_sprite = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		local shadow_sprite = item.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

		table.insert(item_sprites, item_sprite)
		table.insert(shadow_sprites, shadow_sprite)
		table.insert(item_start_alphas, item_sprite.Alpha)
		table.insert(shadow_start_alphas, shadow_sprite.Alpha)
		table.insert(item_start_colors, start_color)
	end

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		for i = 1, #item_sprites do
			item_sprites[i].TintColor = item_start_colors[i]
					* unity_class.mathf.Lerp(item_start_alphas[i], sprite_alpha, progress)
			shadow_sprites[i].Alpha = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(shadow_start_alphas[i], shadow_alpha, progress)
			item_sprites[i]:Rebuild()
			shadow_sprites[i]:Rebuild()
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	for i = 1, #item_sprites do
		item_sprites[i].TintColor = item_start_colors[i] * sprite_alpha
		shadow_sprites[i].Alpha = shadow_alpha
		item_sprites[i]:Rebuild()
		shadow_sprites[i]:Rebuild()
	end
end

function local_class:jump_into_hole(hole_pos)
	local jump_dir = self:vector_to_side_dir(hole_pos - user_party.Leader.Position)
	local move_dur = 0.7
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_fall_down_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

	user_party.Leader.Direction = jump_dir
	character_util.jump(user_party.Leader, 1, move_dur)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party.Leader, 0, move_dur)
	character_util.spine_scale(user_party.Leader, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5, move_dur)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'get'})
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, hole_pos, move_dur)

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'ease_in_out_sine')

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.spine_scale(user_party.Leader, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party.Leader, 1, 0)

function local_class:jump_out_hole(hole_pos, target_pos)
	character_util.spine_scale(user_party.Leader, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party.Leader, 0, 0)

	user_party.Leader.Position = hole_pos
	user_party.Leader.Direction = self:vector_to_side_dir(target_pos - hole_pos)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'ease_in_out_sine')

	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'get'})
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party.Leader, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_scale(user_party.Leader, unity_class.vector3.one, 0.5)
	character_util.jump(user_party.Leader,1, 0.5)

	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, target_pos, 0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
end

function local_class:vector_to_side_dir(v)
	return v.x > 0 and CS.Oak.Direction.Right or CS.Oak.Direction.Left
end

function local_class:ride_train(fo, train, move_camera)
	local ride_dur = 0.25
	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local target_pos = fo.Position + (train.Position - fo.Position).normalized * 0.7

	if move_camera then
		camera_util.move(train.Position, ride_dur)
	end

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fo, 0, ride_dur)
	character_util.look_at(fo, train)
	character_util.set_anim(fo, {name = 'get'})
	fo:HideWeapon(true, 'train_event')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < ride_dur do
		local progress = time_passed / ride_dur
		local cur_x0z = progress * target_pos + (1 - progress) * start_pos
		local cur_y = math.sin(math.pi / 2 * progress) * 0.7

		character_util.set_position(fo, vector_util.get_x0z(cur_x0z, cur_y), true)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.set_position(fo, target_pos, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(fo)
end

function local_class:alight_train(fo, train, alight_dir, move_camera)
	local alight_dur = 0.25
	alight_dir = character_util.get_direction(alight_dir)
	local alight_dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3(alight_dir)
	local start_pos = train.Position + ((alight_dir & CS.Oak.Direction.Side) ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None
			and vector(0, 0, 0.5) or unity_class.vector3.zero)
			+ (alight_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down and 0.5 or 1.0) * alight_dir_vec
	local target_pos = start_pos + alight_dir_vec

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fo, 1, alight_dur / 2)
	character_util.set_direction(fo, alight_dir)
	character_util.set_anim(fo, {name = 'get'})
	character_util.set_position(fo, start_pos)

	if move_camera then
		camera_util.move(target_pos, alight_dur, {end_target = fo})
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < alight_dur do
		local progress = time_passed / alight_dur
		local cur_x0z = progress * target_pos + (1 - progress) * start_pos
		local cur_y = math.cos(math.pi / 2 * progress) * 0.7

		character_util.set_position(fo, vector_util.get_x0z(cur_x0z, cur_y), true)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.set_position(fo, target_pos, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(fo)

	fo:HideWeapon(false, 'train_event')
end

	local angle = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(-45, 0, 0)

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	-- ObjectPool PreLoad가 필요할 때 뒤에 인자로 주르륵 넣는다
	-- ex) yield_return_func(quest_util.load_pool_resource,'bla1', 'bla2')

	self.resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	coroutine.yield(self.resholder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName("ondemand/short_story_lahn/ui", "ShortStoryLahnBook"), function(p)
		local book_obj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, p)
		local overlay = book_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.IUIOverlay))
		overlay.UISceneManager = stage.UISceneManager
		book_obj:SetActive(false)
	end))

	-- 도감 확인 버튼 UI 로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.resholder, 'ondemand/short_story_lahn/ui', 'ShortStoryLahnBookButton', function(prefab)
				self.book_button = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)

				local button = self.book_button.transform:Find('Contents'):Find('Button')

				self.book_button_red_dot = button:Find('Red Dot')
				self.red_dot_cur_stat = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.red_dot_stat_key)
				if self.red_dot_cur_stat == self.red_dot_stat.enabled then
					self.book_button_red_dot.gameObject:SetActive(true)
				else
					self.book_button_red_dot.gameObject:SetActive(false)
				end

				local button_component = button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UIButton))

				button_component.onClick:Clear()
				CS.EventDelegate.Set(button_component.onClick, function()
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_book_popup, self))
				end)
			end)

		local lahn_book = get_or_create_global_table('stageeventcontrollers/ShortStoryLahnBook')
		local last_update_item_data = lahn_book:get_last_updated_item_data()

		local constants = require('ShortStoryLahnBookSetting')
		local book_data = constants['short_story_lahn_book_settings']

		local cur_category = book_data['short_story_lahn_book_category_' .. last_update_item_data.category_num]
		local item_name = game_string:GetString(cur_category.items[last_update_item_data.item_num].title)

		-- {0}에 새로운 기록을 작성 했다!
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = game_string:Format('shortstory_lahn_record_complete_narration_1', item_name) })

		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		party_util.reset_controllers()

	if open_book == true then
		self:show_book_popup()
	end

function local_class:apply_custom_state_immediately(key_name, val)
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.quest_id)
	local save_success = true
	local on_success = function (res)
		save_success = true
	end

	-- 먼저 custom state 를 set 한다.
	local fail_count = 0
	while true do
		local r = CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.SetCustomState(nil, quest_progress, key_name, val)
		coroutine.yield(r)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		-- on_error 콜백을 안받아서 CustomState 가 실제로 변경되었는지로 체크해야 한다..
		save_success = true

		if quest_progress:GetCustomState(key_name) ~= val then
			save_success = false
		end

		if not save_success then
			fail_count = fail_count + 1
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("ShortStoryLahnBook : SetCustomState Retry")
			wait_for_sec(5.0 + fail_count)
		else
			break
		end
	end

	fail_count = 0
	while true do
		save_success = false
		local r = CS.Oak.NetworkManager.ApiConnection:SendProgressQuest(stage.StageId, quest_progress.QuestId, quest_progress.InnerProgress, nil)
		r:Then(on_success)
		coroutine.yield(r:SuppressDefaultErrorHandler())
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		if not save_success then
			fail_count = fail_count + 1
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("ShortStoryLahnBook : SendProgressQuest Retry")
			wait_for_sec(5.0 + fail_count)
		else
			break
		end
	end
end

return {

		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end

-- 도감이 닫힐 때 까지 기다리고 sp_util.play_normal_screenplay를 실행하도록 함
function local_class:play_normal_screenplay(func, ...)
	local args =  {...}
	local routine = function()
		self:wait_until_book_ui_on()

		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		local cached_leader = user_party.Leader
		if cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
			cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(
					stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
		end

		yield_return_func(func, table.unpack(args))

		if cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
			cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(
					stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
		end

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end

	return coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(routine))
end

		coroutine.yield()

end

function local_class:get_angle(target, start)
	local zy_diff = (target.z + target.y) - (start.z + start.y)
	local dir = vector(target.x - start.x, zy_diff)

	local sign
	if zy_diff < 0 then
		sign = -1
	else
		sign = 1
	end

	return unity_class.vector2.Angle(unity_class.vector2.up, dir) * sign
end

function local_class:shoot_red_ice(start_pos, target_pos, duration, angle)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.shoot_red_ice_async, self, start_pos, target_pos, duration, angle))
end

function local_class:shoot_red_ice_async(start_pos, target_pos, duration, angle)
	local red_ice_item = self:get_projectile()
	local time_passed = 0
	local shoot_dir = target_pos - start_pos
	--angle = lua_helper.get_or_default(angle, self:get_angle(target_pos, start_pos))

	if angle then
		red_ice_item.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, angle, 0)
	else
		local look_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(target_pos - start_pos)
		red_ice_item.transform.localRotation = look_rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	end

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		red_ice_item.transform.localPosition = target_pos * progress + start_pos * (1 - progress)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self:dispose_projectile(red_ice_item)
end

function local_class:secret_forest_load()
	self.secret_forest_interact = get_field_object('secret_forest_entrance')
	local tree_name = 'obj_tree_'
	local zone = field:GetZone('secret_forest_zone')
	local move = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(zone.Bounds, move)

	for i = 0, list.Count - 1 do
		local v = list[i]
		if string.find(v.Name, tree_name) then
			table.insert(self.tree_objs, v)
		end
	end

	list:Dispose()

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		self.secret_forest_opened = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.forest_data_name)
		self:set_forest_active(self.secret_forest_opened < 0)
	else
		self:set_forest_active(true)
	end

function local_class:set_forest_active(is_active)
	if is_active then
		for _, tree in ipairs(self.tree_objs) do
			tree.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
			self.secret_forest_interact.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
			self.secret_forest_interact.Position = field:GetMarker('secret_forest_down').position + vector(0, 0, 2.5)
			if self.tree_emoticon == nil then
				self.tree_emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(
						self.secret_forest_interact.Transform, nil, 'custom', 'emoticon_bubble_record_lahn.png',
						{no_time_limit = true})
			end
		end
	else
		for _, tree in ipairs(self.tree_objs) do
			tree.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			self.secret_forest_interact.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			if self.tree_emoticon ~= nil then
				self.tree_emoticon:Clear()
				self.tree_emoticon = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:costume_load_routine()
	if self.quest_progress == nil then return end

	self.current_costume = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.costume_data_name)
	if self.current_costume < 0 then
		self.current_costume = 1
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.costume_data_name, self.current_costume)
	end

	self.current_waits = {}

	for i, v in ipairs(self.costume_data) do
		v.npc = get_character(self.costume_name .. v.name)
		if i ~= self.current_costume then
			table.insert(self.current_waits, i)
		end
	end

	self.cached_waits = self.current_waits

	for n, i in ipairs(self.current_waits) do
		local data = self.costume_data[i]
		character_util.set_position(data.npc, field:GetMarker(self.costume_marker_name .. n).position)
		character_util.set_direction(data.npc, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(data.npc, {name = 'idle', loop = false}, {name = 'empty', loop = false})
		character_util.set_anim(data.npc, {name = '[sub]idle', scale = 0})
	end

	if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 3 then
		self:set_costume_narration(true)

	end
end

function local_class:update_costume_routine(index)
	local prev_costume = self.current_costume
	self.current_costume = index
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.costume_data_name, self.current_costume)

	if #self.current_waits == 0 then
		self.current_waits = {2, 3, 4}
	end

	for n, i in ipairs(self.current_waits) do
		if i == self.current_costume then
			self.current_waits[n] = prev_costume
		end
	end

	self.cached_waits = self.current_waits

	for n, i in ipairs(self.current_waits) do
		local data = self.costume_data[i]
		character_util.set_position(data.npc, field:GetMarker(self.costume_marker_name .. n).position)
		character_util.set_direction(data.npc, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(data.npc, {name = 'idle', loop = false}, {name = 'empty', loop = false})
		character_util.set_anim(data.npc, {name = '[sub]idle', scale = 0})
	end
end

	self:set_costume_narration(false, true)

		character_util.set_position(data.npc, field:GetMarker(self.costume_marker_name .. n).position)
		character_util.set_direction(data.npc, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(data.npc, {name = 'idle', loop = false}, {name = 'empty', loop = false})
		character_util.set_anim(data.npc, {name = '[sub]idle', scale = 0})
	end

function local_class:set_costume_narration(valid, use_temp)
	use_temp = lua_helper.get_or_default(use_temp, false)
	local waits = use_temp and self.current_waits or self.cached_waits
	self.costume_interact_state = valid
	if self.costume_interact_state then
		for i, c in ipairs(waits) do
			local data = self.costume_data[c]
			character_util.add_listener(data.npc, self)
			--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError(c)
		end
	else
		for i, c in ipairs(waits) do
			local data = self.costume_data[c]
			character_util.remove_relate_event(data.npc, self)
		end
	end

	if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 3 then
		self.before_costume = false
	end
end

function local_class:interact_witch_bed()
	-- 캐릭터가 침대 위 혹은 아래로 이동시켜서 겹치지 않게
	local witch_bed = get_field_object('witch_bed')
	local bed_pos = field:GetMarker('lupina_path_b').position
	local lahn_pos = user_party.Leader.Position

	local dist = self.is_bed_stair_open and 1 or 0

	local route = {}
	if lahn_pos.x > bed_pos.x + 1.6 then
		table.insert(route, bed_pos + vector(2 + dist, 0, -2))
		table.insert(route, bed_pos + vector(-1 + dist, 0, -2))
	else
		if lahn_pos.z > bed_pos.z + 0.6 then
			table.insert(route, bed_pos + vector(-1 + dist, 0, 1))
		elseif lahn_pos.x > bed_pos.x - 0.6 then
			table.insert(route, bed_pos + vector(-1 + dist, 0, -2))
		end
	end
	table.insert(route, bed_pos + vector(-1 + dist, 0, -1))
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party.Leader, route, 4, false, nil, nil, 'right')

	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'push', upper = true})
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'walk', scale = 0.5})

	if self.is_bed_stair_open then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(character_util.move_to_async, user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 2, nil))
		self:hide_bed_stair()
	else
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(character_util.move_to_async, user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 2, nil))
		self:reveal_bed_stair()
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
end

function local_class:call_add_ice(name, pos, fast)
	fast = lua_helper.get_or_default(fast, false)
	local virtual_obj = nil

	if #self.virtual_pool > 0 then
		virtual_obj = self.virtual_pool[1]
		table.remove(self.virtual_pool, 1)
	else
		virtual_obj = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
		message_system:Send(virtual_obj, CS.Oak.AddFieldObjectEvent.Create(virtual_obj))
	end
	virtual_obj.Position = pos
	virtual_obj.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1.1, 1, 1.1))
	virtual_obj.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
	virtual_obj.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.InField

	self.main_ice_cache[name] = {
		fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.red_ice_preset):Instantiate(pos),
		fo = virtual_obj
	}
	local anim = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.main_ice_cache[name].fx.transform,
			'fx'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state
	if fast then
		anim:SetAnimation(0, 'ice', false)
	else
		anim:SetAnimation(0, 'ice_start', false)
	end

	return self.main_ice_cache[name]
end

function local_class:call_remove_ice(name, immediate)
	local target = self.main_ice_cache[name]
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		if not immediate then
			local anim = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(target.fx.transform,
				'fx'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state
			anim:SetAnimation(0, 'ice_end', false)
			wait_for_sec(1.7)
		end
		table.insert(self.virtual_pool, target.fo)
		target.fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		target.fx:Dispose()
		target.fx = nil
		target.fo = nil
		self.main_ice_cache[name] = nil
	end))
end

		self.path_blockers[type] = {}
	end
	if self.path_blockers[type].fx ~= nil then
		self.path_blockers[type].fx:Dispose()
	end

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > progress then
		return
	end

	self.path_blockers[type] = {
		pos = field:GetMarker(self.path_blocker_name .. type).position,
		fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.red_ice_preset):Instantiate(
				field:GetMarker(self.path_blocker_name .. type).position),
		npc = get_character(self.path_blocker_name .. type)
	}
	self.path_blockers[type].anim = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.path_blockers[type].fx.transform,
			'fx'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state

	character_util.set_position(self.path_blockers[type].npc, self.path_blockers[type].pos)
	self.path_blockers[type].npc.ActiveState = active_state('infield')
	self.path_blockers[type].npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance

function local_class:toggle_path_blocker_routine(type, active, immediate)
	immediate = lua_helper.get_or_default(immediate, false)
	if type ~= 'a' and type ~= 'c' then
		return
	end
	if active then
		self:set_path_blocker(type)
	else
		if not immediate then
			self.path_blockers[type].anim:SetAnimation(0, 'ice_break', false)
			wait_for_sec(0.6)
		end
		character_util.set_position(self.path_blockers[type].npc, vector(999, 0, 999))
		self.path_blockers[type].fx:Dispose()
		self.path_blockers[type].npc.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIShowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIHideEvent))

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))


	for i, p in ipairs(self.projectile_pool) do
		p.object:Dispose()
	end

	self.projectile_pool = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.custom_atlas_obj) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.custom_atlas_obj)
	end
	self.custom_atlas_obj = nil

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	for k, v in pairs(self.main_ice_cache) do
		self:call_remove_ice(k, true)
	end

	self:blizzard_dispose()
	self.blizzard = nil
	self.fade.gradient = nil
	self.fade = nil

	if self.red_ice_effect_list then
		for i = 1, #self.red_ice_effect_list do
			local red_ice_effect = self.red_ice_effect_list[i]
			red_ice_effect:Dispose()
			self.red_ice_effect_list[i] = nil
		end

		self.red_ice_effect_list = nil
	end

	for key in pairs(self.preset) do
		self.preset[key] = nil
	end
	self.preset = nil

	if self.goods_room_items then
		for _, item in pairs(self.goods_room_items) do
			item:ConsumeComplete()
		end
		self.goods_room_items = nil
	end

	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

--region Blizzard

function local_class:turn_on_blizzard(value)
	while self.is_blizzard_changing do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	if not self.is_blizzard_active then
		self.is_blizzard_changing = true
		--- flag set
		self.is_blizzard_active = true

		--music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
		--- blizzard start
		self:blizzard_start()

		--stage.BuffManager:AddBuff(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
		--		user_party.Leader, self.blizzard_buff, 0, false, false)

		self.blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_blizzard_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = "event", player_priority = "player"
		})
		local fade_time = 0.3
		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

		local mult = lua_helper.get_or_default(value, 0.4)

		--- blizzard update
		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fade_time do
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fade_time, 0) * mult

			self:blizzard_update(progress)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self.is_blizzard_changing = false
	end
end

function local_class:turn_off_blizzard(force, immediate)
	while self.is_blizzard_changing do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	local cond = false
	immediate = lua_helper.get_or_default(immediate, false)
	if force then
		cond = true
	end
	if self.is_blizzard_active and cond then
		self.is_blizzard_changing = true
		--- flag set
		self.is_blizzard_active = false

		--music_player_util.play_stage_music( { state = 'field', mix = 2})
		--- blizzard inner param refresh
		self:blizzard_color_refresh()

		--stage.BuffManager:RemoveBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, user_party_leader, self.blizzard_buff)

		local fade_time = 1
		local wait_time = fade_time + 1.5
		if immediate then
			fade_time = 0.3
			wait_time = 0
		end

		--local remove_buff_time = 1.5
		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		--local remove_buff = false

		self.blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(fade_time)

		--- blizzard update
		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_time do
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max(1 - (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fade_time, 0) * 0.4

			self:blizzard_update(progress)

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			if unity_class.time.time - cur_time > fade_time and not force then
				break
			end
		end

		--- blizzard dispose
		self:blizzard_dispose()
		self.is_blizzard_changing = false
	end
end

--- blizzard 이펙트 셋업
function local_class:blizzard_start(args)
	if self.blizzard == nil or self.fade == nil then return end
	if self.blizzard.obj ~= nil or self.fade.obj ~= nil then return end

	local with_fade = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'with_fade', true)
	local alpha = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'alpha', -1)
	local custom_alpha = false

	if not float_util.almost_close_to(alpha, -1) then
		custom_alpha = true
	end

	local camera = stage_camera

	self.blizzard.obj = self.preset.blizzard:Instantiate(
			camera.Transform.position + vector(0, 5, 10), unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
	self.blizzard.material = self.blizzard.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
			typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer)).material

	self.blizzard.color = self.blizzard.material:GetColor(self.property_name)

	local target_alpha = custom_alpha and alpha or self.blizzard.color.a * 0.2

	self.blizzard.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
			{ self.blizzard.color.r, self.blizzard.color.g, self.blizzard.color.b, target_alpha }))

	if with_fade then
		self.fade.obj = self.preset.blizzard_fade:Instantiate(
				camera.Transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
		self.fade.main_module = self.fade.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
				typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem)).main
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color

		target_alpha = custom_alpha and alpha or self.fade.color.a * 0.2

		self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
				{ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, target_alpha })

		self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color
	end
end

function local_class:blizzard_lerp(from, to, duration)

	self.is_blizzard_changing = true
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local tint = from

	--- blizzard update
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / duration, 0)
		tint = from + (to - from) * progress

		self:blizzard_update(tint)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	self.is_blizzard_changing = false
end
function local_class:blizzard_update(alpha, fade_alpha)
	if fade_alpha == nil then
		fade_alpha = alpha
	end

	self.blizzard.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
			{ self.blizzard.color.r, self.blizzard.color.g, self.blizzard.color.b, alpha }))

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
				{ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, fade_alpha })

		self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
	end
end

function local_class:blizzard_fade_max()
	if self.fade.obj == nil then return end

	self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color({ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, 1 })

	self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
end

function local_class:blizzard_color_refresh()
	self.blizzard.color = self.blizzard.material:GetColor(self.property_name)

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color
	end
end

function local_class:setting_section13_ice()

	local marker = self.get_section13_ice_marker()

	section13_ice.Position = marker.position
	section13_ice.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(2, 1, 1))

	local offset_list = {

		vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
	}

	for i = 1, #offset_list do
		local offset = offset_list[i]
		local red_ice_effect = self.get_red_ice_effect():Instantiate(marker.position + offset)
		local animation = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(red_ice_effect.transform, 'fx'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state
		animation:SetAnimation(0, 'ice', false)

		table.insert(self.red_ice_effect_list, red_ice_effect)
	end
end

--- 눈보라 관련 이펙트 dispose
function local_class:blizzard_dispose()
	if self.blizzard.obj ~= nil then
		self.blizzard.material = nil
		self.blizzard.color = nil
		self.blizzard.obj:Dispose()
		self.blizzard.obj = nil
	end

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.main_module = nil
		self.fade.color = nil
		self.fade.obj:Dispose()
		self.fade.obj = nil
	end
end

	for k, npc in pairs(self.optimized_npcs) do
		local pos = field:GetMarker(k).position + vector(0, 1, -0.3)

		if string.find(k, 'super_star_') then

		elseif string.find(k, 'hanfu_') then

		elseif string.find(k, 'rudolph_') then

		else

			basic_lupina = true

		if string.find(k, '_1') then

		elseif string.find(k, '_3') then

		else
			dir = 'down'
		end

		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

			text.Label.alpha = (cur_time / transition)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		text.Label.alpha = 1

		while cur_time < transition do
			cur_time = cur_time + unity_class.time.unscaledDeltaTime
			text.Label.alpha = 1 - (cur_time / transition)

function local_class:power_of_word_call()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.power_of_word_routine, self))
end

function local_class:power_of_word_routine()
	local words = {}
	local offsets = {
		vector(0, 0.6, 1.2),
		vector(0, 0.6, -1.2),
		vector(1.2, 0.6, 0),
		vector(-1.2, 0.6, 0),
	}
	local a_offsets = {
		0.5,
		1.5,
		0,
		1
	}

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local word = self.effects_start[i]:Instantiate(self.lahn().Position + vector(0, 0.5, -0.1))
		table.insert(words, word)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_fox_ball_02')
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fx_move_to_async, self, word, self.lahn().Position + offsets[i], 0.25))
		wait_for_sec(0.4)
	end
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_magic_circle_emergency_01')

	local timer = 0

	while self.on_word_event do
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local x_pos = math.cos(math.pi * a_offsets[i] + timer * math.pi * 2) * 1.2
			local z_pos = math.sin(math.pi * a_offsets[i] + timer * math.pi * 2) * 1.2
			words[i].transform.position = self.lahn().Position + vector(x_pos, 0.6, z_pos - 0.1)
		end

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime * self.word_speed
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	timer = 0
	local duration = 1

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_flower_ball_03')
	while timer < duration do
		for i = 1, 4 do
			words[i].transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self:progress_lerp((duration - timer) / duration, 3)
		end

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 1, 4 do
		words[i].transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		words[i].transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		words[i]:Dispose()
	end

end

function local_class:fx_move_to_async(target, destination, duration)
	destination = destination + vector(0, 0, -0.1)
	local origin = target.transform.position
	local timer = 0

	while timer < duration do
		target.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(origin, destination, self:progress_lerp(timer / duration, 3))
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	target.transform.position = destination
end

function local_class:speed_lerp_call(target, duration, is_ease)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.speed_lerp, self, target, duration, is_ease))
end

function local_class:progress_ease_in(progress)
	return (1 - math.cos(progress * math.pi * 0.5))
end

function local_class:progress_ease_out(progress)
	return (math.sin(progress * math.pi * 0.5))
end

function local_class:progress_ease_in_out(progress)
	return (1 - math.cos(progress * math.pi)) / 2
end

function local_class:progress_lerp(progress, type)
	type = lua_helper.get_or_default(type, 3)
	if type == 1 then
		--ease in
		return (1 - math.cos(progress * math.pi * 0.5))
	elseif type == 2 then
		--ease out
		return (math.sin(progress * math.pi * 0.5))
	elseif type == 3 then
		--ease in and out
		return (1 - math.cos(progress * math.pi)) / 2
	end
	return progress
end

function local_class:speed_lerp(target, duration, is_ease)
	local origin = self.word_speed
	local gap = target - self.word_speed
	local timer = 0

	while timer < duration do
		local progress = timer / duration
		self.word_speed = origin + gap * (is_ease and self:progress_lerp(progress, 3) or progress)

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.word_speed = target
end


return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

	self.exit_teleport_names = { 'lower_cave_entrance_inner', 'lower_cave_entrance_outer', 'lower_cave_exit_outer'
	, 'lower_cave_exit_inner', 'upper_cave_entrance_inner', 'upper_cave_entrance_outer', 'upper_cave_exit_outer'
	, 'upper_cave_exit_inner' }

	for i = 1, #exit_names do
		local exit_fo = get_field_object(exit_names[i])
		table.insert(self.cached_exit, exit_fo.Interactable)
		exit_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		table.insert(self.exit_interact_fo, exit_fo)
	end

	self.marker_fo_list = { self.exit_interact_fo[3], garv, garv, self.exit_interact_fo[3]
	, self.exit_interact_fo[7], garv, garv, self.exit_interact_fo[7] }
end

-- ExitInteractable의 Interactable를 원복하는 함수
function local_class:restore_exit_interact_fo()
	if self.exit_interact_fo == nil then
		return
	end

	-- ExitInteractable -> ExitInteractable로 원복
	for i = 1, #self.exit_interact_fo do
		local exit_fo = self.exit_interact_fo[i]
		exit_fo.Interactable = self.cached_exit[i]
	end

	self.exit_interact_fo = nil
	self.marker_fo_list = nil
	self.cached_exit = nil
end

-- ExitInteractable 대신 이동해주는 루틴

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.teleport_party_for_marker
	, self, self.exit_teleport_names[index], self.marker_fo_list[index]))
end

-- ExitInteractable 대신 이동해주는 함수

	self:church_npcs_setting(self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 1)

	-- CS Controller 로 OnEvent 를 받을수 있다.
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	--Scene없는 퀘스트도 있음
	--self.scene = scene()

	self.starting_inner_progress = -1
	self.starting_grade = -1
	self.inter_section_params = {}

	self.is_stage_valid = function(stage_name)
		return (stage.Name == stage_name)
	end

	self.data_table = nil

	self.get_lina = function()
		if self.data_table == nil then
			return get_character('lina')
		end
		return self.data_table:get_lina()
	end
	self.get_goury = function()
		if self.data_table == nil then
			return get_character('goury')
		end
		return self.data_table:get_goury()
	end
	self.get_xellos = function()
		if self.data_table == nil then
			return get_character('xellos')
		end
		return self.data_table:get_xellos()
	end

	self.get_amelia = function() return get_character('amelia') end
	self.get_zelgadis = function() return get_character('zelgadis') end
	self.get_eva = function() return get_character('eva') end

	-- 메인 퀘스트 id
	self.main_quest_id = 7000801

	-- 에바가 합류했는지? (메인 퀘스트 섹션이 5(프로그래스4)이상 일 경우에는 합류한 것)
	self.is_join_eva = false

	self.village_buildings = {}
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
	-- pre story section 은 여기서 읽는다
	self.pre_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'ShortStoryLinaMansionPreSection')
end

function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'ShortStoryLinaMansionSection1'),
	}

	self.post_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'ShortStoryLinaMansionPostSection')
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	-- ObjectPool PreLoad가 필요할 때 뒤에 인자로 주르륵 넣는다
	-- ex) yield_return_func(quest_util.load_pool_resource,'bla1', 'bla2')
	--yield_return_func(quest_util.load_pool_resource,'')
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	self:update_join_eva()
end

function local_class:release_holdup(character)
	local breakable_obj = nil
	if character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		breakable_obj = character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		if breakable_obj ~= nil then
			character_util.release_hold_object(character, breakable_obj)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:cache_buildings()
	local zone = field:GetZone('mansion_destruction_zone')
	local move = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(zone.Bounds, move)

	for i = 0, list.Count - 1 do
		local v = list[i]
		if lua_helper.type_compare(v.CrashBehaviour, CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
			table.insert(self.village_buildings, v)
		end
	end

	list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:set_active_buildings(active)
	active = lua_helper.get_or_default(active, true)
	local state = active and active_state('enabled') or active_state('disabled')

	for _, v in ipairs(self.village_buildings) do
		v.ActiveState = state
	end
end

function local_class:update_join_eva()
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)
	if quest_progress ~= nil then
		local main_quest_inner_progress = quest_progress.InnerProgress
		self.is_join_eva = main_quest_inner_progress > 3
	end
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	if self.is_stage_valid('shortstory_sl_1') then
		-- 데이터 테이블 세팅
		self.data_table = get_or_create_global_table('stageeventcontrollers/ShortStoryLinaGold')
		self:cache_buildings()
	end

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.data_table = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}
