local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLinaPassportController')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = controller @
		QuestName = ShortStoryLinaPassport @
		Comment = ShortStoryLinaPassport 퀘스트/이벤트 @
]]

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	-- 아이템 스펙 이름
	self.passport_item_spec_name = 'travel_certificate'

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.rampart_enter_zone_name = 'rampart_enter'
	self.rampart_talk_zone_name = 'rampart_talk'

	-- 퀘스트 마커 이름
	self.quest_marker_name = 'short_story_lina_passport'

	-- 필요한 골드 금액
	self.need_gold_amount = 1000

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_lina = function() return user_party.Leader end
	self.get_guardian = function(num) return get_character('guardian_zaco_' .. num) end
	self.get_book_seller = function() return get_character('paper_seller') end
	self.get_desertelf_female = function() return get_character('travel_desertelf_female') end
	self.get_desertelf_male = function() return get_character('travel_desertelf_male') end
	self.get_blackcat = function() return get_character('blackcat') end

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_book_store = function() return get_field_object('paper_store_entrance') end

	-- 마커를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_paper_seller_item_marker = function(num) return field:GetMarker('paper_seller_item_' .. num) end

	self.is_see_rampart_talk_event = false

	self.item_list = nil

	self.blackcat_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	local blackcat = self.get_blackcat()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(blackcat, self)

	if self.item_list then
		for i = 1, #self.item_list do
			self.item_list[i]:ConsumeComplete()
			self.item_list[i] = nil
		end

		self.item_list = nil
	end

	if self.blackcat_sfx and self.blackcat_sfx.IsUsing then
		self.blackcat_sfx:Stop()
	end

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

-- pre story section 설정
function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
end

-- main section 설정
function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'ShortStoryLinaPassportSection1'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'ShortStoryLinaPassportSection2'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'ShortStoryLinaPassportSection3'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'ShortStoryLinaPassportSection4'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'ShortStoryLinaPassportSection5')
	}

	self.post_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'ShortStoryLinaPassportPostSection')
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	local blackcat = self.get_blackcat()
	character_util.add_listener(blackcat, self)
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:on_progress_section()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local consumed = false

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		consumed =  self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	if consumed then
		return true
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	local item_spec_name_list = {
		'travel_certificate',
		'adventurer_license2',
		'desert_prison_guard_passport',
		'hero_certification_8'
	}
	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')

	self.item_list = {}

	for i = 1, #item_spec_name_list do
		local marker = self.get_paper_seller_item_marker(i)
		local item_spec_name = item_spec_name_list[i]
		local item_id = item_data:GetSpec(item_spec_name).Id
		local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = marker.position, itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

		table.insert(self.item_list, item)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if not self.quest_progress.IsComplete and e.Zone.Name == self.rampart_enter_zone_name then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.passport_check, self)
				return true
			elseif not self.is_see_rampart_talk_event and e.Zone.Name == self.rampart_talk_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rampart_talk, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local blackcat = self.get_blackcat()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, blackcat) then
		if self.blackcat_sfx and self.blackcat_sfx.IsUsing then
			self.blackcat_sfx:Stop()
		end
		self.blackcat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_cat_meow_01', parent = blackcat, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:passport_check()
	local guardian_1 = self.get_guardian(1)
	local guardian_2 = self.get_guardian(2)

	-- 층 계단 앞을 막고 있는 가디언 2명 사이를 지나가려고 하면 존 엔터로 이벤트 발생, 파티는 가디언들 하단에 정렬.
	-- 가디언1 (down, attack 1회) : 정지. 캔터베리 성벽길은 신원이 확인된 사람만 통행할 수 있습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_costume_equip_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(guardian_1, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guardian_1, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_1', skip = true })

	party_util.align_party((guardian_1.Position + guardian_2.Position) / 2, 'down', 1, 'linear')

	-- 가디언2 (down, question) : 낯선 차림새인데… 여행객입니까?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(guardian_2, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guardian_2, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_2', skip = true })

	-- 가디언2 (down, idle) : 여행객이라면 여행 증명서 제출 후 통행이 가능합니다.
	character_util.remove_anim(guardian_2)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guardian_2, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_3', skip = true })

	-- 여행 증명서가 있다면 선택지 출력. (없으면 컨트롤 풀린 후 헌책방에 마커)
	-- progress가 1 이상이면 여행 증명서가 있음.
	if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 4 then
		-- 선택지
		-- 여행 증명서를 보여준다. / 그만 둔다.
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'short_story_lina_passport_3_1', 'mercy' }, { 'short_story_lina_passport_3_2', 'brutal' } })

		if choose_result == 1 then
			-- 여행 증명서를 보여준다.
			local lina = self.get_lina()

			-- 여행 증명서를 보여준다 선택 시, 리나가 eat 모션 후 여행 증명서 던지고, 가디언1이 eat 모션 후 습득.
			character_util.set_side_direction(lina)
			character_util.set_anim(lina, { name = 'eat' })

			character_util.set_direction(lina, 'up')
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(lina, { name = 'throw' })
			wait_for_sec(0.125)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_02')
			local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
			local item_id = item_data:GetSpec(self.passport_item_spec_name).Id
			local passport_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = lina.Position, target = guardian_1.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

			wait_for_sec(1)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_01')
			passport_item.ConsumeTarget = guardian_1
			character_util.set_direction(guardian_1, 'right')
			character_util.set_anim(guardian_1, { name = 'eat' })
			wait_for_sec(1)

			-- 가디언1 느낌표 버블 출력.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
			character_util.remove_anim(guardian_1)
			character_util.set_direction(guardian_1, 'down')
			character_util.show_emoticon_async(guardian_1, nil, 'notice')

			-- 가디언1 : 이건…!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guardian_1, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_4', skip = true })

			-- 리나 (left, tired)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.set_direction(lina, 'left')
			character_util.set_emotion(lina, { name = 'scared' })

			-- 가디언1 (down, idle) : 흐음. 여기저기 많이 다니셨군요.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guardian_1, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_5', skip = true })

			character_util.remove_emotion(lina)
			character_util.set_direction(lina, 'up')

		left = 1,
		up = 2,
		right = 3,
		down = 4,
		tap = 5,
	}

	self.qte_result = self.qte_enum.none
	self.tap_count = 0

	self.tower_name = 'magic_tower_obj_'

	--임시로 마력탑 대신에 npc들을 넣어둠

	}

end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	-- ObjectPool PreLoad가 필요할 때 뒤에 인자로 주르륵 넣는다
	-- ex) yield_return_func(quest_util.load_pool_resource,'bla1', 'bla2')
	--yield_return_func(quest_util.load_pool_resource,'')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		return false
	end
	if self.qte_target == self.qte_enum.tap then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
			self.qte_result = self.qte_enum.tap
			self.tap_count = self.tap_count + 1
			return true
		end
	elseif self.qte_target ~= self.qte_enum.none then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
			self.qte_result = self.qte_enum.left
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
			self.qte_result = self.qte_enum.up
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
			self.qte_result = self.qte_enum.right
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
			self.qte_result = self.qte_enum.down
			return true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	--임시로 마력탑 대신에 npc들을 넣어둠
	self.towers = {
		get_field_object(self.tower_name .. 1),
		get_field_object(self.tower_name .. 2),
		get_field_object(self.tower_name .. 3),
		get_field_object(self.tower_name .. 4),
		get_field_object(self.tower_name .. 5),
		get_field_object(self.tower_name .. 6),
		get_field_object(self.tower_name .. 7),
		get_field_object(self.tower_name .. 8),
	}

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		self:activate_tower(8)
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 0 then
			for i = 1, 7 do
				self:activate_tower(i)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:activate_tower(index)
	local pos = self.towers[index].Position
	local power = self.fx_power_on:Instantiate(pos + vector(0, 0.01, 0))
	table.insert(self.power_ons, power)
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	self.data_table = get_or_create_global_table('stageeventcontrollers/ShortStoryLinaGold')
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	for i, fx in ipairs(self.power_ons) do
		fx:Dispose()
	end
	self.power_ons = nil

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.data_table = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

--- 마력탑 점검 QTE 액티비티
--- @return boolean 성공 여부
function local_class:qte_event(type_str, scale, show_success, goal, time_limit)
	scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
	goal = lua_helper.get_or_default(goal, 12)
	time_limit = lua_helper.get_or_default(time_limit, 9999)
	show_success = lua_helper.get_or_default(show_success, false)

	self.qte_target = self.qte_enum[type_str]
	self.qte_result = self.qte_enum.none

	-- QTE 이벤트
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchControllerBlockAreaResetEvent.Create(false))

	if type_str == 'tap' then
		self.tap_count = 0
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.TurboTap(scale)

		while self.tap_count < goal do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	else
		if scale < 0 then
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(type_str)
		end

		while self.qte_result == self.qte_enum.none do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchControllerBlockAreaResetEvent.Create(true))

	local success = (self.qte_target == self.qte_result)

	self.qte_target = self.qte_enum.none
	self.qte_result = self.qte_enum.none

	return success
end


return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.back_street_tint_exit_zone_name then
				music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
				self.current_zone = self.zone_enum.none
				self:back_street_tint_change(unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0 }))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.back_street_tint_start_zone_name then
				if self.zone_enum.start ~= self.current_zone then
					self.current_zone = self.zone_enum.start

					if self.change_field_volume then
						music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.3)
					end

					if self.fade_sfx then
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
					end

					character_util.set_immortal(user_party.Leader, false)

					self:out_back_street()
					self:back_street_tint_change(unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0.390625 }))
				end
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.back_street_tint_deep_zone_name then
				if self.zone_enum.deep ~= self.current_zone then
					self.current_zone = self.zone_enum.deep

					music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0)
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')

					character_util.set_immortal(user_party.Leader, true)

					self:in_back_street()
					self:back_street_tint_change(unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0.78125 }))
				end
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:back_street_tint_change(color)
	if self.is_ignore_background_tint then
		return
	end

	if self.background_effect == nil then
		-- 뒷골목 암전 이펙트
		self.background_effect = self.get_background_effect_pool():Instantiate(stage_camera.transform.position + vector(0, 5, 0),
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.transform)
		self.background_effect.transform.localScale = vector(3, 1, 2)
	end

	local renderer = self.background_effect.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))

	-- tint 연출용 sharedMaterial을 새로 생성함.
	if self.background_effect_shared_material == nil then
		self.background_effect_shared_material = CS.UnityEngine.Material(renderer.sharedMaterial)
	end

	-- 원래 sharedMaterial은 백업해두고, tint 연출을 하기 위해 만든 sharedMaterial로 갈아끼워줌.
	self.background_effect_origin_shared_material = renderer.sharedMaterial
	renderer.sharedMaterial = self.background_effect_shared_material

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.back_street_tint_change_routine, self, color))
end

function local_class:back_street_tint_change_routine(color)
	self.back_street_tint_change_req_id = self.back_street_tint_change_req_id + 1

	local req_id = self.back_street_tint_change_req_id
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0.5

	local start_alpha = self.background_effect_color
	local end_alpha = color

	while time_passed < duration do
		if req_id ~= self.back_street_tint_change_req_id then
			return
		end

		local progress = time_passed / duration
		self.background_effect_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color.Lerp(start_alpha, end_alpha, progress)
		self.background_effect_shared_material:SetColor(self.color_prop_id, self.background_effect_color)

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	-- alpha가 0이라서 틴트가 완전히 밝아졌으면, 틴트에 사용하는 effect를 해제함.
	if color == unity_class.color.clear then
		if self.background_effect ~= nil then
			self.background_effect:Dispose()
			self.background_effect = nil
		end
	end
end

-- 뒷골목에 들어갔을 때
function local_class:in_back_street()
	if not self.is_in_back_street then
		self.is_in_back_street = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.back_street_routine, self))

		-- 뒷골목 가로등 이펙트
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 1 then
			for i = 1, self.lamp_count do
				local lamp_marker = self.get_lamp_marker(i)
				local lamp_effect = self.get_lamp_effect_pool():Instantiate(lamp_marker.position + self.lamp_effect_offset)

				table.insert(self.lamp_list, {
					effect = lamp_effect,
					position = lamp_effect.transform.position - self.lamp_effect_offset
				})
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 뒷골목에서 나왔을 때
function local_class:out_back_street()
	self.is_in_back_street = false
	self:stop_vampire_girl_timer(false)
	self.is_start_vampire_girl_timer = false

	if #self.lamp_list > 0 then
		for i = 1, #self.lamp_list do
			local lamp_effect = self.lamp_list[i].effect
			lamp_effect:Dispose()
		end

		self.lamp_list = {}
	end
end

-- 뒷골목에 들어왔을 때, 항시 작동하는 루틴
function local_class:back_street_routine()
	local prev_leader_position = nil
	local is_in_lamp_range = false

	while self.is_in_back_street do
		local leader_position = user_party.Leader.Position
		local lamp_range = 3

		if prev_leader_position ~= leader_position then
			is_in_lamp_range = false

			if #self.lamp_list > 0 then
				for i = 1, #self.lamp_list do
					local lamp_position = self.lamp_list[i].position
					local distance = (lamp_position - leader_position).magnitude

					if distance <= lamp_range then
						is_in_lamp_range = true
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end

		prev_leader_position = leader_position

		if not self.find_daughter and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			if not is_in_lamp_range then
				if not self.is_start_vampire_girl_timer then
					self:start_vampire_girl_timer()
				end
				self.is_start_vampire_girl_timer = true
			else
				self:stop_vampire_girl_timer(self.is_start_vampire_girl_timer)
				self.is_start_vampire_girl_timer = false
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:start_vampire_girl_timer()
	if not self.vampire_loop_sfx then
		self.vampire_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_vampire_warning_02', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	end

	character_util.show_attack_timer(user_party.Leader, 16.5)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.vampire_girl_routine, self))
end

function local_class:stop_vampire_girl_timer(is_show_speech_bubble)
	is_show_speech_bubble = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_show_speech_bubble, true)

	if self.vampire_loop_sfx then
		self.vampire_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.vampire_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	character_util.hide_attack_timer(user_party.Leader)

	self:stop_vampire_girl_routine()

	if is_show_speech_bubble then
		--칫…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(user_party.Leader, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_23_1', world_pos = user_party.Leader.Position })
	end
end

function local_class:vampire_girl_routine()
	self:stop_vampire_girl_routine()

	local req_id = self.vampire_girl_routine_req_id

	for i = 21, 23 do
		wait_for_sec(4.5)

		if req_id ~= self.vampire_girl_routine_req_id then
			return
		end

		-- 엄마… 어디있어요…?
		-- 으아앙! 누가 좀 도와주세요…!
		-- 엄마…! 엄마……! 히히……
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_disappear_03')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(user_party.Leader, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_' .. i, bubble_direction = 'none', offset = vector(0, 2, 0) })
	end

	wait_for_sec(3)

	-- 점프 상태일 때 연출 꼬이지 않도록 대기
	while lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if req_id ~= self.vampire_girl_routine_req_id then
		return
	end

	-- 카리나가 플레이어 덮치는 연출
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	if self.vampire_loop_sfx then
		self.vampire_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.vampire_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	self.fade_sfx = false

	local vampire_girl = self.get_vampire_girl()
	local party_last_member = user_party[user_party.Count - 1]

	character_util.set_active_state(vampire_girl, 'enabled')
	character_util.add_color(vampire_girl, 'tint', unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(vampire_girl, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(vampire_girl, party_last_member.Direction)
	vampire_girl.Position = party_last_member.Position - direction_util.to_vector3(party_last_member.Direction)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(vampire_girl, 1, 0.75)

	-- 카리나 (사방향, greed, cast) : 지금이다!
	character_util.set_emotion(vampire_girl, { name = 'greed' })
	character_util.set_anim(vampire_girl, { name = 'cast' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vampire_girl, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_24', skip = true })

	local deviate_angle = 0
	local vampire_girl_direction = direction_util.to_str(vampire_girl.Direction)
	if vampire_girl_direction == 'left' then
		deviate_angle = 30
	elseif vampire_girl_direction == 'right' then
		deviate_angle = -30
	end

	character_util.set_anim(vampire_girl, { name = 'bomb_attack' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(vampire_girl, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local_angle(vampire_girl, deviate_angle, 0.7, 0.2)
	character_util.move_to(vampire_girl, user_party.Leader.Position, 0.5, nil, true)

	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'scared' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'embarrassed' })
	party_util.jump(0.3, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dark_magician_01')

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	lua_helper.call_nullable(self.current_section, 'fail', self.current_section)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(vampire_girl)
	character_util.remove_color(vampire_girl, 'tint', 0)
	character_util.set_active_state(vampire_girl, 'disabled')

	local lina = self.get_lina()
	local gourry = self.get_gourry()
	local xellos = self.get_xellos()

	local reset_position_marker = self.get_reset_position_marker()
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'confused' })
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.set_emotion(xellos, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.remove_anim(xellos)
	party_util.position_party(reset_position_marker.position, reset_position_marker.direction, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()

		-- 제로스가 아닐 경우에만 데미지
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(party_member, xellos) then
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
			damage_info.sender = vampire_girl
			damage_info.target = party_member
			damage_info.damage = party_member.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 0.05
			damage_info.notMortal = true

			command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 리나 right, tired, cross-arm. 가우리 left, confused, prostrate. 제로스 left, idle, idle.
	-- 중앙에서 가우리 바라보는 느낌으로. 이후 가우리, 리나 대사 순서대로 출력되도록 부탁드립이다. 이건 모든 게임오버 동일하도록 연출 변경 부탁드립니다.

	-- 리나 (left, confused, prostrate) : 우으… 뭐야 도대체…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lina, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_fail_1', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	-- mario_jump로 모두 일제히 기상.
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]

		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(party_member, xellos) then
			character_util.set_emotion(party_member, { name = 'tired' })
			character_util.mario_jump_new(party_member, party_member.Direction, 0.3, 0.5)
		end
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 가우리 : ....윽...빈혈이..
	character_util.look_at(lina, gourry)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fat_gnome_03')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gourry, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_fail_2', skip = true })

	-- 리나: "지금 건 대체..."
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lina, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_fail_3', skip = true })

	self.fade_sfx = true

	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

	self.vampire_girl_routine_req_id = self.vampire_girl_routine_req_id + 1
end

		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	-- 섹션 3을 지나오지 않았으면
	if self.quest_progress == nil or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 2 then
		self.current_tesla_state = self.tesla_state.none
	end

	if self.quest_progress == nil or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 3 then
		self.current_belt_state = self.belt_state.none
		self.current_flame_state = self.flame_state.none

		local jump_pad = get_field_object('home_alone_jump_pad')
		jump_pad.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	self:cache_and_disable_belts()
	self:preset_flame_thrower_infos()

	-- 컨베이어벨트 출구 처리
	local belt_exit_zone_bounds = field:GetZone('home_alone_belt_move_8').Bounds
	local wall = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
	wall.Name = 'home_alone_belt_exit_blocker_1'
	wall.Position = vector(belt_exit_zone_bounds.max.x + 0.05, 0, belt_exit_zone_bounds.center.z)
	wall.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.1, 1, 5))
	wall.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
	wall.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
	wall.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	message_system:Send(field, CS.Oak.AddFieldObjectEvent.Create(wall))

	local belt_wall = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
	belt_wall.Name = 'home_alone_belt_exit_blocker_2'
	belt_wall.Position = vector(belt_exit_zone_bounds.max.x + 0.25, 0, belt_exit_zone_bounds.center.z)
	belt_wall.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 1, 1))
	belt_wall.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
	belt_wall.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
	belt_wall.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	message_system:Send(field, CS.Oak.AddFieldObjectEvent.Create(belt_wall))
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.trap_room_zone_name) then
		character_util.set_immortal(get_party_leader(), true)
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

		if self.quest_progress == nil or not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			field:Tint(self.room_tint_key, unity_color({0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1}), 0)
			field:Darken(self.room_darken_key, 0.4, 0)
			self.current_room_darken_mag = 0.4
		end

		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.room_bgm_zone_name) then
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 1 and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress <= 3 then
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'event', name = 'bgm_chasing'})
			else
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted'})
			end

			return true
		end

		return true
	end

	local dir_str = self.belt_zone_infos[e.Zone.Name]
	if dir_str ~= nil and self.belt_check_target_dict[e.FieldObject] ~= nil then
		self:try_add_belt_target_move(e.FieldObject, dir_str)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.trap_room_zone_name) then
		character_util.set_immortal(get_party_leader(), false)
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

		if self.quest_progress == nil or not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			field:RemoveTint(self.room_tint_key, 0)
			field:Undarken(self.room_darken_key, 0)
			self.current_room_darken_mag = 0
		end

		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.room_bgm_zone_name) then
		if music_player.StageBgmState ~= CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field'})
		end

		return true
	end

	if e.FullLeave then
		local dir_str = self.belt_zone_infos[e.Zone.Name]
		if dir_str ~= nil then
			self:try_remove_belt_target_move(e.FieldObject, dir_str)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.spike_grid_name) and self.in_spike_room == false then
		self.in_spike_room = true
		self:enter_spike_room()
		return true

	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.belt_grid_name) then
		self:enter_belt_grid()

		if not self.in_flame_room then
			self.in_flame_room = true
			self:start_flame_routine()
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.spike_grid_name) and self.in_spike_room then
		self.in_spike_room = false
		self:leave_spike_room()
		return true

	elseif type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.belt_grid_name) then
		self:leave_belt_grid()

		if self.in_flame_room then
			self.in_flame_room = false
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, leader)
			and (e.Info.type & CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap) ~= CS.Oak.DamageType.None then
		if self.in_spike_room then
			if leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HP <= 1 and self.is_spike_dead == false then
				self.is_spike_dead = true
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.reset_spike_dead, self)
				return true

			elseif not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, leader) then
				-- 가시블록 데미지인 경우
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
				damage_info.sender = leader
				damage_info.target = leader
				-- 기본 배율이 0.05이어서 0.2로 맞춰줌
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
						* (0.2 - CS.Oak.ConstantsData.Value.GimmickSpikeDamage:GetDecrypted()))
				command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
				return true
			end

		elseif self.in_flame_room then
			if leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HP <= 1 and self.is_flame_dead == false then
				self.is_flame_dead = true
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.flame_leader_dead_scene, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:remove_room_darken_routine(duration)
	self.room_darken_req_id = self.room_darken_req_id + 1
	local req_id = self.room_darken_req_id
	local start_mag = self.current_room_darken_mag
	local target_mag = 0
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration and req_id == self.room_darken_req_id and self.stage_exited == false do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		self.current_room_darken_mag = start_mag * (1 - progress) + target_mag * progress
		field:Darken(self.room_darken_key, self.current_room_darken_mag, 0)

		-- 그리드 이동 시에도 정상 동작하도록 UnscaledTime 사용
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.unscaledDeltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 정상적으로 끝난 경우
	if req_id == self.room_darken_req_id and self.stage_exited == false then
		self.current_room_darken_mag = target_mag
		field:Undarken(self.room_darken_key, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:enter_spike_room()
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_light_turn_off_01')

	--FIXME : 코루틴 한개로 합치기
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.add_spike_darken_routine, self, 0.5))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.remove_room_darken_routine, self, 0.5))

	self:start_tesla_onoff()
end

-- 가시블록 방 나가는 처리
function local_class:leave_spike_room()
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		return
	end

	--FIXME : 코루틴 한개로 합치기
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.remove_spike_darken_routine, self, 0.5))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.add_room_darken_routine, self, 0.5))
end

-- 가시블록에 일정 이상 데미지 받은 경우 리셋 처리
function local_class:reset_spike_dead()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	leader.ActiveState = active_state('visible')

	character_util.set_side_direction(leader)

	character_util.set_emotion(leader, {name = 'damaged'})
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader,
			{name = 'dead', keep_anim = true, sfx = '01_hit_npc_01'})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = nil
	heal_info.target = leader
	heal_info.heal = leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.skipEffect = true
	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

	party_util.position_party(self.get_marker_pos('spike_align'), 'left', 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	leader.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	self.is_spike_dead = false
end

function local_class:start_tesla_onoff(force_start)
	-- 섹션 2에서 강제로 켜주기 위해 조건 추가
	if self.current_tesla_state == self.tesla_state.idle or force_start then
		self.current_tesla_state = self.tesla_state.in_routine
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.tesla_onoff_routine, self))
	end
end

-- 테슬라 코일 On/Off되는 루틴
function local_class:tesla_onoff_routine()
	local time_passed = 0
	while self.in_spike_room and self.stage_exited == false do
		time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < 2 and self.in_spike_room and self.stage_exited == false do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if self.in_spike_room == false or self.stage_exited then
			break
		end

		self:tesla_turn_on()
		self:remove_spike_darken_routine(0.65)

		time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < 2 and self.in_spike_room and self.stage_exited == false do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if self.in_spike_room == false or self.stage_exited then
			break
		end

		self:tesla_turn_off()
		self:add_spike_darken_routine(0.65)
	end

	-- 방을 완전히 나간 시점이므로 테슬라 코일 꺼줌
	self:tesla_turn_off(true)
	self.current_tesla_state = self.tesla_state.idle
end

function local_class:tesla_turn_on()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_light_turn_on_01')

	for i = 1, self.tesla_power_source_count do
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent.Create(self.tesla_power_source_name .. i))
	end
end

function local_class:tesla_turn_off(not_play_sfx)
	if not not_play_sfx then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_light_turn_off_01')
	end

	for i = 1, self.tesla_power_source_count do
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOffEvent.Create(self.tesla_power_source_name .. i))
	end
end

function local_class:cache_and_disable_belts()
	if #self.belt_fo_infos > 0 then
		return
	end

	local check_bounds = field:GetZone(self.belt_zone_name).Bounds
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(check_bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]

		if string.sub(fo.Name, 1, 13) == '[gimmick]belt' then
			local animator = fo:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
			animator.speed = self.belt_speed * 2.5 / 3
			animator:Play('xmas_belt_rolling')
			animator.enabled = false
			fo.ActiveState = active_state('visible')

			table.insert(self.belt_fo_infos, {
				fo = fo,
				animator = animator,
			})
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:enter_belt_grid()
	-- 진입 체크할 파티원들 캐싱
	self.belt_check_target_dict = {}
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local info = {}

		info.default_spine_offset = user_party[i].SpineController.SpineOffset

		-- 캐릭터 스탯 ui 세팅
		local stat_ui = field_ui_manager:GetUIByKey(
				CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, user_party[i])
		if stat_ui ~= nil then
			info.stat_ui = stat_ui
			info.default_ui_offset = stat_ui.Offset.localPosition
		end

		self.belt_check_target_dict[user_party[i]] = info
	end

	if self.current_belt_state == self.belt_state.idle then
		self.current_belt_state = self.belt_state.animating
		self:activate_belt_anim()
	end
end

function local_class:leave_belt_grid()
	if self.current_belt_state == self.belt_state.animating then
		self.current_belt_state = self.belt_state.idle
		self:deactivate_belt_anim()
	end
end

function local_class:activate_belt_anim()
	for i = 1, #self.belt_fo_infos do
		local info = self.belt_fo_infos[i]
		info.animator.enabled = true
	end
end

function local_class:deactivate_belt_anim()
	for i = 1, #self.belt_fo_infos do
		local info = self.belt_fo_infos[i]
		info.animator.enabled = false
	end
end

function local_class:belt_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	self.flame_damage_cooldown = 0

	self:play_belt_loop_sfx()

	while self.belt_move_target_count > 0 and self.stage_exited == false do
		local delta_time = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local move_magnitude = self.belt_speed * delta_time

		local exited_fos = nil

		for fo, _ in pairs(self.belt_move_target_infos) do
			local info = self.belt_move_target_infos[fo]

			if not lua_helper.type_compare(fo.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState)) then
				-- 만약 남은 시간이 있는 경우 일단 강제로 오프셋 맞춰줌
				if info.remain_offset_time > 0 then
					-- 나가고 있는 경우 마이너스 배율
					if info.is_jumping_out then
						self:diff_belt_target_offset(fo,
								-self.belt_spine_offset * info.remain_offset_time / self.belt_jump_offset_dur)
					else
						self:diff_belt_target_offset(fo,
								self.belt_spine_offset * info.remain_offset_time / self.belt_jump_offset_dur)
					end

					info.remain_offset_time = 0
				end

				-- 나가고 있었던 경우 (컨베이어 벨트 위에 있지 않을 때)
				if info.zone_count == 0 then
					-- 오프셋 강제로 원복시켜줌
					local offset_info = self.belt_check_target_dict[fo]

					fo.SpineController.SpineOffset = offset_info.default_spine_offset

					if offset_info.stat_ui ~= nil then
						offset_info.stat_ui.Offset.localPosition = offset_info.default_ui_offset
					end

					if exited_fos == nil then
						exited_fos = {
							fo
						}
					else
						table.insert(exited_fos, fo)
					end
				else
					local offset_info = self.belt_check_target_dict[fo]

					fo.SpineController.SpineOffset = offset_info.default_spine_offset + self.belt_spine_offset

					if offset_info.stat_ui ~= nil then
						offset_info.stat_ui.Offset.localPosition = offset_info.default_ui_offset + self.belt_spine_offset
					end

					-- 대각선 이동이 벽에 막히는 경우가 있어서 x z 방향 두 개로 나눠서 움직이도록 세팅
					if not float_util.is_almost_zero(info.move_dir.x) then
						-- 해당 루틴을 도는 타겟이 많아봐야 2명이기 때문에 일단은 버그 없도록 MoveOneFrameStageLogic 사용
						CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(fo,
								vector(info.move_dir.x, 0, 0), move_magnitude)
					end

					if not float_util.is_almost_zero(info.move_dir.z) then
						-- 해당 루틴을 도는 타겟이 많아봐야 2명이기 때문에 일단은 버그 없도록 MoveOneFrameStageLogic 사용
						CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(fo,
								vector(0, 0, info.move_dir.z), move_magnitude)
					end
				end

			elseif info.remain_offset_time > 0 then		-- 현재 오프셋 조정 중인 경우
				-- 나가고 있는 경우 마이너스 배율
				if info.is_jumping_out then
					self:diff_belt_target_offset(fo, -self.belt_spine_offset
							* math.min(delta_time, info.remain_offset_time) / self.belt_jump_offset_dur)
				else
					self:diff_belt_target_offset(fo, self.belt_spine_offset
							* math.min(delta_time, info.remain_offset_time) / self.belt_jump_offset_dur)
				end

				info.remain_offset_time = info.remain_offset_time - delta_time
			end
		end

		-- 현재 나간 것으로 처리된 애들은 움직일 목록에서 제외시킴
		if exited_fos ~= nil then
			for i = 1, #exited_fos do
				self.belt_move_target_infos[exited_fos[i]] = nil

				-- 현재 움직여줄 타겟들 개수도 동기화
				self.belt_move_target_count = self.belt_move_target_count - 1
			end
		end

		-- 화염 방사기에 닿았는지 여부를 체크할 때 Zone Enter/Leave 내의 로직과 프레임단위로 바운드를 도는 것이 코스트가 비슷함
		-- 벨트 위에 있으면 포지션 변경이 매 프레임마다 무조건적으로 일어나기 때문
		-- 따라서 이벤트 구역의 개수를 최대한 줄이도록 해서 이 퀘스트를 진행하지 않을 때의 이벤트 구역 계산 코스트를 최대한 줄임

		if self.flame_damage_cooldown > 0 then
			self.flame_damage_cooldown = self.flame_damage_cooldown - delta_time
		end

		-- 컨베이어 벨트에 있을 때만 확인하도록 하기 위해서 flame_routine에서 체크하지 않고 여기서 함
		if self.current_flame_state == self.flame_state.throwing
				and self.flame_damage_cooldown <= 0 and not self.is_flame_dead then
			for i = 1, #self.flame_check_bounds do
				if self:aabb(leader.Bounds, self.flame_check_bounds[i]) then
					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
					damage_info.sender = leader
					damage_info.target = leader
					damage_info.damage = math.floor(leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 0.2)
					command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

					self.flame_damage_cooldown = self.flame_damage_cooltime

					break
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self:stop_belt_loop_sfx(0.5)

	self.current_belt_state = self.belt_state.animating
end

function local_class:try_add_belt_target_move(target, dir_str)
	local dir_info = self.belt_direction_infos[dir_str]

	if dir_info.fo_dict[target] == nil then
		-- 해당 방향 진입 처리
		dir_info.fo_dict[target] = true

		local target_info = self.belt_move_target_infos[target]

		if target_info == nil then
			self.belt_move_target_infos[target] = {
				zone_count = 1,
				move_dir = dir_info.move_dir,
				-- 점프로 들어온 경우는 따로 산정함
				remain_offset_time = 0,
				-- 점프로 나가고 있는 경우
				is_jumping_out = false,
			}

			if lua_helper.type_compare(target.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState,
					typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState)) then
				self.belt_move_target_infos[target].remain_offset_time = self.belt_jump_offset_dur
			end

			-- 현재 움직여줄 타겟들 개수도 동기화
			self.belt_move_target_count = self.belt_move_target_count + 1

			if self.belt_move_target_count == 1 then
				-- 그림자 꺼버림
				target.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false

				-- 타겟이 처음 들어왔고, 루틴이 돌고있지 않은 경우 루틴 시작
				if self.current_belt_state == self.belt_state.animating then
					self.current_belt_state = self.belt_state.on_routine
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.belt_routine, self))
				end
			end
		else
			target_info.move_dir = target_info.move_dir + dir_info.move_dir

			target_info.zone_count = target_info.zone_count + 1
		end
	end
end

function local_class:try_remove_belt_target_move(target, dir_str)
	local dir_info = self.belt_direction_infos[dir_str]

	if dir_info.fo_dict[target] ~= nil then
		dir_info.fo_dict[target] = nil

		local target_info = self.belt_move_target_infos[target]

		if target_info ~= nil and not target_info.is_jumping_out then
			-- 모든 구역을 빠져나온 경우
			if target_info.zone_count == 1 then
				-- 그림자 다시 켜줌
				target.SpineController.IsShadowActive = true

				-- 점프해서 나가는 경우
				if lua_helper.type_compare(target.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState,
						typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState)) then
					target_info.is_jumping_out = true
					target_info.remain_offset_time = self.belt_jump_offset_dur
					target_info.zone_count = 0
				else
					-- 화염 방사기에 맞아 데미지를 입은 경우 리셋할 때 등
					-- 오프셋 다시 원복
					self:diff_belt_target_offset(target, - self.belt_spine_offset)
					self.belt_move_target_infos[target] = nil

					-- 현재 움직여줄 타겟들 개수도 동기화
					self.belt_move_target_count = self.belt_move_target_count - 1
				end
			else
				target_info.move_dir = target_info.move_dir - dir_info.move_dir

				target_info.zone_count = target_info.zone_count - 1
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:diff_belt_target_offset(target, diff)

	-- 캐릭터 스탯 ui 세팅
	local stat_ui = self.belt_check_target_dict[target].stat_ui
	if stat_ui ~= nil then
		stat_ui.Offset.localPosition = stat_ui.Offset.localPosition + diff
	end
end

--region 화염방사기 시스템

-- 화염방사기 이펙트 출력 및 화염방사기 바운드 체크에 필요한 정보들 미리 세팅
function local_class:preset_flame_thrower_infos()
	local is_processed_dict = {}
	local marker_list = {}
	-- 실제 불 이펙트와 판정이 다소 어긋나있기에 오프셋을 부여함
	local updown_bound_offset = vector(0, 0, -0.7)

	for i = 1, self.flame_thrower_count do
		local marker = field:GetMarker('home_alone_flame_' .. i)
		local thrower_info = {}

		-- 이펙트 출력 위치와 방향 정보 세팅
		if marker.direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
			thrower_info.effect_rot = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
			thrower_info.effect_pos = marker.position + vector(0, 0, 0.75 + 0.35 - 2)
			thrower_info.sfx_pos = marker.position + vector(0, 1, -1)
		elseif marker.direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
			thrower_info.effect_rot = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)
			thrower_info.effect_pos = marker.position + vector(0.75 - 2, 0, 0.25)
			thrower_info.sfx_pos = marker.position + vector(-1, 1, 0)
		elseif marker.direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
			thrower_info.effect_rot = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0)
			thrower_info.effect_pos = marker.position + vector(0, 0, -0.35 + 2)
			thrower_info.sfx_pos = marker.position + vector(0, 1, 1)
		else
			thrower_info.effect_rot = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 270, 0)
			thrower_info.effect_pos = marker.position + vector(0.75 + 0.5, 0, 0.25 - 0.35)
			thrower_info.sfx_pos = marker.position + vector(1, 1, 0)
		end

		self.flame_thrower_infos[i] = thrower_info

		is_processed_dict[i] = false
		marker_list[i] = marker
	end

	-- 여러칸짜리 바운드 처리
	for _, targets in pairs(self.flame_bounds_mix_targets) do
		local marker_pos_sum = unity_class.vector3.zero

		for i = 1, #targets do
			marker_pos_sum = marker_pos_sum + marker_list[targets[i]].position

			-- 이미 처리된 것으로 세팅
			is_processed_dict[targets[i]] = true
		end

		-- y값이 의미는 없지만 일단 0.5 기준인 것으로 맞춰줌
		local bounds_center = vector_util.get_x0z(marker_pos_sum / #targets, 0.5)

		-- 첫번째 마커에서 현재 중심점까지의 수치를 가지고 방향 체크할 것임
		local diff_from_first = marker_list[targets[1]].position - bounds_center

		-- 좌우 방향인지 상하 방향인지 체크
		if math.abs(diff_from_first.x) < math.abs(diff_from_first.z) then
			table.insert(self.flame_check_bounds,
					CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(bounds_center + updown_bound_offset,
							vector(1, 1, #targets)))
		else
			table.insert(self.flame_check_bounds,
					CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(bounds_center, vector(#targets, 1, 1)))
		end
	end

	-- 한 칸짜리 바운드도 처리
	for i = 1, self.flame_thrower_count do
		if not is_processed_dict[i] then
			local center_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(marker_list[i].position, 0.5)

			if (marker_list[i].direction & CS.Oak.Direction.Side) ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
				center_pos = center_pos + updown_bound_offset
			end

			table.insert(self.flame_check_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center_pos, unity_class.vector3.one))

			is_processed_dict[i] = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start_flame_routine(force_start)
	if self.current_flame_state == self.flame_state.idle or force_start then
		self.current_flame_state = self.flame_state.on_routine
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.flame_routine, self))
	end
end

function local_class:flame_routine()
	while self.in_flame_room and self.stage_exited == false do
		wait_for_sec(2.5)

		if not self.in_flame_room or self.stage_exited then
			break
		end

		self.current_flame_state = self.flame_state.throwing
		self:throw_flame_effects()
		wait_for_sec(2.3)

		self.current_flame_state = self.flame_state.on_routine
	end

	self.current_flame_state = self.flame_state.idle
end

-- 섹션 3에서 따로 연출용으로 불러주기 위해 이펙트 출력만 함수로 빼줌
function local_class:throw_flame_effects()
	local fx_pool = self.get_fx_flamethrower()

	for i = 1, self.flame_thrower_count do
		local info = self.flame_thrower_infos[i]
		fx_pool:Instantiate(info.effect_pos, info.effect_rot, nil)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_fire_explosion_02', play_pos = info.sfx_pos,
									type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'object'})
	end
end

function local_class:flame_leader_dead_scene()
	local fire_effects = {}

	-- 불이 붙는다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_dash_fire_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_catch_fire_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		-- 오프셋이 올라가 있기 때문에 이펙트 위치를 파티원 위치로 잡아도 될듯
		local fire_effect = self.get_fx_fire():Instantiate(user_party[i].Position,
				unity_class.quaternion.identity, user_party[i].Transform)
		fire_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5

		table.insert(fire_effects, fire_effect)

		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], {name = 'hurt'})
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = 'embarrassed'})

		character_util.normal_jump(user_party[i], i == 0)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	party_util.position_party(self.get_marker_pos('belt_align'), 'down', 'linear')

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = nil
	heal_info.target = get_party_leader()
	heal_info.heal = get_party_leader().FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.skipEffect = true
	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

	for _, fire_effect in pairs(fire_effects) do
		fire_effect:Dispose()
	end

	self:stop_belt_loop_sfx(0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	self.is_flame_dead = false
end

function local_class:aabb(a, b)
	return a.min.x <= b.max.x and a.max.x >= b.min.x
			and a.min.z <= b.max.z and a.max.z >= b.min.z
end

--- xmas_tree_big_center에 있는 별 불빛 키고 끄는 함수 (기본 불 켜진 상태, async 형태)
---@param turn_on boolean 불 킬 것인지 끌 것인지 정하는 플래그
---@param duration number 불 키고 끄는데 걸리는 시간
---@param star_num number 불을 키고 끌 별의 개수 (기본 트리 꼭대기에 있는 별 3개)
function local_class:change_xmas_start_glow(turn_on, duration, star_num)
	local dur = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 1)
	local num = lua_helper.get_or_default(star_num, 3)
	local cur_color
	local target_color
	local time_passed = 0

	if turn_on then
		cur_color = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 })
		target_color =  unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 })
	else
		cur_color = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 })
		target_color =  unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 })
	end

	if dur == 0 then
		for i = 1, num do
			local star = get_field_object('display_xmas_star_' .. i)
			if star == nil then
				break
			end

			local renderer = star:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
			renderer.material.color = target_color
		end
	else
		while time_passed <= dur do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / dur)
			local color = CS.UnityEngine.Color.Lerp(cur_color, target_color, progress)

			for i = 1, num do
				local star = get_field_object('display_xmas_star_' .. i)
				if star == nil then
					break
				end

				local renderer = star:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
				renderer.material.color = color
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:twinkle_effect_on()
	if self.twinkle == nil then
		local tree_pos = self.center_tree().Position
		self.twinkle = {}
		for i = 1, #self.twinkle_pos do
			local effect = self.get_twinkle_effect():Instantiate(tree_pos + self.twinkle_pos[i])
			effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)
			table.insert(self.twinkle, effect)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:twinkle_effect_off()
	if self.twinkle ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.twinkle do
			self.twinkle[i]:Dispose()
		end
		self.twinkle = nil
	end
end

function local_class:set_bloom_threshold(threshold, duration)
	local timer = 0
	local start_threshold = self.bloom_max.Threshold

	while timer < duration and not self.is_exit_stage do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		self.bloom_max.Threshold = start_threshold + (threshold - start_threshold) * (timer / duration)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if not self.is_exit_stage then
		self.bloom_max.Threshold = threshold
	end
end

-- 해당 함수를 통해 메인 퀘스트 마커를 생성하면 실내에 들어갔을 때 자동으로 꺼주도록 관리
function local_class:add_quest_marker(key, fo)
	if self.quest_marker_keys[key] == nil then
		self.quest_marker_keys[key] = fo
	end

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(key, self.quest_progress.QuestId, true, fo)
end

function local_class:remove_quest_marker(key)
	if self.quest_marker_keys[key] ~= nil then
		self.quest_marker_keys[key] = nil
	end

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(key)
end

-- 실내에 들어가면 모든 마커 건물 출구로 지정하는 함수
function local_class:markers_point_exit(target_fo)
	for k, _ in pairs(self.quest_marker_keys) do
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(k)
	end
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('inner', self.quest_progress.QuestId, true, target_fo)
end

-- 밖으로 나가면 모든 마커 켜는 함수
function local_class:activate_all_markers(next_target_fo)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('inner')

	if next_target_fo == nil then
		for k, v in pairs(self.quest_marker_keys) do
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(k, self.quest_progress.QuestId, true, v)
		end
	else
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('inner', self.quest_progress.QuestId, true, next_target_fo)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self:twinkle_effect_off()

	if stage_camera ~= nil and self.bloom_max ~= nil then
		self.bloom_max.Threshold = self.start_bloom_effect_threshold
		self.bloom_max = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil

	self.quest_id = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.sections = nil

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end
}

function local_class:flying_snowball()
	local snowball = get_field_object(self.snowball_name)
	local wood_dummy = get_field_object(self.catapult_wood_name)

	-- 점프 타일 발동 사운드
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_jumptile_01')

	-- 점프 타일 애니메이션 실행
	local jump_tile = get_field_object(self.jump_tile_name)
	local jump_tile_animator = jump_tile:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	jump_tile_animator.speed = 1.5
	jump_tile_animator:Play('on')

	-- 날아가는 눈덩이
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 2
	local start_pos = snowball.Position
	local end_pos = wood_dummy.Bounds.center
	local height = 5

	-- NOTE: 기믹 구조가 바뀌면 같이 바뀌어야 함 ([gimmick]snowball)
	local snowball_main = snowball.transform:Find('scale/snowball')
	local shadow = snowball.transform:Find('scale/shadow (1)')
	local origin_rot = snowball_main.rotation
	if shadow ~= nil then
		shadow.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	-- 카메라 이동을 실행했는지 체크
	local camera_active = false

	-- 날아가는 동안 사운드
	local blizzard_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_01', loop = true })

	-- 눈덩이 크기 모자른지 체크
	local snowball_too_small = snowball.Transform.localScale.x < 1.8

	stage.StageCamera:SetTarget(snowball)

	-- 눈덩이 날아가는 사운드
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed > 0.2 and not camera_active then
			camera_active = true
			camera_util.move(wood_dummy.Bounds.center, duration - 0.1)
		end

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

		snowball_main.rotation =
		unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-360 * 4 * progress, unity_class.vector3.right) * origin_rot

		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height

		if cur_y <= 0 then cur_y = 0 end

		snowball.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress) + cur_y * unity_class.vector3.up

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	blizzard_sound:Stop()

	-- 점프 타일 애니메이션 되돌리기
	jump_tile_animator:Play('off')

	-- 바위 파괴
	if not snowball_too_small then
		local destroy_wood_effect_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_xmas_snow_smokescreen')
		destroy_wood_effect_pool:Instantiate(wood_dummy.Bounds.center)
		wood_dummy.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	end

	-- 눈덩이 터짐
	local snowball_effect_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_monster_snowball_hit')
	local snowball_effect = snowball_effect_pool:Instantiate(snowball.Position)
	snowball_effect.transform.localScale = 2.5 * unity_class.vector3.one
	snowball.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	stage.StageCamera:SetTarget(nil)

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	if snowball_too_small then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(
				get_party_leader(), { key = self.event_script..80, skip = false })
	else
		self.current_step = self.quest_step.snowball_puzzle_end

		local crow = get_character('crow')
		character_util.set_position(crow, vector(999,0,999))
	end
end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	--- 눈보라 preset
	local blizzard_preset_name = "FX_Blizzard"
	--- 눈보라 페이드 preset
	local fade_preset_name = "FX_Screen_Blizzard_Cloud"

	-- scene find routine
	self.scene:setting()

	--- fx preload
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_preset)

	local qp = self.quest_progress

	-- preset load
	if qp == nil or not qp.IsComplete then
		self.preset.blizzard = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(blizzard_preset_name)
		self.preset.blizzard_fade = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(fade_preset_name)

		-- particle system 조정에 쓰일 gradient 생성
		-- stage 진행 중 생성할 경우 끊기는 현상이 발생해, 미리 생성
		self.fade.gradient = CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem.MinMaxGradient(unity_class.color.black)

		local object_pool_extensions = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions

		-- 이펙트 로드 대기
		while not object_pool_extensions.IsLoaded(self.preset.blizzard) or
			not object_pool_extensions.IsLoaded(self.preset.blizzard_fade) do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	if qp == nil then return end

	local progress = qp.InnerProgress

	if stage.Name == self.stage_1 and progress == 0
		or stage.Name == self.stage_2 and 1 <= progress and progress < 12 then

		if stage.Name == self.stage_2 then
			if progress >= 1 and progress <= 9 then
				-- 설인 장군 시체 UI 비활성화
				local corpse = get_character("corpse_general")
				stage.FieldUIManager:RemoveUI(corpse, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
				corpse.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(3.5, 1.5, 2))
				corpse.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
			end

			if progress ~= 1 and progress <= 9 then
				self.scene:setting_crime_scene()
			end

			if progress == 2 or progress == 10 then
				self.scene:setting_court()
			end

			-- 회상 씬에서만 사용하는 덤불 설정
			if progress ~= 2 then
				local bush = get_field_object("remind_bush")
				bush.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			end

			-- 코코 마녀 각성 씬을 위한 이펙트
			if progress == 10 then
				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_break_red_ice")
				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("fx_red_ice")
				--unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_reward")
			end
		end

		if self.scene['setting_' .. (progress + 1)] ~= nil and not qp.IsComplete then
			self.scene['setting_' .. (progress + 1)](self.scene)
		end
	end

	-- 왕자 이벤트 보았는지 체크하기 위해 ZoneEnterEvent를 Subscribe한다.

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	local qp = self.quest_progress

	if qp == nil then return end

	local progress = qp.InnerProgress

	if stage.Name == self.stage_1 then
		local character = get_character('event_3_ice_snowman_1')
		character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance

		for index = 1, 10 do
			character = get_character('event_2_ice_snowman_' .. index)
			character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end

		if progress > 0 then
			local victim = get_character('event_3_innuit_1')
			local attacker_1 = get_character('event_3_snowman_1')
			local attacker_2 = get_character('event_3_snowman_2')

			character_util.set_direction(victim, 'right')
			character_util.set_direction(attacker_2, 'right')
			character_util.set_emotion(attacker_1, { name = 'mad' })
			character_util.set_emotion(attacker_2, { name = 'attack' })

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.attack_scene, self, victim, attacker_1, attacker_2, false))
		end
	end

	if stage.Name == self.stage_3 and progress >= 5 then
		local snowman_girl_name = 'snowman_girl'

		local snowman_girl = get_character(snowman_girl_name)
		local marker = stage.Field:GetMarker(snowman_girl_name)

		character_util.set_position(snowman_girl, marker.position, false)
		character_util.set_direction(snowman_girl, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(snowman_girl, { name = 'ice' })

		snowman_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	-- 문 처리
	-- 스테이지 로드가 끝났을 때 현재 메인 퀘스트 상태에 따라 스테이지 진행의 핵심 문을 열고 닫아줌
	-- 네트워크 문제로 섹션이 넘어갔는데 문이 열리거나 닫힐 경우가 있으므로 이하의 처리를 실행함
	if stage.Name == self.stage_2 then
		if progress > 3 then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create("prison_door_1"))

			for index = 1, 2 do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create("crime_scene_door_right_" .. index))

				if progress ~= 11 or qp.IsComplete then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create("crime_scene_door_lower_" .. index))
				end
			end
		else
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create("prison_door_1"))

			for index = 1, 2 do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create("crime_scene_door_right_" .. index))
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create("crime_scene_door_lower_" .. index))
			end
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.stage_3 then
		if progress > 4 then
			for index = 1, 3 do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create("town_door_" .. index))
			end
		else
			for index = 1, 3 do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create("town_door_" .. index))
			end
		end

		if progress >= 5 then
			for index = 1, 2 do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create("boss_door_right_" .. index))
			end
		else
			for index = 1, 2 do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create("boss_door_right_" .. index))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:blizzard_start(args)
	if self.blizzard == nil or self.fade == nil then return end
	if self.blizzard.obj ~= nil or self.fade.obj ~= nil then return end

	local with_fade = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'with_fade', true)
	local alpha = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'alpha', -1)
	local custom_alpha = false

	if not float_util.almost_close_to(alpha, -1) then
		custom_alpha = true
	end

	local camera = stage_camera


	self.blizzard.obj = self.preset.blizzard:Instantiate(
		camera.Transform.position + vector(0, 5, 10), unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
	self.blizzard.material = self.blizzard.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
		typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer)).material

	self.blizzard.color = self.blizzard.material:GetColor(self.property_name)

	local target_alpha = custom_alpha and alpha or self.blizzard.color.a * 0.2

	self.blizzard.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
		{ self.blizzard.color.r, self.blizzard.color.g, self.blizzard.color.b, target_alpha }))

	if with_fade then
		self.fade.obj = self.preset.blizzard_fade:Instantiate(
			camera.Transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
		self.fade.main_module = self.fade.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
			typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem)).main
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color

		target_alpha = custom_alpha and alpha or self.fade.color.a * 0.2

		self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
			{ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, target_alpha })

		self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color
	end
end

function local_class:blizzard_update(alpha, fade_alpha)
	if fade_alpha == nil then
		fade_alpha = alpha
	end

	self.blizzard.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
		{ self.blizzard.color.r, self.blizzard.color.g, self.blizzard.color.b, alpha }))

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
			{ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, fade_alpha })

		self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
	end
end

function local_class:camera_move(target_pos, duration, interpolations, end_target)
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(duration) then
		camera_util.move(target_pos, 0, { ignorecameragrids = true, end_target = end_target })
		return
	end

	duration = duration * 1.5

	local start_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition
	start_pos.y = target_pos.y
	local time_passed = 0
	local progress = 0
	local diff = target_pos - start_pos

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		progress = interpolations(unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration), 0, 1, 1)

		camera_util.move(start_pos + progress * diff, 0, { ignorecameragrids = true })

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if end_target ~= nil then
		camera_util.move(target_pos, 0,
				{ ignorecameragrids = true, end_target = end_target })
	end
end

function local_class:camera_effect(delay)
	if delay == nil then
		delay = 0
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(delay))

	stage_camera:Shake(0.2, 0.25)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.075, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in(0.075, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
end

--[[
	반복해서 이누이트를 구타하는 설인들
]]
function local_class:attack_scene(victim, attacker_1, attacker_2, set_anim)
	while true do
		if not set_anim then
			set_anim = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.scene_set_victim, self, victim))
		end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.scene_victim_reaction, self, attacker_1, victim, set_anim))

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.8))

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.scene_victim_reaction, self, attacker_2, victim, set_anim))

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.8))
	end
end

--[[
	맞는 이누이트들의 리액션
]]
function local_class:scene_victim_reaction(attacker, victim)
	local offset = (attacker.Bounds.center - victim.Bounds.center).x > 0 and -1 or 1

	local hit_preset = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_preset)
	local sfx_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	sfx_info.sfxName = self.hit_sfx
	sfx_info.playPosition = victim.Bounds.center

	if hit_preset == nil then
		return
	end

	attacker.SpineController:DeviateLocal(vector(0.5 * offset, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.set_anim(attacker, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
	hit_preset:Instantiate(victim.Bounds.center)

	character_util.remove_anim(attacker)

	victim:Shake(0.04, 0.2)
	victim.SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
	victim.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
	victim.SpineController:DeviateLocal(vector(0.5 * offset, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
end

function local_class:scene_set_victim(victim)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	character_util.set_anim(victim, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.set_emotion(victim, { name = 'damaged' })
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end

function local_class:discovered(event_name, detector)
    field_ui_manager:Hide()
    user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

    music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "03_dialogue_negative_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

    character_util.jump(detector, 0.5, 0.3)
    character_util.set_anim(detector, { name = "release", sfx_name = "01_swing_01" })
    character_util.set_emotion(detector, { name = "mad" })

    for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
        character_util.jump(user_party[i], 0.5, 0.3)
        character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = "embarrassed" })
        character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = "scared" })
    end

    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(detector, { key = "snowmountain_main_additional_discovered", skip = true })

    screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

    coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

    message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(detector, { "reset", event_name }))

    local marker = CS.Oak.MarkerInfo()

    if event_name == self.normal_reset then
        marker = field:GetMarker(self.reset_marker_name)
    elseif event_name == self.cave_reset then
        marker = field:GetMarker(self.cave_reset_marker_name)
    end

    local marker_dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetOpposite(marker.direction)
    local marker_tovector = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(marker_dir)
    local constants = CS.Oak.Constants

    for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
        character_util.set_position(user_party[i], marker.position + marker_tovector * constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers * i)
        character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], marker.direction)
        user_party[i]:RemoveAnimation()
        user_party[i]:RemoveEmotion()
    end

    if self.is_coco_follow_player then
        character_util.set_position(self.coco, marker.position + marker_tovector * constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers * (user_party.Count))
        character_util.set_direction(self.coco, marker.direction)

        -- 코코가 플레이어 따라오도록 PartyFollowerNPCState로 설정
        local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(self.coco, user_party, 0, 0, false)
        self.coco:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
    end

    detector:RemoveAnimation()
    detector:RemoveEmotion()

    coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

    self.is_discovered = false

    screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

    coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

    field_ui_manager:Show()
    user_party:ResetControllers()
end

   coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_snowbox_position_event, self))

-- 얼음 박스의 위치를 코코의 위치에 맞춰주는 실제 이벤트
function local_class:set_snowbox_position_event()
    -- 코코의 1프레임 전 위치와 방향 저장
    local coco_past_position
    local coco_past_direction

    while self.is_coco_follow_player do
        self.coco_snowbox.Position = self.coco.Position

        -- 코코의 Direction은 잠겨있으므로 이전 위치와 현 위치의 차를 계산해서 방향을 구한다
        if coco_past_position ~= nil then
            -- 코코의 1프레임 전 위치와 현재 위치 확인해서 방향 변경되었는지 확인
            local cur_dir = (self.coco.Position - coco_past_position):ToDirection()

            if cur_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
                cur_dir = coco_past_direction
            end

            if cur_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
                self.coco.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 180)
                self.coco.SpineController.Transform:GetChild(1).localPosition = vector(0, -0.5, -0.5)
            elseif cur_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
                self.coco.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
                self.coco.SpineController.Transform:GetChild(1).localPosition = vector(0, 0.2, 1)
            elseif cur_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
                self.coco.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -90)
                self.coco.SpineController.Transform:GetChild(1).localPosition = vector(-0.2, 0.5, 0)
            elseif cur_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
                self.coco.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 90)
                self.coco.SpineController.Transform:GetChild(1).localPosition = vector(0, 0.5, 0.2)
            end

            coco_past_direction = cur_dir
        end

        coco_past_position = self.coco.Position

        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end
end

-- 얼음 박스 위치를 더이상 코코의 위치에 맞추지 않는다

    self.is_coco_follow_player = false

--- 눈보라 이펙트 셋업
function local_class:blizzard_start(args)
    if self.blizzard == nil or self.fade == nil then return end
    if self.blizzard.obj ~= nil or self.fade.obj ~= nil then return end

    local with_fade = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'with_fade', true)
    local alpha = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'alpha', -1)
    local custom_alpha = false

    if not float_util.almost_close_to(alpha, -1) then
        custom_alpha = true
    end

    local camera = stage_camera

    self.blizzard.obj = self.preset.blizzard:Instantiate(
            camera.Transform.position + vector(0, 5, 10), unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
    self.blizzard.material = self.blizzard.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
            typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer)).material

    self.blizzard.color = self.blizzard.material:GetColor(self.property_name)

    local target_alpha = custom_alpha and alpha or self.blizzard.color.a * 0.2

    self.blizzard.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
            { self.blizzard.color.r, self.blizzard.color.g, self.blizzard.color.b, target_alpha }))

    if with_fade then
        self.fade.obj = self.preset.blizzard_fade:Instantiate(
                camera.Transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
        self.fade.main_module = self.fade.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
                typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem)).main
        self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color

        target_alpha = custom_alpha and alpha or self.fade.color.a * 0.2

        self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
                { self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, target_alpha })

        self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
        self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color
    end
end

-- 눈보라 이펙트 알파값 업데이트
function local_class:blizzard_update(alpha, fade_alpha)
    if fade_alpha == nil then
        fade_alpha = alpha
    end

    self.blizzard.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
            { self.blizzard.color.r, self.blizzard.color.g, self.blizzard.color.b, alpha }))

    if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
        self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
                { self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, fade_alpha })

        self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
    end
end

-- 눈보라 완전히 사라지게 설정
function local_class:blizzard_fade_max()
    if self.fade.obj == nil then return end

    self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color({ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, 1 })

    self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
end

-- 눈보라 Material Color 원래 값으로 복구
function local_class:blizzard_color_refresh()
    self.blizzard.color = self.blizzard.material:GetColor(self.property_name)

    if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
        self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color
    end
end

--- 눈보라 관련 이펙트 dispose
function local_class:blizzard_dispose()
    if self.blizzard.obj ~= nil then
        self.blizzard.material = nil
        self.blizzard.color = nil
        self.blizzard.obj:Dispose()
        self.blizzard.obj = nil
    end

    if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
        self.fade.main_module = nil
        self.fade.color = nil
        self.fade.obj:Dispose()
        self.fade.obj = nil
    end
end

-- 카메라 이동 연출
function local_class:camera_move(target_pos, duration, interpolations, end_target)
    if float_util.is_almost_zero(duration) then
        camera_util.move(target_pos, 0, { ignorecameragrids = true, end_target = end_target })
        return
    end

    duration = duration * 1.5

    local start_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition
    start_pos.y = target_pos.y
    local time_passed = 0
    local progress = 0
    local diff = target_pos - start_pos

    while time_passed < duration do
        time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

        progress = interpolations(unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration), 0, 1, 1)

        camera_util.move(start_pos + progress * diff, 0, { ignorecameragrids = true })

        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    if end_target ~= nil then
        camera_util.move(target_pos, 0,
                { ignorecameragrids = true, end_target = end_target })
    end
end

-- 카메라 강조 이펙트 연출
function local_class:camera_effect(delay)
    if delay == nil then
        delay = 0
    end

    coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(delay))

    stage_camera:Shake(0.2, 0.25)

    screen_util.fade_out_async(0.075, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
    screen_util.fade_in(0.075, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
end

return {
    create = function(quest_id, cs_controller)
        return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
    end
}

		for i, power in ipairs(powers) do

			self.gladiators_power[gladiator] = power
		end

		for i = 1, 68 do
			table.insert(self.audience, get_character('audience_' .. i))
		end

				quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(gladiator)
				gladiator.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

		elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 2 then

	for _, audience in ipairs(self.audience) do

	if self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.execute_store_key2) == -1 then

		nero.Position = vector(7, 0, 61)

		if self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.nero_action_store_key) == 1 then

function local_class:audience_booing(throwers, target, throw_count, is_execution, override_key_name)
	local talks = is_execution and { 'colosseum_audience_booing', 'colosseum_audience_booing_2', 'colosseum_audience_booing_3' }
			or { 'colosseum_audience_booing' }

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_booing_text, self, talks, override_key_name))

	for _ = 1, throw_count do
		local thrower = throwers[random_util.get_random_int(1, #throwers)]
		local item_name = self.booing_items[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.booing_items)]
		local item_id = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetByName(item_name).Id
		local target_pos = vector_util.get_random_point_in_circle(target.Position)
		local junk = drop_item_util.create_item({ itemid = item_id, pos = thrower.Position, target = target_pos, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
		junk.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.throw_junk, self, junk, thrower, target))

function local_class:throw_junk(junk, thrower, target)
	character_util.look_at(thrower, target)
	thrower:SetEmotion('mad', true)
	character_util.set_anim(thrower, { name = 'bomb_attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if target ~= nil and (junk.Position - target.Position).magnitude <= 0.25 then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(target.Position)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(target)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(target)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)
	lua_helper.call_interface(junk, 'System.IDisposable', 'Dispose')
end
