function local_class:audience_booing_to_near(point, throw_audience, override_key_name)
	-- 우우우우!! | 사형!! 사형!! | 죽여라!!!!
	local talks ={ 'colosseum_audience_booing', 'colosseum_audience_booing_2', 'colosseum_audience_booing_3' }
	local throw_routine = function()

		local range = 2

			local item_name = self.booing_items[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.booing_items)]
			local item_id = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetByName(item_name).Id

function local_class:get_battle1_gladiator()

	return self.gladiators[idx]

function local_class:get_last_gladiator()
	local executed_gladiator = self:get_battle1_gladiator()
	local strongest
	for _, gladiator in ipairs(self.gladiators) do
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(gladiator, executed_gladiator) then
			if strongest == nil or self.gladiators_power[strongest] < self.gladiators_power[gladiator] then
				strongest = gladiator
			end
		end
	end

	return strongest
end

function local_class:setting_second_waiting_room()
	local switch = get_field_object('execution_switch')
	switch.Position = unity_class.vector3.one * 999

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local block = get_field_object('execute_block_' .. i)
		block.Position = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	end

	local executioner = get_character('executioner')
	executioner.Position = unity_class.vector3.one * 999

	local last_gladiator = self:get_last_gladiator()

	local gladiators_soldier_key_table = {
		trash = 'trash_soldier_oneline',
		trash_2 = 'trash_soldier_oneline_alt',
		chicken = 'chicken_soldier_oneline',
		chicken_2 = 'chicken_soldier_oneline_alt_1',
		cockroach = 'cockroach_soldier_oneline',
		cockroach_2 = 'cockroach_soldier_oneline_alt_1',
	}

	for _, gladiator in ipairs(self.gladiators) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(gladiator, last_gladiator) then
			gladiator.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
			gladiator:SetEmotion('scared', true)
			gladiator:SetAnimation('seat', true)

			gladiator:Shake(0.05, 99999)
			quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(gladiator)
			gladiator.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
		else
			local signboard = get_field_object(gladiator.Name .. '_signboard')
			signboard.Interactable.Message = 'kanterbury_' .. gladiator.Name .. '_dead'

			local soldiers = {
				get_character(gladiator.Name .. '_soldier_' .. 1),
				get_character(gladiator.Name .. '_soldier_' .. 2)
			}
			for _, soldier in ipairs(soldiers) do
				soldier:SetEmotion('smile', true)
				soldier:SetAnimation('success', true)
			end

			soldiers[1].Interactable.Talk = gladiators_soldier_key_table[gladiator.Name]
			soldiers[2].Interactable.Talk = gladiators_soldier_key_table[gladiator.Name .. '_2']

			gladiator.Position = signboard.Position + unity_class.vector3.left
			gladiator.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
			gladiator:RemoveEmotion()
			gladiator:RemoveAnimation()
			gladiator.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end

	local soldier_1 = get_character('soldier_1')
	soldier_1.Position = vector(21, 0, 12)
	soldier_1.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
	soldier_1.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)

	soldier_2.Position = soldier_1.Position + unity_class.vector3.back
	soldier_2.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.Shake(block1.Transform, 0.05, 1),
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.Shake(block2.Transform, 0.05, 1),
	})

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_wallimpact'):Instantiate(executed.Position)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(executed.Position)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(executed)
	executed.SpineController:Scale(vector(0, 1, 1), 0.125)

		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_to_async, block2, block2.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 1.1, 0.125),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local gladiators_key_table = {
				trash = 'colosseum_execution_scream_1',
				chicken = 'colosseum_execution_scream_1_alt_1',
				cockroach = 'colosseum_execution_scream_1_alt_2',
				nero = 'colosseum_execution_scream_1',
			}

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(executed, {key = gladiators_key_table[executed.Name], bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true})
			end)})

function local_class:audience_watch_battle()
	local center = vector(1.5, 0, 54.5)
	local animations = {
		'success',
		'attack',
		'release',
		'clap'
	}
	for _, audience in ipairs(self.audience) do
		local pick = random_util.get_random_int(1, #animations)
		audience:RemoveEmotion()
		audience:RemoveAnimation()
		audience.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(center - audience.Position)
		audience:SetEmotion('smile', true)
		character_util.set_anim(audience, {name = animations[pick], mix_duration = 0})
	end
end

function local_class:get_audience_near_target(target, dist)
	local ret = {}

	local target_pos = lua_helper.type_compare(target, unity_class.vector3) and target or target.Position
	for _, audience in ipairs(self.audience) do
		local diff = (target_pos - audience.Position).magnitude
		if diff <= dist then
			table.insert(ret, audience)
		end
	end

	return ret
end

function local_class:on_progress_section()
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, _)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end
}

end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()

end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	self:toggle_doggy_interact(false)

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then

		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

function local_class:toggle_doggy_interact(is_enabled)
	local doggy = self.get_doggy()
	if not type_util.is_npc_interactable(doggy) then return end

	if is_enabled then
		doggy.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
	else
		doggy.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end
end

function local_class:toggle_doggy_follow(is_enabled)
	local doggy = self.get_doggy()

	if is_enabled then
		local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(doggy, user_party, 0, 0, false)
		doggy:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
		doggy.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self:toggle_doggy_interact(false)
		doggy.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	else
		character_util.stop(doggy)
		doggy.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
		doggy.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		doggy.Interactable.Talk = 'steampunk_doggy_28'
	end
end

function local_class:is_doggy_follow()
	return lua_helper.type_compare(self.get_doggy().FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
		CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState)
end

function local_class:section_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'doggy_soldier_blocking' then
			self.is_seen_blocking_soldier = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.try_reach_treasure, self)

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'doggy_soldier_frightening_1' or e.Zone.Name == 'doggy_soldier_frightening_2' then
			if self.is_seen_blocking_soldier and not self.is_seen_frightened_soldier
				and not self:is_doggy_follow() then
				self.is_seen_frightened_soldier = true

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.frightened_soldier, self)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:try_reach_treasure()
	local soldier = self.get_soldier()

	if not self:is_doggy_follow() then
		local origin_soldier_pos = soldier.Position
		local soldier_pos = vector(soldier.Position.x, 1, user_party.Leader.Position.z)

		party_util.set_direction('left')

		if not (origin_soldier_pos - soldier_pos):IsAlmostZero() then
			wp_util.move_way_points_async(soldier, {waypoints = soldier_pos, speed = 4})
		end

		character_util.set_direction(soldier, 'right')

		character_util.set_anim(soldier, {name = 'attack_stab', loop = false, scale = 0.5, remove_after = 0.5})

		wait_for_sec(0.27)

		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_big_01')
		local effect = self.get_fx_hit_me():Instantiate(user_party_leader.Position + vector(-0.1, 0, 0))
		effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2

		-- 파티원들 뒤로 밀어냄
		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
				'physics', true, vector(1, 0, 0), 10000, 0.05,
				CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

			local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(user_party[i], knock_back_info)
			user_party[i].FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

			user_party[i].SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
			user_party[i].SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
		end

		party_util.set_emotion({name = 'hurt'})
		party_util.set_anim({ name = 'damaged' })

		wait_for_sec(0.6)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_hit_npc_01')
		party_util.set_emotion({name = 'hurt'})
		party_util.set_anim({ name = 'prostrate' })

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			character_util.shake(user_party[i], 0.05, 1)
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')
		party_util.remove_emotion()
		party_util.remove_animation()

		character_util.align_party(soldier, 'right', 1, 'linear')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--Left, attack, release, “어딜 들어가려고!”, idle.
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		character_util.set_anim(soldier, {name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
		character_util.set_emotion(soldier, {name = 'attack'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier, {key = 'steampunk_doggy_1', skip = true})
		character_util.remove_anim(soldier)

		--플레이어, attack, release 2회.
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'attack'})
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

		--Left, attack, idle, “하! 아무리 매섭게 노려봐도 소용 없다!”
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier, {key = 'steampunk_doggy_2', skip = true})

		--Left, attack, cast2, “이 몸은 무서운 게 없는 남자 중의 남자!”
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.set_anim(soldier, {name = 'cast2', loop = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier, {key = 'steampunk_doggy_3', skip = true})

		--Left, attack, jingak, “날 비키게 할 순 없을 거다!”, 살짝 셰이크.
		character_util.set_anim(soldier, {name = 'jingak', loop = false, remove_after = 1, sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_01'})
		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(function()
				wait_for_sec(0.7)
				camera_util.shake(0.08, 0.2)
				wait_for_sec(0.3)
			end),
			util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, soldier, {key = 'steampunk_doggy_4', skip = true})
		})

		-- 개만 빼고....
		character_util.remove_emotion(soldier)
		character_util.set_direction(soldier, 'left')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier, {key = 'steampunk_doggy_4_2', skip = true})

		if not (origin_soldier_pos - soldier.Position):IsAlmostZero() then
			wp_util.move_way_points_async(soldier, {waypoints = origin_soldier_pos, speed = 3})
		end

		character_util.set_direction(soldier, 'right')

	else
		local doggy = self.get_doggy()

		--플레이어 파티, 제국병 오른쪽에 정렬.
		--character_util.align_party(soldier, 'right', 1, 'linear')
		self:custom_align_party(soldier, 'right')

		character_util.set_anim(soldier, {name = 'cross_arm', loop = true})
		character_util.set_emotion(soldier, {name = 'attack'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier, {key = 'steampunk_doggy_11', skip = true})

		--강아지, 제국병 가까이 다가가 victory
		local wp = {
			doggy.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.7),
			vector(soldier.Position.x + 1, 1, doggy.Position.z - 0.7)
		}

		wp_util.move_way_points_async(doggy, {waypoints = wp, speed = 3})

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_pet_ordinary_01')
		character_util.set_anim(doggy, {name = 'victory', loop = false})
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
		character_util.set_emotion(soldier, {name = 'surprise'})

		wait_for_sec(1.3)

		character_util.remove_anim(doggy)

		--제국병, surprise, 점프 후 idle, “윽, 저, 저건!”
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(soldier, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier, {key = 'steampunk_doggy_12', skip = true})

		--제국병, scared, 덜덜 떨며, “개, 개는 나보다 약하다개는나보다약하다개는나보다…”
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(soldier, {name = 'surprise'})
		character_util.shake(soldier, 0.04, 99)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier,
			{key = 'steampunk_doggy_13', skip = true})
		character_util.stop_shake(soldier)

		--제국병, scared, 외침 “으아아아아!”
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		character_util.set_anim(soldier, {name = 'embarrassed', loop = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier,
			{key = 'steampunk_doggy_14', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})

		--제국병, 언덕 아래로 뛰어넘어 도망간다.
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_jump_01')
		character_util.jump(soldier, 1, 0.5)
		wp_util.move_way_points(soldier,
			{waypoints = soldier.Position + vector(0, -1, -7), speed = 6, run = true})

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		self:toggle_doggy_follow(false)

		-- 강아지, 제국병을 따라간다.
		wp_util.move_way_points_async(doggy,
			{waypoints = doggy.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), speed = 6, run = true})
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_small_jump_01')
		character_util.jump(doggy, 1, 0.5)
		wp_util.move_way_points_async(doggy,
			{waypoints = doggy.Position + vector(0, -1, -7), speed = 6, run = true})

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
		character_util.set_active_state(soldier, 'disabled')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(doggy)
		character_util.set_active_state(doggy, 'disabled')

		--이벤트 종료.
		yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self, 0)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(doggy, { 'doggy_follwer_end' }))
	end
end

function local_class:frightened_soldier()
	local soldier = self.get_soldier()

	camera_util.move_async(soldier.Position, 1)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(soldier, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.jump(soldier, 0.5, 0.3)

	-- 멍멍!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_pet_bark_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.get_doggy(),
		{key = 'steampunk_doggy_5', world_pos = soldier.Position + vector(3, 0, 1),
		 bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true, scale = 1.2})

	--제국병, surprise, “개, 개 짖는 소리?”
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier, {key = 'steampunk_doggy_6', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)

	--제국병, scared, 덜덜 떨며 “근처에 개가 있는 건… 아니겠지…?”
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.shake(soldier, 0.04, 99)
	character_util.set_emotion(soldier, {name = 'scared'})

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.set_direction(soldier, 'left')
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			character_util.set_direction(soldier, 'right')
		end),

		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, soldier,
			{key = 'steampunk_doggy_7', skip = true})
	})
	character_util.stop_shake(soldier)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)

	--제국병, attack, 떨기를 멈추고, “크흠! 아무렴 어때!”
	character_util.set_emotion(soldier, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier, {key = 'steampunk_doggy_8', skip = true})

	--제국병, attack, cast2, “개는 나보다 약하다! 그럼그럼!”
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim(soldier, {name = 'cast2', loop = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier, {key = 'steampunk_doggy_9', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)

	--카메라 원상복구, 제국병은 다시 left, idle 상태로 전환.
	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 1, {end_target = user_party.Leader})

-- 강아지를 찾았을 때
function local_class:talk_with_doggy()
	local doggy = self.get_doggy()

	--강아지 옆으로 파티 정렬
	party_util.align_to_target(doggy.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0), 'left', 1, 'arc')

	character_util.normal_jump_async(doggy, true)

	--주인공이 말걸면 밖으로 나와서 벌벌 떠는데 주인공이 쓰다듬어주면 꼬리를 흔들며 따라오기 시작함.
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_pet_hurt_01')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(doggy, doggy.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 1, false, nil, nil, 'left')

	--플레이어, 강아지 보고 sing
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(user_party.Leader,
		{waypoints = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0), speed = 1})

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'sing', loop = true})
	party_util.set_emotion({name = 'smile'})

	wait_for_sec(1.3)

	--선택지 : 머리를 쓰다듬는다.
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'steampunk_doggy_10', 'mercy' } })

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(user_party.Leader,
		{waypoints = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0.7, 0, 0), speed = 1})

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'shoot', scale = 0.5 })

	wait_for_sec(1.3)
	character_util.remove_emotion(doggy)
	character_util.stop_shake(doggy)
	wait_for_sec(1.3)

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(user_party.Leader,
		{waypoints = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), speed = 1, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right})
	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, 'none')

	--강아지, victory 하며 하트 이모티콘
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_pet_ordinary_01')
	character_util.set_anim(doggy, {name = 'victory', loop = true, remove_after = 2.3})
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(doggy, nil, 'heart')

	--플레이어파티 , victory_get
	party_util.set_anim({name = 'victory_get', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_stage_intro_jump_01'})

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.remove_emotion()

	--이후 강아지, 파티를 따라다닌다.
	self:toggle_doggy_follow(true)
end

-- linear하게 정렬(following 중인 npc도 정렬)
function local_class:custom_align_party(target, dir_str)
	local doggy_align_pos
	local dif = (1.5 + user_party.Count * 0.7) * vector(1, 0, 0)
	local doggy_last_dir

	if dir_str == 'left' then
		doggy_align_pos = target.Position - dif
		doggy_last_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	else
		doggy_align_pos = target.Position + dif
		doggy_last_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	end

	self:toggle_doggy_follow(false)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.align_party, target, dir_str, 1, 'linear'),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_way_points_async, self.get_doggy(),
			{waypoints = doggy_align_pos, speed = 3, ymode = 'floor', last_direction = doggy_last_dir})
	})
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end
}

function local_class:setting_section()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadBossTitle()

	if stage.Name == self.stage_1_name and self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 0 and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 5 then
			self:deactivate_party()
		end

		-- 순찰하는 제국병 비활성화
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress ~= 1 then
			for i = 1, self.patrol_soldier_num do
				character_util.set_active_state(get_character(self.patrol_soldier_name..i), "disabled")
			end
		end

		-- 비밀 통로 막고 있는 쓰레기 비활성화
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 2 then
			get_field_object(self.past_scrap_name).ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		end

		-- 쓰레기통에 숨는 방의 쓰레기 비활성화
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 3 then
			get_field_object(self.scrap_name_1).ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			get_field_object(self.scrap_name_2).ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		end

		-- 런 퍼즐 1 이벤트 문 설정
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 2 then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.kid_door_name))
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.stage_2_name and self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress <= 8 then
			self:deactivate_party()
		end

		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 7 then
			-- 동쪽 수용소로 넘어가는 문을 닫아 둠
			for i = 1, self.east_door_num do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.east_door_name..i))
			end

			-- 가짜 열쇠문 닫아 둠
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.fake_key_door_name))
		else
			-- 동쪽 수용소로 넘어가는 문을 열어 둠
			for i = 1, self.east_door_num do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.east_door_name..i))
			end

			-- 가짜 열쇠문 열어 둠
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.fake_key_door_name))
		end

		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 8 then
			-- 서쪽 노역소로 넘어가는 문을 닫아 둠
			for i = 1, self.west_door_num do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.west_door_name..i))
			end
		else
			-- 서쪽 노역소로 넘어가는 문을 열어 둠
			for i = 1, self.west_door_num do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.west_door_name..i))
			end

			-- 일반 쓰레기 제거
			for i = 1, self.stage_2_scrap_num do
				get_field_object(self.stage_2_scrap_name..i).ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			end
		end

		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 9 then
			-- 다음 스테이지로 넘어가는 문을 닫아 둠
			for i = 1, self.next_stage_door_num do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.next_stage_door_name..i))
			end
		else
			-- 다음 스테이지로 넘어가는 문을 열어 둠
			for i = 1, self.next_stage_door_num do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.next_stage_door_name..i))
			end

			-- 이벤트용 쓰레기 제거
			for i = 1, self.stage_2_event_scrap_num do
				get_field_object(self.stage_2_event_scrap_name..i).ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			end
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.stage_3_name and self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 9 or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 11 then
			-- 가스실 문을 열어둠
			for i = 1, self.gas_room_door_num do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.gas_room_door_name..i))
			end
		else
			-- 가스실 문을 닫아둠
			for i = 1, self.gas_room_door_num do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.gas_room_door_name..i))
			end
		end

		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 10 then
			-- 길막 블록 비활성화
			get_field_object(self.stage_3_blocked_block_name).ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

			-- 쓰레기더미 비활성화
			for i = 1, self.stage_3_scrap_num do
				get_field_object(self.stage_3_scrap_name..i).ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			end

			for i = 1, self.stage_3_train_scrap_num do
				get_field_object(self.stage_3_train_scrap_name..i).ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			end

			-- 길막 문들 열어둠
			for i = 1, self.stage_3_town_door_num do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.stage_3_town_door_name..i))
			end
		end

		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 12 then
			-- 다음 스테이지로 넘어가는 문 닫아 둠
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.stage_3_exit_door_name))
		else
			-- 다음 스테이지로 넘어가는 문 열어 둠
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.stage_3_exit_door_name))
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.stage_4_name and self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 12 and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 15 then
			self:deactivate_party()

			self:change_manual_character(self.knight_refugee_vice_name)
		end

		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 13 then
			-- 앞마당 문 닫아 둠
			for i = 1, self.frontyard_door_num do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.stage_4_frontyard_door_name..i))
			end
		else
			-- 앞마당 문 열어 둠
			for i = 1, self.frontyard_door_num do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.stage_4_frontyard_door_name..i))
			end
		end

		local clear_flag = get_field_object(self.stage_4_clear_flag_name)

		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 15 then
			-- Clear Flag 활성화
			clear_flag.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		else
			-- Clear Flag 비활성화
			clear_flag.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.stage_5_name and self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 16 then
			-- 우측 문 닫아 둠
			for i = 1, self.stage_5_main_right_door_num do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.stage_5_main_right_door_name..i))
			end

			-- 폭탄병 문 닫아 둠
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.stage_5_bomb_door_name))
		else
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.stage_5_bomb_door_name))
		end

		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 16 then
			local main_gate = get_field_object(self.stage_5_main_gate_name)
			main_gate.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

			local gate_animator = main_gate:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
			gate_animator:Play('crash')

			for i = 1, self.stage_5_main_left_door_num do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.stage_5_main_left_door_name..i))
			end
		else
			for i = 1, self.stage_5_main_left_door_num do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.stage_5_main_left_door_name..i))
			end
		end

		local clear_flag = get_field_object(self.stage_5_clear_flag_name)

		if self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			-- Clear Flag 활성화
			clear_flag.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		else
			-- Clear Flag 비활성화
			clear_flag.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		end
	end
end

-- 기차 탑승 연출
function local_class:ride_on_train(train)
	local ride_duration = 0.25

	camera_util.move(train.Position, ride_duration, { end_target = train })

	local ride_dir_vec = (train.Position - user_party_leader.Position)
	local ride_dir = ride_dir_vec:ToDirection()
	local ride_pos

	if (ride_dir & CS.Oak.Direction.Side) == 0 then
		ride_pos = vector(user_party_leader.Position.x, 0, user_party_leader.Position.z + ride_dir_vec.z * 0.7)
	else
		ride_pos = vector(user_party_leader.Position.x + ride_dir_vec.x * 0.7, 0, user_party_leader.Position.z)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[i], 0, ride_duration)
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], ride_dir)

		if i == 0 then
			character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = 'get' })

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.ride_in, self, ride_pos, ride_duration))
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(ride_duration)
end

-- 기차 탑승 시 파티 리더의 움직임
function local_class:ride_in(end_pos, ride_duration)
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_pos = user_party_leader.Position

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < ride_duration do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / ride_duration

		local cur_x = (end_pos.x - start_pos.x) * normalized
		local cur_y = math.sin(math.pi * normalized / 2) * 0.7
		local cur_z = (end_pos.z - start_pos.z) * normalized

		character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, start_pos + vector(cur_x, cur_y, cur_z), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, end_pos)
end

-- 기차 내리는 연출
function local_class:get_off_train(train)
	local get_off_duration = 0.25

	local dest = train.Position + CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(train.Direction) * 2

	if train.Direction & CS.Oak.Direction.Side ~= 0 then
		dest = dest + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
	end

	local dest_dir = ((dest - train.Position)):ToDirection()
	local dest_start_pos

	if dest_dir & CS.Oak.Direction.Side == 0 then
		dest_start_pos = vector(dest.x, 0, train.Position.z)
	else
		dest_start_pos = vector(train.Position.x, 0, dest.z)
	end

	local offset = unity_class.vector3.zero

	if train.Direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		offset = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(dest_dir).normalized * 1.5
	end

	camera_util.move(dest, get_off_duration, { end_target = user_party_leader })

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], dest_dir)

		if i == 0 then
			character_util.set_position(user_party[i], dest_start_pos + offset)

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[i], 1, get_off_duration / 2)
			character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = 'get' })
		else
			character_util.set_position(user_party[i],
					dest - (dest - train.Position) * CS.Oak.Constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers * i * 0.33)
		end
	end

	coroutine.yield(self:get_off(dest, get_off_duration))

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party[i])

		if i ~= 0 then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[i], get_off_duration / 2)
		end
	end
end

-- 기차 내릴 시 파티 리더의 움직임
function local_class:get_off(end_pos, get_off_duration)
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_pos = user_party_leader.Position

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < get_off_duration do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / get_off_duration

		local cur_x = (end_pos.x - start_pos.x) * normalized
		local cur_y = math.cos(math.pi * normalized / 2) * 0.7
		local cur_z = (end_pos.z - start_pos.z) * normalized

		character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, start_pos + vector(cur_x, cur_y, cur_z), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, end_pos)
end

	self.party_list = nil

function local_class:preload_bullet()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local custom_atlas

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)

	self.pooled_bullet = {}
	for i = 1, self.bullet_pool_size do
		self.pooled_bullet[i] = self.get_custom_sprite():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
		local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet[i].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
		bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
		bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
		bullet_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas

		bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'sniper_shot_middle.png'
		bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
	end
end

function local_class:get_bullet()
	for i = 1, #self.pooled_bullet do
		local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet[i].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		if bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition == unity_class.vector3.one * 999 then
			return self.pooled_bullet[i]
		end
	end
end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local train = get_character('train_' .. i)
		character_util.set_active_shadow(train, false)
	end

	if self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('last_door_1', true))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('last_door_2', true))

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('room_3_door_1', true))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('room_3_door_2', true))

	else
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 3 then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('room_3_door_1', true))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('room_3_door_2', true))
		end

		local inner_progress_to_marker = {
			{marker_name = 'hekate_sniper_point_1', damage = 0},
			{marker_name = 'hekate_sniper_point_1', damage = 0},
			{marker_name = 'hekate_sniper_point_2', damage = 1},
			{marker_name = 'hekate_sniper_point_3', damage = 2},
			{marker_name = 'hekate_sniper_point_4', damage = 3},
			{marker_name = 'hekate_sniper_point_5', damage = 3},
		}

		self.zone_index = self.quest_progress.InnerProgress

		local sniper = self.get_sniper()
		local marker = field:GetMarker(inner_progress_to_marker[self.quest_progress.InnerProgress + 1].marker_name)

		character_util.set_position(sniper, marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(sniper, marker.direction)

		sniper.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'nw_2000_sniper_rifle')

		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 5 then

			character_util.set_direction(sniper, 'left')
			character_util.set_emotion(sniper, {name = 'mad'})

-- 저격 루틴
function local_class:snipping_routine()
	local sniper = self.get_sniper()

	local is_hiding = true
	local snipping_start_time = nil

	local snipping_times = self:get_cur_snipping_times()

	-- 전체 조준 시간
	local snipping_hour = snipping_times.snipping_hour

	-- 서칭 시간
	local aiming_hour = snipping_times.aiming_hour


	-- 조준 시작 후 화면 흔들기 시작할 때까지 걸리는 시간
	local shaking_after = snipping_times.shaking_after
	local is_shaking = false

	local start_size = unity_class.vector3.one
	local end_size = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5

	local tint_key = 'sniper_aiming'
	local shake_key = 'sniper_danger'

	local tint_color = unity_color({1, 0.3216, 0.1961})

	local custom_check_func = self:get_cur_custom_check_func()

	while self.is_snipping do
		if self.is_in_instant_spot then
			self.is_in_instant_spot = false

			if self.fx_scope ~= nil then
				self.fx_scope:Dispose()
				self.fx_scope = nil
			end

			self:stop_sfx_targeted()

			field:RemoveTint(tint_key, 0.3)
			stage_camera:CancelShake(shake_key)

			self.sniper_attack_range:Hide()
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.shoot_scene, self)
			return
		end

		local detection_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(sniper.Position, user_party.Leader.Bounds.center.y)

		local bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(detection_pos, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.05)
		local move = vector_util.get_x0z(user_party.Leader.Position - sniper.Position)

		-- 열차에 타거나, 연출 이벤트 진행 중에는 엄폐중으로 처리
		local is_screen_playing = lua_helper.type_compare(
				user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState)
		local is_dead = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead
		local is_hiding_now = is_screen_playing or is_dead

		if not is_hiding_now then
			local list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(bound, move)

			for i = 0, list.Count - 1 do
				local v = list[i]
				local is_holding_object = lua_helper.reference_equals(v.Holdable.Holder, user_party.Leader)
				local is_ethereal = CS.Oak.ICrashBehaviourExtensions.IsEthereal(v.CrashBehaviour)
				local is_character = lua_helper.type_compare(v, CS.Oak.Character)
				local is_fit_custom_check = custom_check_func(v)

				if not is_holding_object and not is_ethereal and not is_character and is_fit_custom_check then
					is_hiding_now = true
					break
				end
			end

			list:Dispose()
		end

		-- 상태가 바뀌었을 때
		if is_hiding ~= is_hiding_now then
			-- 플레이어가 엄폐 해제한 경우
			if is_hiding_now == false then
				self:enable_scope(start_size, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				field:Tint(tint_key, tint_color, snipping_hour)
				snipping_start_time = unity_class.time.time

				local attack_range_dir = (self.fx_scope.transform.position - sniper.Bounds.center).normalized

				attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.sniper_attack_range,
						sniper.Bounds.center, attack_range_dir, 0)
				attack_range_util.show(self.sniper_attack_range, 0.2)

			-- 플레이어가 엄폐한 경우
			else
				self:disable_scope()
				field:RemoveTint(tint_key, 0.3)
				stage_camera:CancelShake(shake_key)
				snipping_start_time = nil
				is_shaking = false
				self.sniper_attack_range:Hide()
			end

			is_hiding = is_hiding_now
		end

		-- 엄폐 중이지 않을 때 조준 상태(조준 이펙트, AttackRange) 업데이트
		if not is_hiding then
			if stage.Name ~= self.sub_stage_name then
				character_util.look_at(sniper, user_party.Leader)
			end

			local sniper_center = sniper.Position + sniper.SpineController.SpineTotalOffset
			local rifle_dir = self:get_current_rifle_dir(user_party.Leader)
			local rifle_pos = self:get_current_muzzle_pos(user_party.Leader, 0.5)
			sniper.SpineController.AimPoint = CS.Oak.IKSupportUtil.GetAimPointInSpineSpace(rifle_pos, sniper_center)

			local attack_range_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(rifle_pos, user_party.Leader.Bounds.center.y)

			attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.sniper_attack_range, attack_range_pos, rifle_dir, user_party.Leader.Bounds.center.y)

			local time_dif = unity_class.time.time - snipping_start_time

			-- 최대 조준 시간 지나면 플레이어가 총에 맞음
			if time_dif >= snipping_hour then
				if self.fx_scope ~= nil then
					self.fx_scope:Dispose()
					self.fx_scope = nil
				end

				self:stop_sfx_targeted()

				field:RemoveTint(tint_key, 0.3)
				stage_camera:CancelShake(shake_key)

				self.sniper_attack_range:Hide()

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.shoot_scene, self)
				return

			elseif time_dif >= shaking_after and not is_shaking then
				is_shaking = true
				camera_util.shake(0.04, snipping_hour - shaking_after, nil, shake_key)
			end

			if self.fx_scope ~= nil then
				self.fx_scope.transform.position = user_party.Leader.Bounds.center
				local normalized_shrink_time = time_dif / snipping_hour
				self.fx_scope.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_size, end_size, normalized_shrink_time)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 숨거나 이벤트 존을 나가거나 했을 때 이펙트, 틴트, 카메라 셰이크 후처리
	if self.fx_scope ~= nil then
		local stop_pos = self.fx_scope.transform.position
		local stop_size = self.fx_scope.transform.localScale

		self.fx_scope:Dispose()
		self.fx_scope = nil

		self.fx_scope_end = self.get_fx_targetcircle_end():Instantiate(stop_pos)
		self.fx_scope_end.transform.localScale = stop_size
	end

	self:stop_sfx_targeted()

	field:RemoveTint(tint_key, 0.3)
	stage_camera:CancelShake(shake_key)
end

function local_class:shoot_scene()
	camera_util.resize_to(3.5, 0.3)
	local sniper_origin_pos = self.get_sniper().Position

	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(true)

	local got_hit = false
	local tint_key = 'shoot_scene'

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.sniper_shoot_to_target, self, user_party.Leader, function() got_hit = true end, 'beat'))

	while got_hit == false do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_gun_shoot_02')

	field:Tint(tint_key, unity_class.color.red, 0.2)

	local is_right = user_party.Leader.Position.x < self.get_sniper().Position.x

	if user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		command_util.execute_throw(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget,
				is_right and unity_class.vector3.right or unity_class.vector3.left,
				user_party.Leader.Position, 3, false)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, is_right and 'right' or 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'dead1', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01'})
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'damaged'})
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(user_party.Leader, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(user_party.Leader, unity_class.color.red, 1, 1, 0.5)

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = 'embarrassed', loop = true})
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], {name = 'surprise'})

		character_util.normal_jump(user_party[i], true)
	end

	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Bounds.center)
	self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Bounds.center)
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)
	--wait_for_sec(0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	field:RemoveTint(tint_key, 0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_gun_reload_02', parent = self.get_sniper(),
								type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:reset_party()
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.get_sniper())
	character_util.set_anim(self.get_sniper(), {name = 'sniper_shoot', loop = false, scale = 0})
	character_util.set_position(self.get_sniper(), sniper_origin_pos)

	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(false)
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	local reset_marker = self:get_cur_reset_marker()
	local is_not_side = (reset_marker.direction & CS.Oak.Direction.Side) == CS.Oak.Direction.None
	if is_not_side then
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	else
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, reset_marker.direction)
	end

	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'prostrate', loop = true})
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'damaged'})

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(user_party.Leader, 0.04, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')

	if is_not_side then
		character_util.mario_jump_async(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	else
		character_util.mario_jump_async(user_party.Leader, reset_marker.direction)
	end
end

-- 총에 맞았을 때, 유저 파티 위치 리셋

	party_util.position_party(reset_marker.position, reset_marker.direction, 'linear')

	camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position, 0, {end_target = user_party.Leader})

	if stage.Name == self.sub_stage_name and self.zone_index == 3 and get_character('train_3').Interactable.IsForward == false then
		message_system:Send(get_character('train_3'), CS.Oak.TrainLeverInteractEvent.Create(nil, false))
	end

function local_class:sniper_shoot_to_target(target, callback, anim_state)
	local sniper = self.get_sniper()
	local target_pos = self:get_position(target)

	local bullet_speed = 60
	local effect_scale_ratio = bullet_speed / 30 * 1.1
	local effect_delay_ratio = bullet_speed / 30 * 0.5
	local rifle_dir = self:get_current_rifle_dir(target_pos)
	local muzzle_pos = self:get_current_muzzle_pos(target_pos) + vector(0, 0.4, 0)
	local shoot_dir = (target_pos - muzzle_pos).normalized
	local start_pos = muzzle_pos
	local end_pos = target_pos - shoot_dir * 0.3
	local target_hit_hour = unity_class.vector3.Distance(start_pos, end_pos) / bullet_speed

	local bullet_sprite = self:get_bullet().transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir)
			* unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	if anim_state ~= nil then
		if anim_state == 'beat' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(sniper, {name = 'sniper_shoot'})
				character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(sniper, {name = 'rifle_reload'})
				character_util.set_anim(sniper, {name = 'sniper_shoot', loop = false, scale = 0})
			end))
		elseif anim_state == 'miss' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				character_util.set_anim(sniper, {name = 'sniper_shoot', loop = false, scale = 1.2})
				wait_for_sec(0.35)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sniper)
				character_util.set_anim(sniper, {name = 'sniper_shoot', loop = false, scale = 0})
			end))
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	local fx_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.right, rifle_dir).eulerAngles.y, 0)
	self.get_fx_common_cannonfire():Instantiate(muzzle_pos, fx_rotation, sniper.Transform)

	local fx_rotation_2 = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir) * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		if target_hit_hour > effect_delay_ratio then
			wait_for_sec(target_hit_hour - effect_delay_ratio)
			local smoke_effect = self.get_fx_smoketrail():Instantiate(bullet_sprite.transform.position, fx_rotation_2, nil)
			smoke_effect.transform.localScale = vector(effect_scale_ratio, 1, 1)
		else
			local smoke_effect = self.get_fx_smoketrail():Instantiate(start_pos, fx_rotation_2, nil)
			smoke_effect.transform.localScale = vector(effect_scale_ratio, 1, 1)
		end
	end))

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo, bullet_sprite.transform,
			start_pos, end_pos, -1, nil, bullet_speed, false)

	if callback ~= nil then
		callback()
	end

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo, bullet_sprite.transform,
			end_pos, end_pos + shoot_dir * 10, -1, nil, bullet_speed, false)

	bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
end

function local_class:get_current_rifle_dir(target)
	local target_pos = self:get_position(target)
	return vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - self.get_sniper().Bounds.center).normalized
end

function local_class:get_current_muzzle_pos(target, offset)
	local target_pos = self:get_position(target)
	local offset_size = offset == nil and 0.85 or offset

	local sniper = self.get_sniper()
	local sniper_center = sniper.Position + sniper.SpineController.SpineTotalOffset
	local rifle_dir = self:get_current_rifle_dir(target_pos)
	local rifle_pos = sniper_center + rifle_dir * offset_size

	return rifle_pos
end

function local_class:get_position(target)
	return lua_helper.type_compare(target, CS.Oak.Character) and target.Bounds.center or target
end

-- 조준점 나타나게
-- 시작 로컬 스케일과 로컬 위치 입력
function local_class:enable_scope(start_local_scale, start_local_pos)
	if self.fx_scope ~= nil then
		self.fx_scope:Dispose()
		self.fx_scope = nil
	end

	if self.fx_scope_end ~= nil then
		self.fx_scope_end:Dispose()
		self.fx_scope_end = nil
	end

	self:play_sfx_targeted()
	self.fx_scope = self.get_fx_targetcircle_loop():Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Bounds.center + start_local_pos,
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, user_party.Leader.Transform)
	self.fx_scope.transform.localScale = start_local_scale
end

-- 조준점 사라지게
function local_class:disable_scope()
	if self.fx_scope_end ~= nil then
		self.fx_scope_end:Dispose()
		self.fx_scope_end = nil
	end

	self:stop_sfx_targeted()

	if self.fx_scope ~= nil then
		local stop_pos = self.fx_scope.transform.position
		local stop_size = self.fx_scope.transform.localScale
		self.fx_scope:Dispose()
		self.fx_scope = nil

		self.fx_scope_end = self.get_fx_targetcircle_end():Instantiate(stop_pos)
		self.fx_scope_end.transform.localScale = stop_size
	end
end

function local_class:play_sfx_targeted()
	self:stop_sfx_targeted()

	self.sfx_targeted = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{sfx_name = '01_targeted_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})
end

function local_class:fade_sfx_targeted()
	if self.sfx_targeted ~= nil then
		self.sfx_targeted:FadeOut(0.3)
		self.sfx_targeted = nil
	end
end

function local_class:stop_sfx_targeted()
	if self.sfx_targeted ~= nil then
		self.sfx_targeted:Stop()
		self.sfx_targeted = nil
	end
end

-- 스나이핑 루틴 시작용
function local_class:start_snipping_routine()
	self.is_snipping = true

	field:Tint(self.snipping_tint_key, unity_color({0.7, 0.7, 0.7}), 0.3)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.snipping_routine, self))

	self.is_snipping = false

	local sniper_center = sniper.Position + sniper.SpineController.SpineTotalOffset
	sniper.SpineController.AimPoint = CS.Oak.IKSupportUtil.GetAimPointInSpineSpace(self:get_cur_reset_marker().position, sniper_center)

	field:RemoveTint(self.snipping_tint_key, 0.3)
	self.sniper_attack_range:Hide()
end

	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, _)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end
}

	character_util.normal_jump(audition_staff, true)

	-- TODO: 액션 배우 오디션을 보실 분은 제 앞으로 와주세요.
	if self.quest_progress == nil or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 0 then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(audition_staff, { key = 'street_audition_15', skip = true })
	else
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(audition_staff, { key = 'street_audition_16', skip = true })
	end

	local position = user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -2)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party_leader, position, 4, false, nil, nil, 'down', true)

	character_util.set_direction(audition_staff, 'down')

function local_class:request_vampire_girl(already_know)
	local vampire_girl = get_character("vampire_bad_girl")

	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(vampire_girl)
	vampire_girl:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.set_direction(vampire_girl, 'left')
	character_util.align_party(vampire_girl, 'left')

	if not self.skip_request then
		yield_return(self.scene, "request_vampire_girl")

		if already_know then
			yield_return(self.scene, "request_vampire_girl_add")
		end

		self.skip_request = true
	end

	local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId)

	vampire_girl:RemoveAnimation()

	if accepted then
		self.current_quest_state = self.vampire_quest_states.proceed

		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker("vampire_bad_girl")

		--실패나 이탈 이벤트 1회 확인 후에 퀘스트 재수락 시 햇빛 위치에 서브 퀘스트 마커 출력
		local quest_marker_pos = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(already_know,

function local_class:load_resource()

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()

end

function local_class:on_init()

		quest_util.load_section(self, 'WitchChefSection1to3'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'WitchChefSection1to3'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'WitchChefSection1to3'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'WitchChefSection4'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'WitchChefSection5')
	}

	self.post_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'WitchChefPostSection')
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	self.scene:setting()

	self.witch_chef = get_character(self.witch_chef_name)
	self.cauldron = get_field_object(self.cauldron_name)
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.setting_section, self))
end

function local_class:setting_section()
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		self:activate_potion()
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	if self.quest_progress == nil or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress <= 4 then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_event')
	end

	local item_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ItemData")
	if self.quest_progress == nil or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress <= 2 then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
		self.category = {0, 0, 0}
		self.limit = {4, 16, 4}

		for i = 0, 3 do
			local fo = get_field_object(string.format("%s%d", self.witch_flower_name, i))
			local marker = field:GetMarker(string.format("%s%d", self.flower_marker_name, i))
			fo.Position = marker.position

			local item_id = item_data:GetSpec("flower_cannibal").Id
			local drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = fo.Position, target = fo.Position,
			itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = "dontfindlooter"})

			local stuff = {fo, drop_item}
			table.insert(self.stuff_list, stuff)
		end
	end

	if self.quest_progress == nil or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress <= 1 then
		for  i = 0, 3 do
			local fo = get_field_object(string.format("%s%d", self.witch_pot_name, i))

			for j = 0, 3 do
				local item_place_holder = CS.Oak.ItemPlaceholder()
				item_place_holder.ItemId = item_data:GetSpec("cheesecake").Id
				item_place_holder.Amount = 1
				item_place_holder.SkipItemGetText = true
				item_place_holder.NotForInventory = true
				stage.DropManager:AddDropTo(fo, item_place_holder)
			end
		end
	else
		for i = 0, 3 do
			local fo = get_field_object(string.format("%s%d", self.witch_pot_name, i))
			character_util.set_active_state(fo, "disabled")
		end
	end

	if self.quest_progress == nil or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0 then
		for i = 0, 3 do
			local fo = get_field_object(string.format("%s%d", self.witch_lizard_name, i))
			local marker = field:GetMarker(string.format("%s%d", self.lizard_marker_name, i))
			fo.Position = marker.position

			local item_id = item_data:GetSpec("lizard").Id
			local drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = fo.Position + unity_class.vector3.up,
			itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = "dontfindlooter"})

			drop_item.ShadowTransform.position = drop_item.ShadowTransform.position + unity_class.vector3.up

			local stuff = {fo, drop_item}
			table.insert(self.stuff_list, stuff)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.item_get, self, e.Item.ItemId))
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then

		for i = 1, #self.stuff_list do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.stuff_list[i][1], e.Target) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
						self.interact, self, e.Target, i))
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) or e.FieldObject.Name == "My Party" then
			self:update_grid(e.CameraGrid.name)
		end
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:interact(target, idx)
	character_util.set_active_state(target, "disabled")

	if string.find(target.Name, "flower") then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

		local gether_sfx = music_player:PlaySfx(self.gether_Sfx)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.scared_sfx_name)

		local dir
		if target.Position.x > user_party_leader.Position.x then
			dir = "right"
		else
			dir = "left"
		end
		character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, dir)
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = "scared", loop = false})
		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = "eat", scale = 1, remove_after = 1})

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

		gether_sfx:FadeOut(0.3)

		user_party_leader:RemoveEmotion()

		if self.category[3] >= 0 then
			if get_field_object(string.format("%s%d", self.witch_flower_name, 0)).ActiveState ==
			CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled and
					get_field_object(string.format("%s%d", self.witch_flower_name, 2)).ActiveState ==
							CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name2)
			end

			if get_field_object(string.format("%s%d", self.witch_flower_name, 1)).ActiveState ==
					CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled and
					get_field_object(string.format("%s%d", self.witch_flower_name, 3)).ActiveState ==
							CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name3)
			end
		end

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end

	target.Position = vector(999, 999, 999)
	self.stuff_list[idx][2].ConsumeTarget = user_party_leader
end

function local_class:item_get(id)
	local item_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ItemData")

	if id == item_data:GetSpec("lizard").Id then
		self.category[1] = self.category[1] + 1

		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0 then
			self:update_marker_and_tracker()
		end
	elseif id == item_data:GetSpec("cheesecake").Id then
		self.category[2] = self.category[2] + 1

		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 then
			self:update_marker_and_tracker()
		end
	elseif id == item_data:GetSpec("flower_cannibal").Id then
		self.category[3] = self.category[3] + 1

		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 2 then
			self:update_marker_and_tracker()
		end
	elseif id == item_data:GetSpec("strange_recipe").Id then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
		quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	else
		return
	end
end

function local_class:find_next_section()
	local cur_section = self.quest_progress.InnerProgress
	local next_section = cur_section

	for i = next_section, 3 do
		next_section = i

		if next_section == 3 then
			break
		end

		if not self:is_clear(i) then
			break
		end
	end

	if next_section - cur_section == 3 then
		yield_return(self.scene, "complete_already_0")
	elseif next_section - cur_section > 1 then
		yield_return(self.scene, "complete_already_1")
	end

	if next_section == 3 then
		yield_return(self.scene, "pot_main")
		--섹션4로 넘어가는시점
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	else
		yield_return(self.scene, string.format("%s%d",
				"accept_main_", next_section))
	end

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self, next_section - cur_section)
end

function local_class:is_clear(progress)
	return self.category[progress + 1] >= self.limit[progress + 1]
end

function local_class:update_marker_and_tracker()
	if self.quest_progress == nil then return end

	self:update_marker()
	self:update_tracker()
end

function local_class:update_grid(grid_name)
	local last_name = self.current_grid

	if grid_name == "start" or grid_name == "roomA" or grid_name == "roomB" or grid_name == "roomBoss" then
		self.current_grid = "GridMain"
	elseif grid_name == "roomMainA" then
		self.current_grid = "GridA"
	elseif grid_name == "roomMainB" then
		self.current_grid = "GridB"
	elseif grid_name == "roomMainC" then
		self.current_grid = "GridC"
	elseif grid_name == "roomSub" then
		self.current_grid = "GridQuest"
	end

	if self.quest_progress == nil then return end

	if last_name ~= self.current_grid then
		self:update_marker()
	end
end

function local_class:update_marker()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name1)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name2)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name3)

	if self.current_grid == "GridQuest" then
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0 then
			if not self:is_clear(0) then
				local pos = field:GetMarker(self.lizard_marker_name .. 1).position + vector(0.5, 1, 0)
				self:add_quest_marker(self.marker_name1, pos)
			end
		elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 then
			if not self:is_clear(1) then
				local pos = get_field_object(self.witch_pot_name .. 2).Position +
						get_field_object(self.witch_pot_name .. 1).Position
				self:add_quest_marker(self.marker_name1, pos * 0.5)
			end
		elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 2 then
			if not self:is_clear(2) then
				if get_field_object(self.witch_flower_name .. 0).ActiveState == active_state("enabled") or
						get_field_object(self.witch_flower_name .. 2).ActiveState == active_state("enabled") then
					local pos = field:GetMarker(self.flower_marker_name .. 0).position +
							unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.5
					self:add_quest_marker(self.marker_name2, pos)
				end
				if get_field_object(self.witch_flower_name .. 1).ActiveState == active_state("enabled") or
						get_field_object(self.witch_flower_name .. 3).ActiveState == active_state("enabled") then
					local pos = field:GetMarker(self.flower_marker_name .. 1).position +
							unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.5
					self:add_quest_marker(self.marker_name3, pos)
				end
			end
		end
	else
		if self.current_grid == "GridMain" then
			local pos = field:GetMarker(self.marker_exit_b_name).position + unity_class.vector3.right * 1.5
			self:add_quest_marker(self.marker_name1, pos)
		elseif self.current_grid == "GridA" then
			local pos = field:GetMarker(self.marker_exit_a_name).position + unity_class.vector3.right * 1.5
			self:add_quest_marker(self.marker_name1, pos)
		elseif self.current_grid == "GridB" then
			local pos = self.witch_chef.Position
			self:add_quest_marker(self.marker_name1, pos)
		elseif self.current_grid == "GridC" then
			local pos = field:GetMarker(self.marker_exit_c_name).position + unity_class.vector3.right * 1.5
			self:add_quest_marker(self.marker_name1, pos)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:add_quest_marker(marker_name, pos)
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, pos)
end

function local_class:update_tracker()
	if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress <= 2 then
		local progress = self.quest_progress.InnerProgress

		if self:is_clear(progress) then
			quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.witch_chef)
			quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name1 .. 4))
		else
			quest_icon.SetQuestAccepted(self.witch_chef)
			quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:Format(self.tracker_name1 .. progress, self.category[progress + 1]))
		end
	elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 3 then
		quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.cauldron)
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name1 .. 3))
	elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 4 then
		quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.witch_chef)
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name1 .. 5))
	end
end

function local_class:activate_potion()
	local item_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ItemData")

	for i = 0, 2 do
		local fo = get_field_object(self.witch_potion_name .. i)
		fo.Position = self.witch_chef.Position - vector(1 - i, 0, 1)

		local item_id = item_data:GetSpec("healing_potion").Id
		drop_item_util.create_item({pos = fo.Position, target = fo.Position, itemid = item_id,
		lootstate = "dontfindlooter"})
	end
end


function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	self.witch_chef = nil
	self.cauldron = nil
	self.category = nil
	self.limit = nil
	self.stuff_list = nil

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end


	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:load_characters()

		self.character_table = {}
		for _, npc_data in pairs(self.npc_data_table) do
			local pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(npc_data.spec_name)
			while pool.State ~= CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolState.Loaded do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			local character = pool:Instantiate(vector(999,999,999))
			local spine = character:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
			if npc_data.skin_name ~= nil then
				spine.SkinName = npc_data.skin_name
			end
			self.base_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
			spine:SetAnimation(self.base_track, npc_data.animation, false)

	while time_passed < time_limit do

		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		banner_transform.position = banner_transform.position + unity_class.vector3.up * velocity * dt
		scale.y = scale.y + 1 / time_limit * dt
		banner_transform.localScale = scale
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	banner_transform.position = self.fo.Bounds.center + vector(0, 2.05, 0)

function local_class:generate_balloon_routine()
	local balloon = self:instantiate_random_balloon()
	local transform = balloon.transform
	local x_velocity = random_util.get_random_value()*2 - 1
	if self.last_velocity * x_velocity > 0 then
		x_velocity = x_velocity * -1
	end
	self.last_velocity = x_velocity
	local rising_time = self.balloon_rising_limit / self.balloon_rising_velocity
	local time = 0
	while time < rising_time do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time = time + dt
		local random_accel = random_util.get_random_value() / 2 - 0.25
		x_velocity = x_velocity + random_accel * dt
		transform.position = transform.position + vector(x_velocity * dt, self.balloon_rising_velocity * dt, 0)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	balloon:Dispose()

function local_class:instantiate_random_balloon()

	balloon_sprite:Rebuild()
	return balloon

function drop_item:calculate_position()
	local displacement_y = self.v0 * self.time_passed + self.accel * self.time_passed * self.time_passed / 2
	return self.init_pos + vector(0 , displacement_y, 0) + self.xz_dir * self.xz_speed * self.time_passed
end

function drop_item:bounce(bounce_pos)
	self.current_bounce_cnt = self.current_bounce_cnt + 1
	self.init_pos = bounce_pos
	self.v0 = -(self.v0 + self.time_passed * self.accel) / self.deceleration_y_ratio
	self.xz_speed = self.xz_speed / self.deceleration_xz_ratio
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function drop_item:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_bounce_cnt > self.bounce_cnt then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	local next_pos = self:calculate_position()
	if next_pos.y <= 0 then
		next_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(next_pos)
		self:bounce(next_pos)
	end
	self.transform.position = next_pos

	if self.use_rotation then
		self.transform:Rotate(vector(0, 0, 360 * self.rotation_speed * dt))
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 4 })
	self:move_camera_to_fo()
	self:throw_stone_screen_play()
	self.is_routine_playing = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.leader_move_routine, self))
	self.animator:Play('open')
	self:camera_production()

	self:open_routine()

	--exit
	self:move_camera_to_party()
	self.hit_count = 0
	self.is_routine_playing = false
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
end

function local_class:throw_stone_screen_play()
	wait_for_sec(2)
	self:end_throw_routine()
end

function local_class:move_camera_to_fo()
	camera_util.move(user_party.Leader.Position)
end

function local_class:camera_production()
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 3.8)
	wait_for_sec(1.0)
	camera_util.resize_to(4.7, 0.1)
	wait_for_sec(1.0)
	camera_util.resize_to(4.4, 0.1)
	wait_for_sec(1.0)
	camera_util.resize_to(4.1, 0.1)
	wait_for_sec(0.8)
	character_util.jump(user_party.Leader, 1, 0.35)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
end

function local_class:leader_move_routine()
	character_util.show_emoticon(user_party.Leader, nil, 'notice')
	user_party.Leader:SetAnimation('idle', true)
	user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('surprise', true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_farm_05')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	self.leader_pos_cache = user_party.Leader.Position
	user_party.Leader:SetAnimation('run', true)
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, self.leader_target_pos,
			nil, self.leader_run_speed, true, false, true)
	user_party.Leader:SetAnimation('idle', true)
	user_party.Leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
end

function local_class:open_routine()
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.3)
	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	--fx
	--sfx
	self:instantiate_banner_routine()
	self:drop_item_routine()
	self:fall_farm_npc()
	self:dance_farm_npc()
end

function local_class:drop_item_routine()
	local accel = -9.8
	local time_passed = 0
	for _, item_list in ipairs(self.drop_list) do
		self:shuffle(item_list)
		for i, item_sprite in ipairs(item_list) do
			self:instantiate_item(item_sprite, i, #item_list)
		end
		wait_for_sec(self.drop_interval)
	end
end

function local_class:shuffle(list)
	for i = #list, 2, -1 do
		local rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, i)
		list[i], list[rand] = list[rand], list[i]
	end
end

function local_class:instantiate_item(sprite_name, section, list_size)
	local item = {}
	item.pooled_object = self.item_pool:Instantiate(self.fo.Bounds.center + self.global_offset)
	item.transform = item.pooled_object.transform
	item.transform.position = self.fo.Bounds.center + self.global_offset + self.item_offset
	item.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(90, 0, 0))

	local item_sprite = item.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	item_sprite.Atlas = self.custom_atlas
	item_sprite.SpriteName = sprite_name
	item_sprite:Rebuild()

	item.time_passed = 0
	item.v0 = 0
	item.init_pos = item.transform.position

	local theta = (random_util.get_random_value() + (section-1)) * -math.pi / list_size
	item.xz_dir = vector(math.cos(theta), 0, math.sin(theta))
	item.current_bounce_cnt = 0

	item.use_rotation = string.match(sprite_name, 'lucky')
	item.rotation_speed = random_util.get_random_value() - 0.5

	setmetatable(item, {__index = drop_item})
	table.insert(self.active_item_list, item)
end

function local_class:instantiate_banner_routine()
	self.party_paper_instance = self.party_paper_fx:Instantiate(self.fo.Bounds.center + self.global_offset)
end

function local_class:fall_farm_npc()
	local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo.Bounds.center + self.character_offset + self.global_offset)
	self.fx_dead:Instantiate(target_pos)
	self.character.SpineController:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'get', false)
	self.character.SpineController:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	self.character.SpineController.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	self.character.transform.position = target_pos

	wait_for_sec(2)
end

function local_class:dance_farm_npc()
	user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	user_party.Leader:SetAnimation('clap', true)
	self.firework_instance = self.firework_fx:Instantiate(self.fo.Bounds.center + self.global_offset + vector(0.5, 1, 0.5))
	self.bg_fx_instance_1 = self.bg_fx:Instantiate(self.fo.Bounds.center + self.global_offset + vector(-0.75, 0, -1.5))
	self.bg_fx_instance_2 = self.bg_fx:Instantiate(self.fo.Bounds.center + self.global_offset + vector(0.75, 0, -1.5))
	self.character.SpineController:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'dance', true)
	self.character.SpineController:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	self.character.SpineController.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	wait_for_sec(1)
	self.character.SpineController.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	wait_for_sec(1)
	self.character.SpineController.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	wait_for_sec(1)
	self.character.SpineController.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	wait_for_sec(1)
	self.character.SpineController.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	wait_for_sec(1)
	self.character.SpineController.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
end

function local_class:move_camera_to_party()
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	self.character.transform.position = vector(999, 999, 999)
	self.firework_instance:Dispose()
	self.bg_fx_instance_1:Dispose()
	self.bg_fx_instance_2:Dispose()
	self.party_paper_instance:Dispose()
	for i = #self.active_item_list, 1, -1 do
		self.active_item_list[i]:dispose()
		self.active_item_list[i] = nil
	end
	self.animator:Play('idle')
	user_party.Leader.Position = self.leader_pos_cache

	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0, {end_target = user_party})
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

function local_class:qte_fail_routine()
	self.is_throwing = false
	user_party.Leader:SetAnimation('idle', true)
	user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('blush', true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'farm_anni_gourd_qte_fail' })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
end

function local_class:update_building(data, pooled_object)
	self.animator = pooled_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
end

function local_class:remove_building(_)
	self.animator = nil
	if self.stone_list ~= nil then
		for i = #self.stone_list, 1, -1 do
			self.stone_list[i]:dispose()
			table.remove(self.stone_list, i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_stone(dt)
	self:update_drop_item(dt)

	if self.is_throwing then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
		if self.time_passed > self.throw_interval then
			self:throw_stone()
			self.time_passed = 0
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_drop_item(dt)
	for _, item in ipairs(self.active_item_list) do
		item:update_frame(dt)
	end
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('FarmDecorationChair')

-- 생성자
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')
	if data_key == '' then
		data_key = 'default'
	end

	-- 데이터 세팅
	local data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	-- 의자 앉았을 때 오프셋
	self.offset_x = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['offset_x'], 0)
	self.offset_z = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['offset_z'], 0)

	-- 의자 앉았을 때 높이
	self.seat_height = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['seat_height'], 0.5)

	-- 앉았을 때 재생할 애니메이션
	self.seat_anim = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['seat_anim'], 'seat')

	-- 앉았을 때 재생할 표정 (nil 이면 표정 없는 것)
	self.seat_emotion = data['seat_emotion']

	-- 앉았을 때의 방향 (None이면 앉는 위치에 따라)
	self.seat_direction = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['seat_direction'], 'none')

	-- fo의 포지션 좌표에 앉을 것인가?
	self.is_center = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['is_center'], false)

	-- 앉았을 때 재생할 루프 사운드 (nil 이면 재생x)
	self.seat_loop_sfx_name = data['seat_loop_sfx_name']

	-- 재생할 sfx
	self.loop_sfx = nil

	-- 앉기 시작할 때 있는 자리 백업
	self.position_back_up = nil

	-- 의자에 앉아있는 캐릭터
	self.cur_seat_char = nil

	-- 앉는 목적지 위치 리스트
	self.destination_list = nil

	-- 앉아 있는지?
	self.is_seat = false

	self.farm_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(_)
end

function local_class:unsubscribe_events()
	if self.is_seat then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:unsubscribe_events()

	self:dispose_loop_sfx()

	self.farm_system = nil

	self.fo = nil
	self.cur_seat_char = nil
	self.destination_list = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.is_seat then
		return false
	end

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Interactor, leader) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.seat, self, leader))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.is_seat == false then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stand_up, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 의자에 앉는 연출
function local_class:seat(leader)
	-- 네비게이션 바 기능 막아둠
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = false

	-- 액션 스테이트 해제
	character_util.reset_action_state(leader)

	-- 목적지 세팅
	local destination = vector_util.get_x0z(self:get_near_point(leader.Position), self.seat_height)

	-- 리더가 앉을 때 좌표
	self.position_back_up = leader.Position

	-- 컨트롤 멈춤
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 점프 방향
	local jump_dir = (destination.x - leader.Position.x > 0) and 'right' or 'left'

	-- 최종 방향
	local side_dir = self.seat_direction == 'none' and jump_dir or self.seat_direction

	-- 점프 소리 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')

	-- 의자까지 가서 앉는다
	character_util.move_to(leader, destination, 0.3, nil, false, false, false)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(leader, jump_dir, 0.3, self.seat_height)

	-- 앉는 애니메이션으로 변경
	self:dispose_loop_sfx()
	self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.seat_loop_sfx_name
	, loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', parent = leader })

	character_util.set_active_shadow(leader, false)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, side_dir)
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = self.seat_anim })

	if self.seat_emotion ~= nil then
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = self.seat_emotion })
	end

	self.is_seat = true
	self.cur_seat_char = leader
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	-- 네비게이션 바 기능 활성화
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = true
	-- 대표 캐릭터 변경 기능 막아둠
	self.farm_system.CharacterManager:DisableCharacterSelector(self.cs_behaviour)
end

function local_class:get_near_point(leader_pos)
	local cur_destination = self.fo.Bounds.center
	local dist = 9999

	for i = 1, #self.destination_list do
		local cur_dist = (leader_pos - self.destination_list[i]).magnitude
		if cur_dist < dist then
			dist = cur_dist
			cur_destination = self.destination_list[i]
		end
	end

	return cur_destination
end

-- 의자에서 내려는 연출
function local_class:stand_up()
	if self.cur_seat_char == nil then
		return
	end

	-- 네비게이션 바 기능 막아둠
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = false
	-- 대표 캐릭터 변경 기능 허용
	self.farm_system.CharacterManager:EnableCharacterSelector(self.cs_behaviour)

	-- 터치 이벤트 구독해제
	self.is_seat = false
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	-- 내리는 방향으로 방향 전환
	local diff = (self.position_back_up - self.cur_seat_char.Position)
	character_util.set_direction(self.cur_seat_char, diff:ToDirection())
	local side_dir = (diff.x > 0) and 'right' or 'left'

	-- 내리는 소리 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')

	-- 의자에서 내림
	self:dispose_loop_sfx()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.cur_seat_char)
	character_util.move_to(self.cur_seat_char, self.position_back_up, 0.3, nil
	, false, false, false)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(self.cur_seat_char, side_dir, 0.3, self.seat_height)

	-- 컨트롤 원복
	character_util.set_active_shadow(self.cur_seat_char, true)
	message_system:SendSync(self.cur_seat_char, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	-- 네비게이션 바 기능 활성화
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = true

	self.cur_seat_char = nil
end

function local_class:update_building(data, pooled_object)
	local size = self.cs_behaviour.BuildingSpec.Size
	self.destination_list = {}

	if self.is_center == false and (size[0] > 1 or size[1] > 1) then
		-- 의자가 1x1 사이즈보다 크다면 앉는 포인트를 크기만큼 담는다
		local start_pos = self.fo.Position

		for i = 1, size.x do
			for j = 1, size.y do
				table.insert(self.destination_list, start_pos + vector(i - 1, 0, j - 1))
			end
		end
	else
		-- 1x1 사이즈라면 의자의 바운스 센터 + 오프셋 한 좌표를 앉는 좌표로
		table.insert(self.destination_list, self.fo.Bounds.center + vector(self.offset_x, 0, self.offset_z))
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_loop_sfx()
	if self.loop_sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	self.loop_sfx:Stop()
	self.loop_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:update_frame(_)
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}
