function local_class:get_n_factorial(n)
	if n == 0 then
		return 1
	end

	local length = #self.factorials
	if n <= length then
		return self.factorials[n]
	end

	while length ~= n do
		table.insert(self.factorials, self.factorials[length] * (length + 1))
		length = length + 1
	end

	return self.factorials[n]
end

function local_class:binomial(n, i)
	local a1 = self:get_n_factorial(n)
	local a2 = self:get_n_factorial(i)
	local a3 = self:get_n_factorial(n - i)
	return a1 / (a2 * a3)
end

function local_class:bezier(t, control_points)
	local n = #control_points - 1

	if n == 0 then
		return control_points[1]
	end
	if t <= 0 then
		return control_points[1]
	end
	if t >= 1 then
		return control_points[n + 1]
	end

	local res = unity_class.vector3.zero
	for i = 0, n do
		res = res + self:binomial(n, i) * t ^ i * (1 - t) ^ (n - i) * control_points[i + 1]
	end

	return res
end

function local_class:move_sled(duration, character, control_points, base_height, dir, scale_on_height, sync_rotation, roll, shake, shake_magnitude)
	local point_num = #control_points
	if point_num == 0 then
		return
	end

	local transform = self.pooled_object.transform
	local shake_calculator = nil
	if shake then
		shake_calculator = CS.Oak.ShakeCalculator()
		local shake_info = CS.Oak.ShakeInfo()
		shake_info.magnitude = shake_magnitude and shake_magnitude or 0.1
		shake_info.duration = duration
		shake_info.useUnscaledTime = false

		shake_calculator:Shake(shake_info)
	end

	local base_scale = unity_class.vector3.one
	local time_passed = 0
	local prev_dir = (dir == nil or dir == unity_class.vector3.zero) and unity_class.vector3.left or dir
	local new_dir = prev_dir
	local prev_pos = transform.localPosition
	local new_pos = prev_pos
	while time_passed < duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		prev_pos = new_pos
		new_pos = self:bezier(progress, control_points)

		if shake then
			shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			transform.localPosition = new_pos + shake_calculator.ShakeOffset
		else
			transform.localPosition = new_pos
		end

		if scale_on_height then
			transform.localScale = math.max((new_pos.y - base_height) * 0.4 + 1, 1) * base_scale
		end

		prev_dir = prev_dir ~= new_dir and new_dir or prev_dir
		new_dir = (new_pos - prev_pos).normalized
		local up_dir = unity_class.vector3.up
		local angle = 0
		if sync_rotation then
			if roll then
				up_dir = (new_dir - prev_dir).normalized
			end
			transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(new_dir,up_dir) * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)
			local object_up = transform.up
			angle = unity_class.vector3.Angle(unity_class.vector3.up, object_up:GetXy0().normalized) * (object_up.x > 0 and -1 or 1)
			-- 다음 프레임에 적용됨, 해당 동작 update_frame에서 실행 필요
			character.SpineController:Rotate(angle, 0)
		end

		angle = math.abs(angle)
		local look_dir = (new_pos - prev_pos).x * (angle > 90 and -1 or 1)
		if look_dir < constants.epsilon then
			look_dir = 0
		end
		if look_dir > 0 then
			if character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_aircraft_11')
			end
			character_util.set_direction(character, CS.Oak.Direction.Right)
		else
			if character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_aircraft_11')
			end
			character_util.set_direction(character, CS.Oak.Direction.Left)
		end

		local offset = (self.fo.Bounds.extents:GetX0z() + unity_class.vector3(self.offset_x - 0.5,self.seat_height,self.offset_z - 0.5)) * transform.localScale.y
		local rotated_offset = transform.rotation * offset
		character.Position = transform.position + rotated_offset
		character.Transform.localScale = transform.localScale

		--[[if self.fx_snowflake then
			self.fx_snowflake.transform.position = transform.position
			self.fx_snowflake.transform.rotation = transform.rotation
			self.fx_snowflake.transform.localScale = transform.localScale
		end
		if self.fx_snowflake_up then
			self.fx_snowflake_up.transform.position = transform.position
		end]]

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	transform.localPosition = control_points[point_num]
	character.SpineController:Rotate(0, 0)

	if shake then
		shake_calculator:Cancel()
	end

	return prev_dir
end

function local_class:tilt_toward_camera(vectors)
	local n = #vectors
	local base = vectors[1]
	local r = math.sqrt(3)
	for i = 1, n do
		local v = vectors[i] - base
		vectors[i] = unity_class.vector3(v.x, (r * v.y + v.z) * 0.5, (-v.y + r * v.z) * 0.5) + base
	end
end

function local_class:fade_in_sfx(sfx, time, from, to)
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < time do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		local progress = time_passed / time
		sfx.Volume = from + (to - from) * progress

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	sfx.Volume = to
end

end

return {

		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end

		[self.rabbit_state.t_move] = {center + vector(-0.45,0,-0.75), center + vector(0.45,0,-0.75)},

		[self.rabbit_state.s_move_rev] = {center + vector(-0.75,0,0.35), center + vector(0.75,0,0.35)},

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때

	self.target_info = nil

	self.farm_system = nil
end

-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:update_building(data, pooled_object)
	self.pooled_object = pooled_object
	self.pooled_object_animator = pooled_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

end

function local_class:remove_building(building_Id)
	self.pooled_object = nil
	self.pooled_object_animator = nil

	self:change_rabbit_state(self.rabbit_state.hide)

	farm_util.stop_ambient_sound(self.cs_behaviour)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	if not self.is_first_run and next_state == self.state.off then
		if not is_unity_null(self.pooled_object_animator) then
			self.pooled_object_animator:Play('off')
			self:turn_off_routine()
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.on then
		if not is_unity_null(self.pooled_object_animator) then
			self.pooled_object_animator:Play('on')
			self:turn_on_routine()
		end
	end

	self.current_state = next_state

	self.is_first_run = false
end

function local_class:turn_on_routine()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')

	farm_util.play_ambient_sound(self.cs_behaviour, 'hhf_full_moon_ambient', self.fo)

	if self.left_rabbit == nil then
		local rabbit = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('chooseok_rabbit'):Instantiate(vector(0,0,0))
		self.left_rabbit = {
			transform = rabbit.transform,
			spine_controller = rabbit:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
		}
		self.left_rabbit.transform.position = self.target_info[self.rabbit_state.f_move_rev][1]
		self.left_rabbit.spine_controller:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'run', true)
	end

	if self.right_rabbit == nil then
		local rabbit = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('chooseok_rabbit'):Instantiate(vector(0,0,0))
		self.right_rabbit = {
			transform = rabbit.transform,
			spine_controller = rabbit:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
		}
		self.right_rabbit.transform.position = self.target_info[self.rabbit_state.f_move_rev][2]
		self.right_rabbit.spine_controller:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'run', true)
	end

	if self.current_rabbit_state == self.rabbit_state.watching then
		return
	end

	if self.current_rabbit_state == self.rabbit_state.hide then
		self:change_rabbit_state(self.rabbit_state.f_move)
	else
		self:change_rabbit_state(self.current_rabbit_state * -1)
	end
end

function local_class:turn_off_routine()
	if self.current_rabbit_state == self.rabbit_state.hide then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')
	farm_util.stop_ambient_sound(self.cs_behaviour)

	if self.current_rabbit_state == self.rabbit_state.watching then
		self:change_rabbit_state(self.rabbit_state.t_move_rev)
	else
		self:change_rabbit_state(self.current_rabbit_state * -1)
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Interactor, leader) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_routine, self, leader))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_routine(interactor)
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = false
	character_util.reset_action_state(interactor)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

	local diff = self.fo.Position - interactor.Position
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(interactor, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false }, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(interactor, diff * 0.2, 0.3, 0.2)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	self:change_state(self.current_state == self.state.off and self.state.on or self.state.off, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(interactor)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = true
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_left_rabbit(dt)
	self:update_right_rabbit(dt)
end

function local_class:update_left_rabbit(dt)
	if self.current_rabbit_state == self.rabbit_state.hide or self.current_rabbit_state == self.rabbit_state.watching then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	if self.time_passed > 0.5 then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed - 0.5
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01', 0.4)
	end

	local target = self.target_info[self.current_rabbit_state][1]
	local magnitude = self.rabbit_speed * dt

	if magnitude > vector_util.magnitude(target - self.left_rabbit.transform.position) then
		magnitude = vector_util.magnitude(target - self.left_rabbit.transform.position)
		self:change_rabbit_state(self.current_rabbit_state + 1)
	end

	math.min(self.rabbit_speed * dt, vector_util.magnitude(target - self.left_rabbit.transform.position))
	local direction = vector_util.normalized(target - self.left_rabbit.transform.position)

	self.left_rabbit.transform.position = self.left_rabbit.transform.position + direction * magnitude
	self.left_rabbit.spine_controller.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(direction)
end

function local_class:update_right_rabbit(dt)
	if self.current_rabbit_state == self.rabbit_state.hide or self.current_rabbit_state == self.rabbit_state.watching then
		return
	end

	local target = self.target_info[self.current_rabbit_state][2]
	local magnitude = self.rabbit_speed * dt

	if magnitude > vector_util.magnitude(target - self.right_rabbit.transform.position) then
		magnitude = vector_util.magnitude(target - self.right_rabbit.transform.position)
		self:change_rabbit_state(self.current_rabbit_state + 1)
	end

	math.min(self.rabbit_speed * dt, vector_util.magnitude(target - self.right_rabbit.transform.position))
	local direction = vector_util.normalized(target - self.right_rabbit.transform.position)

	self.right_rabbit.transform.position = self.right_rabbit.transform.position + direction * magnitude
	self.right_rabbit.spine_controller.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(direction)
end

function local_class:change_rabbit_state(next_state)
	if self.left_rabbit == nil or self.right_rabbit == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.current_rabbit_state == self.rabbit_state.hide then
		self.left_rabbit.transform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.right_rabbit.transform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.time_passed = 0
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01', 0.4)
	elseif self.current_rabbit_state == self.rabbit_state.watching then
		self.left_rabbit.spine_controller:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'run', true)
		self.right_rabbit.spine_controller:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'run', true)
		self.time_passed = 0
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01', 0.4)
	end

	self.current_rabbit_state = next_state

	if self.current_rabbit_state == self.rabbit_state.hide then
		self.left_rabbit.transform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.right_rabbit.transform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	elseif self.current_rabbit_state == self.rabbit_state.watching then
		self.left_rabbit.spine_controller:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'victory', true)
		self.right_rabbit.spine_controller:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'victory', true)
		self.left_rabbit.spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		self.right_rabbit.spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	end
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('FarmDecorationHalloweenCoffin')

-- 생성자
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour
	self.is_first_run = nil

	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')
	if data_key == '' then
		data_key = 'default'
	end

	self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	self.pooled_object = nil
	self.pooled_object_animator = nil

	self.farm_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()

	self.state = {
		off = 0,
		on = 1
	}

	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.ghost_spawn_time = self.data.spawn_time
	self.ghost_spawn_count = self.data.spawn_count
	self.current_spawn_index = 0

	self.ghost_spawn_interval = self.data.spawn_interval

	self.ghost_move_dist = self.data.move_dist
	self.ghost_move_duration = self.data.move_duration

	self.ghost_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.data.spawn_name)

	self.ghost_prototype = {
		object = nil,
		initial_pos = nil,
		target_pos = nil,
		duration = self.ghost_move_duration,
		fade_time = self.ghost_move_duration * 0.66,
		time_passed = 0,
		spine = nil,
		mpb = nil,
		renderer = nil,
		init = function(self, object, pos, target_pos)
			self.object = object
			self.object.transform.localPosition = pos
			self.initial_pos = pos
			self.target_pos = target_pos

			local spine = object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
			spine.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
			spine:SetAnimation(1,'idle',true)
			spine.IsShadowActive = false

			self.mpb = CS.UnityEngine.MaterialPropertyBlock()
			self.renderer = spine.SkeletonAnimation:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))
		end,
		update = function(self, dt)
			if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
				return false
			end

			self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / 3)
			self.object.transform.localPosition = vector_util.lerp(self.initial_pos, self.target_pos, progress)
					+ vector(0, 0, math.sin(math.pi * progress * 3) * 0)

			if self.time_passed > self.fade_time then
				local alpha = (1 - progress) * 3
				self.mpb:SetColor(CS.UnityEngine.Shader.PropertyToID('_Color'), unity_color(
						{ alpha, alpha, alpha, alpha }) );
				self.renderer:SetPropertyBlock(self.mpb)
			end

			return true
		end,
		dispose = function(self)
			self.renderer:SetPropertyBlock(nil)
			self.mpb:Clear()
			self.object:Dispose()
			self.object = nil
			self.spine = nil
		end
	}
	self.summoned_ghosts = {}
	self.summoned_ghosts_mt = { __index = self.ghost_prototype }
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo
	self.is_first_run = true
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(_)
	self.fo = nil
	self.is_first_run = nil

	self.pooled_object = nil
	self.pooled_object_animator = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	for _, v in pairs(self.summoned_ghosts) do
		v:dispose()
	end
	self.summoned_ghosts = nil
	self.summoned_ghosts_mt = nil
	self.ghost_prototype = nil

	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil

	self.pooled_object = nil
	self.pooled_object_animator = nil

	self.ghost_spawn_time = nil
	self.ghost_spawn_count = nil

	self.farm_system = nil
	self.ghost_pool = nil

	self.data = nil
end

-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:time_passed_last_frame(time_passed, target_time, dt)
	if target_time < time_passed and target_time >= time_passed - dt then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:update_building(data, pooled_object)
	self.pooled_object = pooled_object
	self.pooled_object_animator = pooled_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	self:change_state(self.state.off)
end

function local_class:remove_building(building_Id)
	for _, v in pairs(self.summoned_ghosts) do
		v:dispose()
	end
	self.summoned_ghosts = {}

	self.pooled_object = nil
	self.pooled_object_animator = nil

	if self.timer_bar then
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
		self.timer_bar = nil
	end

	if self.data.off_ambient then
		farm_util.stop_ambient_sound(self.cs_behaviour)
	end

	self.current_spawn_index = 0
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = self.state.off
end

function local_class:start_next_timer()
	self.current_spawn_index = self.current_spawn_index + 1

	local ui_dic = field_ui_manager:SetUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
	self.timer_bar = ui_dic[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar]
	self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(60)
	self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, self.ghost_spawn_time[self.current_spawn_index])
	self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(0, 0)
	self.timer_bar.BarSprite.Transform.position = self.fo.Position + unity_class.vector3(0,0,-0.3)
end

function local_class:update_timer()
	if self.time_passed >= self.ghost_spawn_time[self.current_spawn_index] then
		-- 유령 스폰 시작
		self.time_passed = self.ghost_spawn_interval
		self.spawn_count = 0

		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
		self.timer_bar = nil

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.data.spawn_sfx[self.current_spawn_index],
									 parent = self.fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
		return true
	end

	self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.time_passed, 0)

	return false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_ghosts(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.off then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.timer_bar then
		self:update_timer()
	else
		if self.time_passed >= self.ghost_spawn_interval then
			self.time_passed = 0
			self.spawn_count = self.spawn_count + 1
			self:spawn_ghost()

			if self.spawn_count == self.ghost_spawn_count[self.current_spawn_index] then
				if self.current_spawn_index < #self.ghost_spawn_time then
					-- 스폰 종료 다음 타이머 시작
					self:start_next_timer()
				else
					-- 꺼짐
					self:change_state(self.state.off)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:spawn_ghost()
	local current_pos = self.pooled_object.transform.localPosition + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
	local target_pos = current_pos + vector(0, 0, - self.ghost_move_dist)
	local ghost_object = self.ghost_pool:Instantiate(target_pos)

	local ghost_spawned = {}
	setmetatable(ghost_spawned, self.summoned_ghosts_mt)
	ghost_spawned:init(ghost_object, current_pos, target_pos)
	table.insert(self.summoned_ghosts, ghost_spawned)
end

function local_class:update_ghosts(dt)
	for i,v in pairs(self.summoned_ghosts) do
		if not v:update(dt) then
			v:dispose()
			table.remove(self.summoned_ghosts, i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	if next_state == self.state.off then
		if not self.is_first_run and not is_unity_null(self.pooled_object_animator) then
			self.pooled_object_animator:Play('off')

			if self.data.off then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.data.off, parent = self.fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
			end
		end

		if self.timer_bar then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
			self.timer_bar = nil
		end

		self.current_spawn_index = 0
		self.time_passed = 0

		if self.data.off_ambient then
			farm_util.play_ambient_sound(self.cs_behaviour, self.data.off_ambient, self.fo)
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.on then
		if not is_unity_null(self.pooled_object_animator) then
			self.pooled_object_animator:Play('on')

			if self.data.on then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.data.on, parent = self.fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_impact_02', parent = self.fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
			end
		end

		if self.data.off_ambient then
			farm_util.stop_ambient_sound(self.cs_behaviour)
		end

		self:start_next_timer()
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.is_first_run = false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Interactor, leader) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_routine, self, leader))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_routine(interactor)
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = false
	character_util.reset_action_state(interactor)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	if self.data.interact then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.data.interact, parent = interactor, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	end

	local diff = self.fo.Position - interactor.Position
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(interactor, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false }, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(interactor, diff * 0.2, 0.3, 0.2)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	self:change_state(self.current_state == self.state.off and self.state.on or self.state.off)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(interactor)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = true
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.is_interacting then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed >= self.interact_duration then
		self.is_interacting = false

		local command = CS.Oak.InteractFinishCommand.Create(self.interactor, self.fo)
		command_util.execute_cmd(command)
	else
		self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.time_passed, 0)
	end
end

-- 건물 업데이트
function local_class:update_building(data, pooled_object)
	-- 건물 오브젝트인가.
	self.pooled_object = pooled_object
end

-- 건물 제거
function local_class:remove_building(building_Id)
	self.pooled_object = nil
end

-- 상호작용 이벤트 시작
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Interactor, leader) then
		-- 인터렉터 세팅
		self.interactor = e.Interactor
		farm_util.play_screenplay(self.choose_interaction_routine, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 선택지 루틴
function local_class:choose_interaction_routine()
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { 'farm_default_magic_tree_open', 'mercy' }, { 'farm_default_magic_tree_not_open', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 연출 루틴 시작
		self:screen_play_routine()
	end
end


-- 연출 루틴 시작
function local_class:screen_play_routine()
	self:screen_play()
end

-- 연출
function local_class:screen_play()

	-- 혹시 다른 음악이 있을 경우에 변경 요청 우선
	-- bgm_farm, 0.6, 믹싱 디폴트
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', name = 'bgm_farm', volume = 0.6})
	-- 볼륨 변경
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
	-- 유저 조작 금지
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local state = CS.Oak.CharacterMarionetteState.Create(self.interactor)
	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(state)
	message_system:SendSync(self.interactor.FieldObjectBehaviour, state_change_event)
	-- 액션 스테이트 리셋
	character_util.reset_action_state(self.interactor)
	-- 인터렉션 이후 루틴.

	-- 특정 위치로 이동
	self.leader_target_pos = self.fo.Position + vector(-1.0, 0, 0)

	-- 나무와 인터렉션 할 위치는 무조건 오른쪽이다.
	local interact_dir = 'right'
	-- 이동할 방향 바라봄
	local look_dir = nil
	if self.interactor.Position.x < self.leader_target_pos.x then
		look_dir = 'right'
	else
		look_dir = 'left'
	end

	-- 인터렉션 할 위치로 이동
	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.interactor, look_dir)
	-- 1초간 이동
	--character_util.move_to_async(self.interactor, self.leader_target_pos, 1.0, nil, false, true)
	wp_util.move(self.interactor, self.leader_target_pos, nil, 1.0)
	wait_for_sec(1.0)

	-- 무기 제거 시점 변경.
	character_util.hide_weapon(self.interactor, true, 'magic_tree')

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	-- 나무랑 인터렉팅 할 방향
	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.interactor, interact_dir)
	-- 나무 바라보고 사용하는 연출 idle / eat 1초
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.interactor, {name='eat'}, {name='idle'})

	-- 인터렉팅 사운드 플레이 1초간.
	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
		parent = self.interactor,
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'player',
		duration = 1.0})
	-- 1 초간 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.0)
	-- 먹는 모션 제거
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.interactor, {name='idle'}, {name='idle'})

	-- 검은배경에 캐릭터 등 연출위해서 위치를 변경하여 연출 하도록 함.
	-- 이벤트 플레이 위치
	local screen_play_pos = vector(-999, 0, -999)

	-- 수프캔 떨어지는 위치를 캐릭터 뒤쪽으로 잡아 떨어진 이후에 방향 변경.
	-- 기본 배경음 음소거
	-- 카메라 리더에게 0.1 초 : 토탈 0.1초
	camera_util.move_to_target(self.interactor, 0.1)

	-- 캐릭터의 앞, 나무가지 아래에 캔이 떨어지도록 할것.
	local dir_vec = vector(0.4, 0, 0)
	local target_pos = self.interactor.Position + dir_vec

	-- 수프 캔 떨어짐
	-- 일단 나무 중앙에서 생성하지만 차후 위치 변경 가능 .
	-- 집을수 없는 아이템이어야 하기 때문에 dontfindlooter 설정 한다.
	self.soup_can = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = self.fo.Bounds.center, target = target_pos,
			  itemid = 20081, notforinven = true, markforpick = false,
			  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'})
	-- 캔 떻어지는 사운드
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')

	-- 아이템 떨어질때까지 0.8초 대기 : 토탈 0.9초
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	-- 전체 어둡게 0.6초 : 토탈 1.5초
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.6, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	-- 다큰 설정 (차후 캐릭터/아이템만 보여져야 하기 때문에 )
	field_util.darken('magic_tree', 1, 0)
	-- 나중에 돌아올 위치 캐싱
	local original_pos = self.interactor.Position
	-- 캐릭터 위치 허공으로 이동
	character_util.set_position(self.interactor, screen_play_pos)
	-- 카메라는 바로 쫒아감.
	camera_util.move_to_target(self.interactor, 0)

	-- 아이템도 먹을 위치로 이동
	drop_item_util.move_item_async(self.soup_can, self.interactor.Position + dir_vec )

	-- 페이드인 풀고
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	-- 캐릭터 나오게 0.5초 : 토탈 2.0초
	field_util.undarken('magic_tree', 0.5)

	-- 1.5초간 먹는 애니 : 토탈 3.5초
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.interactor, {name = 'eat'}, { name='awesome' })
	-- 캔먹을때 나는 사운드
	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_eat_01',
		parent = self.interactor,
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'player',
		duration = 1.5 })

	drop_item_util.shake(self.soup_can, 'eat', 0.05, 1.5)
	-- 스프캔 없어짐
	drop_item_util.resize_to_async(self.soup_can, 0, 1.5)

	-- 다 먹었으니
	-- 번쩍이는 빛!
	self.lightning_pool:Instantiate(self.interactor.Position + unity_class.vector3(0, 0.6, 0))
	-- 이펙트 진행 시간 동안 대기
	-- bgm 제거 를 동시에 진행
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	-- 라이팅 사운드
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_matched_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')

	-- 캐릭터 아래 방향 전환
	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.interactor, 'down')
	-- 캐릭터 놀람!
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.interactor, {name = 'idle'}, { name='surprise' })
	-- 느낌표 표시
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.interactor, nil, 'notice')
	-- 0.5초 대기 : 토탈 4.0초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--fx_default_magic_tree
	-- 파란색 이펙트와 함께 3초간 제자리 회전 : 토탈 7초
	self.blue_light_pool:Instantiate(self.interactor.Bounds.center)
	character_util.spine_rotate(self.interactor, 360 * 8, 3)
	--회전 이펙트 사운드
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lights_01')
	self.sfx_loop = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_cast_magic_01',
		loop = true
	})

	wait_for_sec(1.0)
	-- 1초 후 사운드 출력 위해 wait_for_sec 분리
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gong_01')
	wait_for_sec(1.4)
	-- 회전 중에 페이드 아웃 시키기 위함.
	-- 페이드아웃 0.6초 : 토탈 7.3초
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.6, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	-- 루프 사운드 페이드아웃
	self.sfx_loop:FadeOut(0.6)

	-- 처음 위치로 이동
	character_util.set_position(self.interactor, original_pos)
	camera_util.move_to_target(self.interactor, 0)

	-- 회전되어있는 스파인 원래 회전값으로 변경
	character_util.spine_rotate(self.interactor, 0, 0)
	-- 처음 보고 있던 방향으로 전환
	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.interactor, interact_dir)
	-- 쓰러져 있는 캐릭터
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.interactor, {name = 'prostrate', mix_duration = 0}, {name='blush'})
	-- 카메라 복구
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.0)
	camera_util.move(self.interactor.Position, 0.0, { target = user_party, end_target = user_party, ignore_camera_grid = true })

	camera_util.move_to_target_async()

	-- bgm 복구 페이드 인 하면서 사운드 복귀
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', bgm_name = 'bgm_farm', mix = 4.0 })
	-- 페이드 인 0.5초 : 토탈 7.8초
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	-- 대기 0.5초 : 토탈 8.3초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 0.5초 떨고 1.0초 대기 2회 후 점프 1.0초 = 4.0초 : 토탈 12.3초
	character_util.shake_and_wakeup(self.interactor, interact_dir, 2, nil, true)
	-- bgm 전환
	-- local bgm = music_player:PlaySfx(self.bgm_info)
	-- 일어나서 잠깐 대기 0.5초 : 토탈 12.8초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.interactor)

	-- 무기 복구
	character_util.hide_weapon(self.interactor, false, 'magic_tree')

	-- 드랍아이템 Dispose
	if self.soup_can ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.soup_can)
		self.soup_can = nil
	end

	-- 방향 락 해제
	character_util.reset_locked_dir(self.interactor)
	-- 캐릭터 상태 초기화
	character_util.reset_all_state(self.interactor, interact_dir)
	-- 조작 가능상태로 변경
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	message_system:SendSync(self.interactor, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('FarmDecorationOnOff')

-- 생성자
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour
	self.is_first_run = nil

	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')
	if data_key == '' then
		data_key = 'default'
	end

	-- 데이터 세팅
	local data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	self.sfx_data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	self.pooled_object = nil
	self.pooled_object_animator = nil

	self.farm_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()

	self.state = {
		off = 0,
		on = 1
	}

	-- Shake 변수
	self.is_shake = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['shake'], false)
	self.shake = false
	self.shake_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['shake_magnitude'], 0.2)
	self.shake_duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['shake_duration'], 0.2)
	self.shake_effect = data['shake_effect']

	self.shake_calculator = CS.Oak.ShakeCalculator()
	if self.shake_effect then
		self.fx_shake_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.shake_effect)
	end

	self.current_state = nil
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo
	self.is_first_run = true
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(_)
	self.fo = nil
	self.is_first_run = nil
	self.pooled_object = nil
	self.pooled_object_animator = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil

	self.pooled_object = nil
	self.pooled_object_animator = nil

	self.farm_system = nil
	self.original_object_pos = nil

	self:stop_shake()
	self.shake_calculator = nil

	if self.fx_shake_pool then
		self.fx_shake_pool:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_shake_pool = nil
end

function local_class:start_shake(magnitude, duration)
	if not self.pooled_object then
		return
	end

	local shake_info = CS.Oak.ShakeInfo()
	shake_info.magnitude = magnitude
	shake_info.duration = duration
	shake_info.useUnscaledTime = false

	self.shake_calculator:Shake(shake_info)
	self.shake = true
end

function local_class:stop_shake()
	self.shake_calculator:Cancel()
	self.shake = false
end

-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:update_building(data, pooled_object)
	self.pooled_object = pooled_object
	self.pooled_object_animator = pooled_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	self.original_object_pos = self.pooled_object.transform.localPosition

	self:change_state(farm_util.get_deco_data(data.Id, 1))
end

function local_class:remove_building(building_Id)
	self.pooled_object = nil
	self.pooled_object_animator = nil

	farm_util.remove_relative_deco_datas(building_Id)
	self:change_state(self.state.off)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state, need_apply)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	if not self.is_first_run and next_state == self.state.off then
		if not is_unity_null(self.pooled_object_animator) then
			self.pooled_object_animator:Play('off')
		end
		if self.sfx_data.on_ambient then
			farm_util.stop_ambient_sound(self.cs_behaviour)
		end

		if self.sfx_data.off then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.sfx_data.off, parent = self.fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
		end

		if self.sfx_data.off_additional then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.sfx_data.off_additional, parent = self.fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.on then
		if not is_unity_null(self.pooled_object_animator) then
			self.pooled_object_animator:Play('on')
		end

		if not self.is_first_run and self.sfx_data.on then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.sfx_data.on, parent = self.fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
		end

		if not self.is_first_run and self.sfx_data.on_additional then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.sfx_data.on_additional, parent = self.fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
		end

		if self.sfx_data.on_ambient then
			farm_util.play_ambient_sound(self.cs_behaviour, self.sfx_data.on_ambient, self.fo)
		end
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	if need_apply then
		farm_util.set_deco_data(self.cs_behaviour.BuildingId, 1, next_state)
	end

	self.is_first_run = false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Interactor, leader) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_routine, self, leader))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_routine(interactor)
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = false
	character_util.reset_action_state(interactor)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	if self.sfx_data.interact then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.sfx_data.interact, parent = interactor, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	end

	local diff = self.fo.Position - interactor.Position
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(interactor, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false }, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(interactor, diff * 0.2, 0.3, 0.2)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	if self.is_shake then
		self:start_shake(self.shake_magnitude, self.shake_duration)
	end
	if self.fx_shake_pool then
		self.fx_shake_pool:Instantiate(self.fo.Position)
	end

	self:change_state(self.current_state == self.state.off and self.state.on or self.state.off, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(interactor)
	wait_for_sec(self.shake_duration)
	if self.is_shake then
		self:stop_shake()
	end

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = true
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.shake then
		return
	end

	if self.shake_calculator.IsActive then
		self.shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		self.pooled_object.transform.localPosition = self.original_object_pos + self.shake_calculator.ShakeOffset
	else
		self.shake = false
	end
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

		return self:on_interact_cancel_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractFinishEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_finish_event(e)
	end

end

function local_class:update_building(data, pooled_object)

	farm_util.play_ambient_sound(self.cs_behaviour, 'hhf_slime_pool_ambient', self.fo)
end

function local_class:remove_building(building_Id)
	self.pooled_object = nil

	farm_util.stop_ambient_sound(self.cs_behaviour)
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Interactor, leader) then
		-- 액션 스테이트 리셋
		character_util.reset_action_state(leader)

		self.is_interacting = true
		self.interactor = e.Interactor
		local look_dir
		if self.interactor.Position.x < self.fo.Bounds.center.x then
			look_dir = 'right'
		else
			look_dir = 'left'
		end

		character_util.set_locked_dir(self.interactor, look_dir)

		local interact_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerInteractState.Create(self.interactor, self.fo)
		message_system:SendSync(self.interactor, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(interact_state))

		self.interact_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_plate_01', parent = leader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })

		local req = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('eat', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, true)
		local state = CS.Oak.CharacterMarionetteState.Create(self.interactor, req)
		local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(state)

		state.CurrentAction = CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Gathering
		message_system:SendSync(self.interactor.FieldObjectBehaviour, state_change_event)

		local ui_dic = field_ui_manager:SetUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)

		if self.timer_bar == nil then
			self.timer_bar = ui_dic[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar]
			self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(100)
			self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, self.interact_duration);
			self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(0, 0);

			self.time_passed = 0
			self.prev_time_passed = 0
		end
		return true
	end

	return falsez
end

function local_class:on_interact_cancel_event(e)
	if self.interact_sfx then
		self.interact_sfx:FadeOut(0.05)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.interactor)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.interactor, 'none')
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
	self.timer_bar = nil

	self.is_interacting = false

	return true
end

function local_class:on_interact_finish_event(e)
	if self.interact_sfx then
		self.interact_sfx:FadeOut(0.05)
	end

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
	self.timer_bar = nil

	self.is_interacting = false

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.screen_play_routine, self)

	return true
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.is_interacting then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed >= self.interact_duration then
		self.is_interacting = false

		local command = CS.Oak.InteractFinishCommand.Create(self.interactor, self.fo)
		command_util.execute_cmd(command)
	else
		self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.time_passed, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:screen_play_routine()
	-- 무기 감춤
	character_util.hide_weapon(user_party.Leader, true, 'slime_pool')

	-- 뽕! 하고 튀어나옴
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_popup_01', parent = self.fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	local slime_jelly_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = self.fo.Bounds.center,
		target = user_party.Leader.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(user_party.Leader.LockedDirection) * 0.5,
		itemid = 20068,
		notforinven = true,
		amount = 1,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
	})
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 먹는 연출
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'eat', loop = true })
	local holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_eat_01', parent = user_party.Leader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })

	local time_passed = 0
	while (time_passed < 1.5) do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / 1.5)
		slime_jelly_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - progress)
		slime_jelly_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - progress)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 다 먹음
	holder:FadeOut(0.2)
	slime_jelly_item:ConsumeComplete()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	-- 완식 후 만-족
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'dance', loop = true }, { name = 'awesome' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_bad_fairy_01', parent = user_party.Leader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })

	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	-- 연출 종료 준비
	holder:FadeOut(0.2)
	character_util.hide_weapon(user_party.Leader, false, 'slime_pool')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, 'none')

	wait_for_sec(0.2)
end

	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	if next_state == self.state.off then

			self.pooled_object_animator:SetTrigger('is_off')

	self.selected_song_key = 'hhf_snow_ball_ambient_'..random_idx;

		coroutine.yield(farm_util.is_sfx_playing(self.selected_song_key))

		if self.current_state == self.state.on then

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')
	farm_util.stop_ambient_sound(self.cs_behaviour)
	music_player:ChangeStageMusicVolume(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field, 1.0, 0.5)
	self.is_in = true
end

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Interactor, leader) then

	character_util.reset_action_state(interactor)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

	local diff = self.fo.Position - interactor.Position
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(interactor, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false }, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(interactor, diff * 0.2, 0.3, 0.2)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	self:change_state(self.current_state == self.state.off and self.state.on or self.state.off, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(interactor)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = true
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.off then
		return
	end

	if user_party.Leader == nil then
		return
	end

	local distance = vector_util.distance(self.fo.Position, user_party.Leader.Position);

	if distance <= self.check_distance then
		if not self.is_in then
			self.is_in = true
			music_player:ChangeStageMusicVolume(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field, 0.5, 0.5)
		end
	else
		if self.is_in then

			music_player:ChangeStageMusicVolume(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field, 1.0, 0.5)
		end
	end

	self.pooled_object_animator = nil

	farm_util.remove_relative_deco_datas(building_Id)

function local_class:reset_remove_sound_state()
	self.current_state_index = 0

	if self.has_ambient then
		farm_util.stop_ambient_sound(self.cs_behaviour)

function local_class:change_state(next_state_index, need_apply)
	if self.current_state_index == next_state_index then
		return
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.pooled_object_animator) then
		self.pooled_object_animator:Play(self.data.animation_key[next_state_index])

	end

	if not self.is_first_run and self.data.sfx_key[next_state_index] then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.data.sfx_key[next_state_index],
									 parent = self.fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
	end

	if self.has_ambient and self.data.ambient_key[next_state_index] then
		farm_util.play_ambient_sound(self.cs_behaviour, self.data.ambient_key[next_state_index], self.fo)
	end

	self.current_state_index = next_state_index
	if need_apply then
		farm_util.set_deco_data(self.cs_behaviour.BuildingId, 1, next_state_index)
	end

	self.is_first_run = false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Interactor, leader) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_routine, self, leader))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_routine(interactor)
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = false
	character_util.reset_action_state(interactor)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	if self.data.interact then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.data.interact, parent = interactor, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	end

	local diff = self.fo.Position - interactor.Position
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(interactor, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false }, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(interactor, diff * 0.2, 0.3, 0.2)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	local next_state_index = math.fmod(self.current_state_index, self.state_count) + 1
	self:change_state(next_state_index, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(interactor)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = true
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('FarmDecorationTable')

-- 생성자
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)

	end

	-- 데이터 세팅
	local data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	-- 책상 칠 때 모션
	self.hit_anim = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['hit_anim'], 'release')

	-- 칠 때 재생할 표정 (nil 이면 표정 없는 것)
	self.hit_emotion = data['hit_emotion']

	-- 임시
	self.anim_length = 0.467
	self.hit_timing = 0.234

	-- Shake 변수
	self.shake = false
	self.shake_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['shake_magnitude'], 0.2)
	self.shake_duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['shake_duration'], self.anim_length - self.hit_timing)

	self.hit_count = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['hit_count'], 2)

	self.shake_calculator = CS.Oak.ShakeCalculator()

	-- 재생할 sfx
	self.swing_sfx = '01_swing_01'
	self.hit_sfx = '01_car_door_02'
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(_)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
	self.original_object_pos = nil

	self:stop_shake()
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.character then
		return false
	end

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Interactor, leader) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_table, self, leader))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_shake(magnitude, duration)
	if not self.pooled_object then
		return
	end

	local shake_info = CS.Oak.ShakeInfo()
	shake_info.magnitude = magnitude
	shake_info.duration = duration
	shake_info.useUnscaledTime = false

	self.shake_calculator:Shake(shake_info)
	self.shake = true
end

function local_class:stop_shake()
	self.shake_calculator:Cancel()
	self.shake = false
end

function local_class:interact_table(leader)

	local fo_center_pos = self.fo.Bounds.center:GetX0z()
	local char_pos = leader.Position
	local dir_vector = (fo_center_pos - char_pos).normalized
	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(dir_vector)

	character_util.reset_action_state(leader)
	-- 컨트롤 멈춤
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	for _ = 1, self.hit_count do
		-- 표정
		if self.hit_emotion ~= nil then
			character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = self.hit_emotion })
		end

		-- 팔 휘두름
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.swing_sfx)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, dir)
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = self.hit_anim, loop = false })
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(self.hit_timing))

		-- 테이블 침
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.hit_sfx)
		self:start_shake(self.shake_magnitude, self.shake_duration)
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(self.anim_length - self.hit_timing))
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	end

	self:stop_shake()
	message_system:SendSync(leader, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

function local_class:update_building(data, pooled_object)
	self.pooled_object = pooled_object
	self.original_object_pos = self.pooled_object.transform.localPosition
end

function local_class:remove_building(building_Id)
	self.pooled_object = nil
	self.original_object_pos = nil
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.shake then
		return
	end

	if self.shake_calculator.IsActive then
		self.shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		self.pooled_object.transform.localPosition = self.original_object_pos + self.shake_calculator.ShakeOffset
	else
		self.shake = false
	end
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('FarmDecorationTent')

-- 생성자
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')
	if data_key == '' then
		data_key = 'default'
	end

	-- 데이터 세팅
	local data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	-- 텐트 입장 오프셋
	self.enter_offset_x = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['enter_offset_x'], 0)
	self.enter_offset_z = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['enter_offset_z'], 0)

	-- 텐트 입장 후 오프셋
	self.emoticon_offset_x = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['emoticon_offset_x'], 1)
	self.emoticon_offset_z = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['emoticon_offset_z'], 1)

	-- 텐트 내부 바닥 높이
	self.tent_inside_height = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['tent_inside_height'], 0.5)

	-- 내부에 들어갈 때 재생할 애니메이션
	self.enter_anim = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['enter_anim'], 'walk4legs')

	-- 재생할 sfx
	self.enter_sfx_name = data['enter_sfx_name']
	self.exit_sfx_name = data['exit_sfx_name']

	-- 텐트에 들어간 캐릭터
	self.character = nil

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.emot_spawn_term = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['emoticon_spawn_term'], 5)

	self.farm_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()

	self.emoticon_key = {
		question = 'question',
		exclamation = 'notice',
		silence = 'silence',
		heart = 'heart'
	}
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(_)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	self.farm_system = nil

	self.fo = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil

	self.emoticon_key = nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.character then
		return false
	end

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Interactor, leader) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_tent, self, leader))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.character == nil then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.leave_tent, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_loop_emoticon()
	self.loop_emoticon = true
	self:show_emoticon_on_tent()
end

function local_class:stop_loop_emoticon()
	self.loop_emoticon = false
	self:dispose_emoticon()
end

function local_class:show_emoticon_on_tent()
	if self.emoticon then
		self:dispose_emoticon()
	end

	local type_str = nil

	local rand = random_util.get_random_int(0, self.last_emoticon and 3 or 4)
	if self.last_emoticon and rand >= self.last_emoticon then
		rand = rand + 1
	end

	if rand == 0 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		type_str = character_util.get_emoticon_type(self.emoticon_key.silence)
	elseif rand == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		type_str = character_util.get_emoticon_type(self.emoticon_key.exclamation)
	elseif rand == 2 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
		type_str = character_util.get_emoticon_type(self.emoticon_key.question)
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		type_str = character_util.get_emoticon_type(self.emoticon_key.heart)
	end

	local pos = self.fo.Bounds.center
	local emoticon_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('emoticon'):Instantiate(pos)
	self.emoticon = emoticon_pool.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.Emoticon))
	local base_scale = unity_class.vector3.one
	local type = character_util.get_emoticon_type(type_str)
	local offset = unity_class.vector3(self.emoticon_offset_x, 0, self.emoticon_offset_z)

	self.emoticon:Init()
	self.emoticon:ShowOn(self.fo.Transform, base_scale, type, offset)
	self.last_emoticon = rand
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:dispose_emoticon()
	if self.emoticon then
		self.emoticon:Dispose()
		self.emoticon = nil
	end
end

function local_class:enter_tent(leader)
	-- 네비게이션 바 기능 막아둠
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = false
	character_util.reset_action_state(leader)

	local fo_center_pos = self.fo.Bounds.center:GetX0z()
	fo_center_pos.y = field:GetTileInfoAt(fo_center_pos):GetHeightAt(fo_center_pos)
	local entrance_pos = fo_center_pos + unity_class.vector3(self.enter_offset_x, 0, self.enter_offset_z)
	local destination = fo_center_pos + unity_class.vector3(0, self.tent_inside_height, 0)
	local entrance_dist = (entrance_pos - leader.Position):GetX0z().magnitude
	local dir_vector = (fo_center_pos - leader.Position).normalized
	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(dir_vector)

	-- 컨트롤 멈춤
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 입구로
	character_util.move_to(leader, entrance_pos, entrance_dist * 0.5, nil, true, true, false)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(entrance_dist * 0.5))

	-- 입장
	character_util.set_direction(leader, dir)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.enter_sfx_name)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.1))
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = self.enter_anim })
	character_util.move_to(leader, destination, 1, nil, true, false, false)
	leader.SpineController:SetAlphaFade(0, 0.5)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.2))

	self:start_loop_emoticon()

	self.character = leader
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	-- 네비게이션 바 기능 활성화
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = true
	-- 대표 캐릭터 변경 기능 막아둠
	self.farm_system.CharacterManager:DisableCharacterSelector(self.cs_behaviour)
end

function local_class:leave_tent()
	if self.character == nil then
		return
	end

	local exit_pos = self.fo.Bounds.center:GetX0z() + unity_class.vector3(self.enter_offset_x, 0, self.enter_offset_z)
	exit_pos.y = field:GetTileInfoAt(self.fo.Position):GetHeightAt(self.fo.Position)

	-- 네비게이션 바 기능 막아둠
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = false
	-- 대표 캐릭터 변경 기능 허용
	self.farm_system.CharacterManager:EnableCharacterSelector(self.cs_behaviour)

	-- 터치 이벤트 구독해제
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	self:stop_loop_emoticon()

	-- 나감
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.exit_sfx_name)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.1))
	character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = self.enter_anim })
	character_util.move_to(self.character, exit_pos, 1, nil, true, false, false)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))
	self.character.SpineController:SetAlphaFade(1, 0.5)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.6))

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.character)

	-- 컨트롤 원복
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	-- 네비게이션 바 기능 활성화
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = true

	self.character = nil
end

function local_class:update_building(data, pooled_object)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.loop_emoticon then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed >= self.emot_spawn_term then
		self:show_emoticon_on_tent()
	end
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}
